name: Run for the Oaks
description:
Run for the Oaks

This is the 10th annual Run for the Oaks at Left Coast Cellars! The course will predominantly be on gravel roads or off-road with trail and paved road segments. The run will meander throughout the Left Coast Cellars estate and runners will pass oak forests, vineyards, and gardens with spectacular views of the Willamette Valley. This run has been created to raise funds for our Oak Savanna Restoration Project. The goal of the project is to model how ecological integrity can coincide with responsible industry.

Great Event

  • Complimentary wine tasting!
  • Participant T-Shirts
  • Finishers receive a custom wine glass
  • Event professionally chip timed
  • Free Parking
We hope to see you out there!

name: Run Whiskey Run
description:
For more information, visit our website at www.SouthCoastRunningClub.org

Located roughly 20 miles south of Coos Bay, the region’s first single-track trail system is open year-round to mountain bikers, but for the first time ever will be reserved for those of us who shred at running pace. 

We’ll start and finish at the main Whiskey Run Trailhead. 

Our chosen section of Whiskey Run is shaded and sheltered, which means these trails are rolling, smooth, and oh so loamy.

Course options include:

·      1.5 Mile (Shirley Temple)

·      5 Mile (Whiskey Ginger)

·      10 Mile (Double Shot) 

Please note that all courses are 100% trail, so not stroller friendly.

PRICES

Online

$15 Club member (your discount will appear at check-out), Non-member $25. 

Day of race

$20 Club member, Non-member $30

Students: $5.00.  Use the code Student2022 to register.  To avoid credit card charges, students will not be charged at on-line registration.  Please bring $5 (exact change appreciated) to registration!  

START TIMES

-      9am (10 Mile Double Shot)

-      9:30am (5 Mile Whiskey Ginger) 

-      9:45 (1.5 Mile Shirley Temple)

Course support ends at 12 PM.

Day of race registration and packet pick up begins at 8:00 at Whiskey Run Trailhead.

Runners should assemble at the starting line no later than 10 minutes before start time for instructions from the race director.  

Come dressed to run; no space is available for changing/showering.

INFORMATION ABOUT THE AREA

Whiskey Run is located on Oregon’s Adventure Coast. Our costal community offers endless opportunities for beach combing, fishing, crabbing, paddling, hiking, and golfing. And don’t forget about the mountain biking… bring your bike and explore the 30+ miles of premier single track at Whiskey Run.

Come see what attracts so many runners to Oregon’s Adventure Coast.

name: RUN/WALK FOR THE RARE!
description:
Haley's Heroes Foundation presents 7th Annual RUN FOR THE RARE, a 10k, 5k and 1 mile run/walk to support International Batten Disease Awareness Day.  Did you know that Rare is everywhere? Join us as we run on Sunday, June 14, 2026. 1 in 10 people have a rare disease and 50% of those are children. There are more than 7000 known rare diseases and an estimated 350 million people globally diagnosed with a rare disease. YET, 95% of all rare diseases don't have a FDA approved treatment or cure. Let's run (or walk) to change the course of the lives for all those with rare disease. Post pictures at #RUNWALKFORTHERARE!  

The race will start and finish outside of the Pavilion in the North Meadow. Starting time is 10am and all participants should be finished by 1pm.

Cost is $45 for adults and $35 for children and includes the t-shirt.

Registration fee includes  a T-shirt, coupon for wings and fries, coupon for ice cream and a Photo Booth.

June 13 - Early packet pick up is 2pm-4pm at Gallagher's Fitness | 135 Commercial St NE, Salem, OR 97301
June 14 - Packet pick up beginning at 9am at the run

name: Salem Holiday Festivus 5k
description:
We are doing it. Again. Festivus. The third annual. Get any Christmas/Santa/Festivus/Seinfeld/Ugly Sweater costume together, or just come as you are.  Spots are limited.

Show up late morning on Saturday December 27, 2025 at 10:30am at the Gerry Frank Rotary Pavilion near the bridge at Salem Riverfront Park. The Feats of Strength begin at 11:00am.

The Festivus activities, if you know anything about it, involves 4 things:

  1. Feats of Strength
  2. The Airing of Grievances
  3. The Feast
  4. The Festivus Pole

So, how do we approach this?

Feats of Strength: The timer starts at 11:00am. The first component is a wall sit for 45 seconds along the wall, or against the fence. After your 45 seconds, then you have to do 20 push ups. Take as long as you need. Once you finish, you can start the 5k run across the white bridge straight into Minto Park.  

We will have a stop watch, but no chip timing this year. The finishing order will be recorded only.  The run is about 3.1 miles.  You have to be able to finish the course in 45 minutes. That is a 14.5-minute pace. Brisk walkers okay. No dogs. Dogs can't do push ups. You gotta finish. Skipping might get you there in time for a Festivus miracle. Reach the finish line and turn in your bib tag.

The airing of grievances: You can write your grievances in advance on any paper, or on a card at the event. Post it on the board. Keep it short. This is not an intervention.  On the other side of the board will be the "Festivus Miracles."

The Feast: Yes, it will be cold. Yes, there will be a cup of hot chocolate or hot soup. Feast is an overstatement...This part will expand in future events.  

The Festivus Pole: Yes, we have the official Festivus Pole. Will there be tinsel on the pole? NO. "Tinel is distracting," according to Frank Costanza. You can totally get your picture taken with the pole. Please don't dance on the pole. It's awesome, but it's not bolted down.

A guy we will call "Mullet Santa" will give out prizes for the following:

Top 3 male/female finishers (No age group awards)

Best Santa/Christmas Costume Mens Division & Womens Division
Best Seinfeld Costume Mens Division & Womens Division
Best Ugly Sweater Mens Division & Womens Division

If you are a serious runner who wants a pretty t-shirt and a certified course, this is not the race for you. This is Festivus, the race for the rest of us! 

If you have never heard of Festivus, it was an anti-holiday popularized by a Seinfeld episode. You can view that clip here:

https://www.bing.com/videos/search?q=festivus+seinfeld+episode&view=detail&mid=25668A2CB76E51064C9B25668A2CB76E51064C9B&FORM=VIRE

There are a few Festivus races around the country, and now Salem, Oregon has one.

name: Shamrock Run
description:

WHEN:  March 21st

name: Sole Sisters 13.1 / 10k / 5k
description:
Women walkers, joggers, and runners of all ages and abilities are welcome to join us in the Sole Sisters Half Marathon, 10k, and 5k! Join us as we celebrate the gift of sisterhood, and the satisfaction of achieving big goals!

Enjoy a beautiful out and back course that winds through the scenic trails along the Willamette River and beautiful side streets of Wilsonville. 

***This is a timing optional race, with special recognition given to the top three finishers in each age division.  

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 

Each participant will receive...

  • Weekly Long-distance Routes in 1 of 15 Different Locations beginning March 2026

  • Optional in-person weekly training led by coaches (location dependent)

  • Special Events and Raffles at Road Runner Sports in Tualatin

  • Weekly Emails/Connection 

  • Race Day Breakfast Item 

  • Personalized Race Bib  

  • Finisher's Medal

  • Optional Race Tech T-Shirt or Tank Top available for purchase. 

 

ALL REGISTRATIONS RECEIVED AFTER MAY 10th WILL NOT INCLUDE A PERSONALIZED RACE BIB

 

No refunds.  Transfers are allowed.

Dogs are not allowed on the race course.

name: Southern Oregon Runners Turkey Trot Run
description:
Come to Talent, Oregon for our Thanksgiving run! We will be hosting a food drive for the SOU food bank and a portion of the proceeds will go to SOR Student Runners Programs which include Shoes for Kids (provides shoes to Jr. High and High School athletes who would like to participate in Cross Country and Track but cannot afford proper running shoes), KidsRunFree (provides free entry to all SOR races for kids 18 & under), and XC Project (provides timing support for schools during cross country season).

When - November 26, 2025

Free Turkey Dash Kids Run( 8 and Under)8:00AM| 8 Mile Run 8:15AM|5k Run/Walk 8:30AM|2 Mile Family Run/Walk 8:40AM $20 for members| $25 for non members| Youth 18 and Under are free. Family Pricing available for this event, this is for families and families with extended family in town for the holidays, only.  

Where - Cummins 300 W Valley View Rd, Talent, Oregon 97540

Packet Pick Up - November 25th from 3:30-8pm at Legend Cider Co. Talent Taphouse, 245 W Valley View, Talent, Oregon 97540. Packet pick up is also available from 7-8am on the day of the race. NO IN PERSON REGISTRATION will be offered. 

Participants will receive a custom race bib and finishers medal. No age group awards.

NO DOGS, BIKES, SKATEBOARDS OR SKATES PERMITTED.

*Races are on public roads and trails that ARE NOT closed to cars, pedestrian or cyclist.  Please use caution while on public roadways and paths.

name: Support the Girls 5K Run/Walk Fundraiser for Breast Friends
description:
Over 4000 women in Oregon are diagnosed with breast cancer each year and our mission is to ensure no one goes through breast cancer alone. Striving to be relevant, accessible, and inclusive of all who want to participate. Breast Friends empowers those to thrive beyond their cancer diagnosis through education, community, and support.

Please join us for this fun community event at Stickmen Brewery in Tualatin. The course is paved and mostly flat - perfect for all abilities and ages! Grab your friends, co-workers, and family, and enjoy this walk/jog/run together! Afterward, you can rest and recover with pizza and a beverage at Stickmen Brewing.

**Registration opens on March 16th, 2026!!!!

name: Timberline Marathon and Half Marathon
description:
Get ready for the most picturesque marathon and half marathon trail running course in the Pacific Northwest! The course completely circles shimmering Timothy Lake on single track trails that are absolutely a runner's dream. This gem is nestled at 3,227 feet in the high Cascades and the views of Mt. Hood across the lake are extraordinary.

Finisher medals and gender specific technical shirts are included with your registration.

The journey begins at the Clackamas Lake Historic Ranger Station and takes runners on a magical course that traverses three rustic bridges over sparkling tributaries that feed the deep blue waters of the lake. The ever changing scenery and terrain create an experience that is unparalleled. The Timberline Marathon and Half Marathon is a must for any runner's calendar!

name: TrackTown Triathlon
description:
Join the University of Oregon Triathlon Team for a fun, welcoming, and beginner-friendly triathlon right here at the UO Rec Center! Whether you’re a experienced triathlete, completely new to the sport, or you’re a young athlete excited to challenge yourself, this event is built just for you.

What to Expect

This race is designed to be accessible, low-pressure, and community-oriented. Distances are intentionally short, the atmosphere is relaxed, and our UO Tri athletes will be on deck to cheer you on, answer questions, and guide you every step of the way. Perfect for:

  • Newcomers wanting a fun introduction to triathlon
  • Youth and teens interested in trying something active and exciting
  • Community members looking for a supportive challenge
  • Families and friends participating together


Race Format

The event takes place entirely within and around the Rec Center facilities, featuring:

Indoor Swim – Safe, supervised laps in the Rec Center pool
Stationary Bike Ride – Timed effort on indoor bikes—your own pace, no traffic!
Outdoor Run – A quick course to finish strong
Each segment is designed to be manageable for all ability levels. No specialized gear or prior triathlon experience required.

Why Race With Us?

  • Friendly, inclusive environment
  • Great way to try a new sport
  • Meet UO student-athletes and local community members
  • Boost confidence and fitness
  • Celebrate crossing a finish line—maybe your first!

Come Tri!
Bring your energy, your curiosity, and maybe a friend or two. Whether this is your first race ever or simply a fun way to stay active, we can’t wait to see you at the Rec Center starting line.

 

What Do I Need to Bring?

  • Clothes you can comfortably swim, bike, and run in
  • Goggles
  • Running shoes

Optional:

  • Swim cap
  • Cycling shoes (SPD cleat)

 

USAT Sanctioned Event

This race is sanctioned by USA Triathlon, which means all participants must have a current USAT membership. If you don’t already have one, you will be prompted to purchase it during registration process.

Each segment is designed to be manageable for all ability levels. No specialized gear or prior triathlon experience required.

Why Race With Us?

  • Friendly, inclusive environment
  • Great way to try a new sport
  • Meet UO student-athletes and local community members
  • Boost confidence and fitness
  • Celebrate crossing a finish line—maybe your first!

Come Tri!
Bring your energy, your curiosity, and maybe a friend or two. Whether this is your first race ever or simply a fun way to stay active, we can’t wait to see you at the Rec Center starting line.

 

What Do I Need to Bring?

  • Clothes you can comfortably swim, bike, and run in
  • Goggles
  • Running shoes

Optional:

  • Swim cap
  • Cycling shoes (SPD cleat)

 

USAT Sanctioned Event

This race is sanctioned by USA Triathlon, which means all participants must have a current USAT membership. If you don’t already have one, you will be prompted to purchase it during registration process.

name: USARA Adventure Race National Championships
description:
For more than 25 years, the annual USARA Adventure Race National Championships have seen some of the best teams from across the nation come together to compete in a non-stop, 30-hour adventure race. Many of these teams have to push the boundaries of human endurance and teamwork just to finish. Winning requires extreme willpower, mastery across disciplines, and sometime a little luck. 

When the race ends, teams come together for an evening meal. We announce the national champions, crown the winners of the national points series, and celebrate the amazing adventure racing community. 

The 2026 race is limited to teams of four in three divisions:  mixed gender, all-women, all-men.  There is not a separate masters division, though the top masters team from across all divisions will be recognized.

Race check-in will be Thursday, October 22, 2026. The 30-hour race will start Friday morning, October 23, 2026, and end Saturday afternoon, October 24, 2026.

Priority registration opens January 1, 2026. Eligible teams will receive a link by email. Open registration begins February 1, 2026. You can find the most up-to-date information on the event at the USARA website.

REFUND POLICY:

The RunSignUp processing fee will be deducted from any and all refunds.  A racer who withdraws within one week of registering will receive a full refund, less processing fees.  A racer who withdraws more than one week after registering will receive a refund pursuant to the following scale: 


Before 6/1/26:  Entry fee less $50 and RSU processing fee
From 6/1/26 through 7/31/26:  Entry fee less $100 and RSU processing fee
From 8/1/26 through 8/31/25:  Entry fee less $200 and RSU processing fee 
From and after 9/1/26:  No refund


A racer can transfer their entry to another racer at no charge.  Contact nationals@usara.com to request a refund or transfer of entry.

name: 105th Statuto Race
description:
Running strong for 100 years!
The Statuto Race commemorates the creation of the first Italian Constitution (Statuto Albertino) and is a running tradition in San Francisco going back more than 100 years. Join us in 2025 for the 105th running of this iconic race!

Celebrate post-race with brunch!
Following the race, join us for brunch in the SFIAC Ballroom! Runners/walkers and guests welcome. $43.40 per adult. Kids 5-18 years are $22.20 per person (no charge for kids under age 5). You can purchase brunch tickets during registration or on the Store page in the menu bar above. NOTE: For 2026 the bottomless mimosa portion will not be offered, but a cash bar will be available.

First Responders Cup!
This is an opportunity to bring the Italian community together with the City and County of San Francisco's Public Safety & First Responder families while enjoying a little friendly competition. A trophy will be awarded to the first place First Responders finisher. First responders in agencies outside of SF are welcome to participate and should contact us at statutorace@sfiacfoundation.org to be added to the list of teams.

Awards!
• For the 8K run, trophies will be awarded to the first overall male runner, first overall female runner, the first overall SFIAC dues-paying club member, and first overall first responder.
• For the 8K run, medals will be awarded to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd place in the following age groups (male and female divisions): 19 and under, 20 - 29, 30 - 39, 40 - 49, 50 - 59, 60 - 64, 65 - 69, 70 - 74, 75-79, 80-84, 85-90.

name: 10th Antioch Rotary Club Bunny Hop 5K a.k.a. Antioch Rotary BunnyHop "X"
description:
2025 Results!

Please join the Antioch Rotary Bunny Hop 5K on April 19, 2025 (The day before Easter).

Here we go Hopping again!!!

It's Summertime so the Easter Bunny is on vacation! Next year we invite participants to run like the Hare or pace yourself steady to victory like the Tortoise. Participants will get a Finisher's Medal and are guaranteed a Bunny Hop T-Shirt if you register before Saturday, March 14, 2026.  Registration will open in October, 2025. If you like to be part of community video please  email your picture to rdeloso@yahoo.com.  Like us and see up to date notices on Facebook @AntiochBunnyHop5K

Important Notes:

(1) Packet Pick up will be at Fleet Feet Sports in Brentwood on Friday, April 3rd from 3-7pm. There will also be same-day Packet Pick-up on Saturday, April 4th from 7:15 - 8:25 a.m. Beat the confusion & crowds on Saturday by passing by Fleet Feet Sports on Friday!

(2) This 5K Fun Run is a timed event. Accurate timing is provided by the E-Tag attached on the back of your Race Bib - your time starts when you cross the Start Line Sensor and you finish when you cross the Finish Line Sensor. Race Timing will be provided by Ford Timing. 

All Finishers will receive a BunnyHop 5K Medal. First Place Overall in Men's & Women's will receive a plaque, and a Gift Card. 

Age Group Medals will go to the Top 3 in each of these Age Groups: 9 and under,
10-14, 15-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, & 70 and up.

AWARDS CEREMONY will take place after the KIDS KWIK DASH & EASTER EGG HUNT approximately 11:10am

(3) The 5K Course is entirely within Corteva Wetlands Preserve and the surface is mostly gravel and grass paths. Because of this we do not recommend bringing strollers or wagons unless you are prepared to carry these over some barriers and over the uneven terrain.

(4) We love our furry friends too, but we do not advise that you bring dogs to this fun run for safety reasons.

(5) The Bunny Hop Start Line is about 3/4 mile from the Antioch Marina Festival/Parking Area - please plan on a 20–30-minute nature walk! Plan on arriving at the Antioch Marina by 8:00 a.m. - there will be plenty of Parking and Porta Potties. Start Time will be approximately 9:00am

(6) This Race will happen Rain or Shine! 

(7) For Runners of Antioch Unified School District - please arrive at the Antioch Marina by 7:30am to pick up your Race Bibs and GoodyBags - There will be a special area for AUSD-sponsored Runners.

(8) Because of the size of the Event, we will not have a "Bag Drop"

(9) The KIDS KWIK DASH will take place at the Antioch Marina Parking Lot at approximately 10:30am

(10) The Easter Egg Hunt will follow the Kids Kwik Dash

The Rotary Club of Antioch is a non-profit volunteer civic organization servicing the local community for over 75 years. Some of the projects include Girls Empowerment Project, Boys King Conference, Community Beautification, and Assisting Seniors in the Community with home repairs.  The Bunny Hop 5k proceeds will directly go toward scholarships at the local high schools. If you would like to learn more about the Rotary Club of Antioch please visit www.antiochrotary.net

name: 13th Annual Luc's Run
description:
Luc's Run is held annually each spring in historic Tuolumne, California and Virtually Anywhere in the World. Luc's Run is known as one of the premier races in the county.  We are looking at welcoming our local 10K, 2-mile, and Kids Run (ages 10 & under) back to Tuolumne, CA in 2023! And of course welcoming our supporters around the globe through our virtual run where hundreds of enthusiasts from around the world walk and run in support of Luc’s legacy on their own turf with a virtual 1/2 marathon, 10K, 2-mile, and Kids Run (ages 10 & under). Sign up for two events and save 5%, sign up for all three and save 15%! 

On January 28, 2013, Luc, a United States Air Force pilot was on a training mission over the Adriatic Sea off the coast of Italy. During the sortie, Luc was forced to eject from his F-16 and did not survive the ejection.  Luc is survived by family and friends who continue his Legacy through the Major Lucas Gruenther Legacy Foundation.

Major Lucas Gruenther was an incredible human being.  He was an outstanding F-16 fighter pilot, community role model, and a true humanitarian.  He lived his life to the fullest and never took a single day for granted.  Luc is remembered for the way he treated people with wisdom and kindness and was a genuine human being who made a tremendous positive impact.

All proceeds from this race go to the Major Lucas Gruenther Legacy Foundation, an IRS-approved 501(c)(3) non-profit organization.  The purpose of the Major Lucas Gruenther Legacy Foundation is to bestow scholarships to Americans for the advancement of educational goals and self development.

And of course welcoming our supporters around the globe through our virtual run where hundreds of enthusiasts from around the world walk and run in support of Luc’s legacy on their own turf with a virtual 1/2 marathon, 10K, 2-mile, and Kids Run (ages 10 & under). Sign up for two events and save 5%, sign up for all three and save 15%! 

On January 28, 2013, Luc, a United States Air Force pilot was on a training mission over the Adriatic Sea off the coast of Italy. During the sortie, Luc was forced to eject from his F-16 and did not survive the ejection.  Luc is survived by family and friends who continue his Legacy through the Major Lucas Gruenther Legacy Foundation.

Major Lucas Gruenther was an incredible human being.  He was an outstanding F-16 fighter pilot, community role model, and a true humanitarian.  He lived his life to the fullest and never took a single day for granted.  Luc is remembered for the way he treated people with wisdom and kindness and was a genuine human being who made a tremendous positive impact.

All proceeds from this race go to the Major Lucas Gruenther Legacy Foundation, an IRS-approved 501(c)(3) non-profit organization.  The purpose of the Major Lucas Gruenther Legacy Foundation is to bestow scholarships to Americans for the advancement of educational goals and self development.

name: 16th Annual BEACHFRONT RUN
description:
Hello Runners & Walkers!

We’re excited to invite you to City Impact's 16th Annual Beachfront Run on Saturday, May 30, 2026, at the beautiful Ventura Promenade.

Enjoy a race course with stunning views of Ventura’s coastline while participating in one of our exciting race options: Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, or the Kids 1K Run. The event will also feature a variety of vendors, lively music, and a festive awards ceremony.

Each participant will receive a custom event shirt and a finisher’s medal. Please note that if you register after March 15th, 2026, we cannot guarantee your preferred shirt size.

Awards will be given to the top 3 finishers in each 10-year age category (10-19, 20-29, etc.), so everyone has a chance to shine!  Whether you’re racing or cheering, this is a perfect event for friends, family, and colleagues to come together and enjoy the day.

All proceeds from the event will benefit City Impact’s programs supporting at-promise youth and families. Your participation makes a difference, and we thank you for your support!        


If you should have any questions, please email info@cityimpact.com or call 805.983.3636 x105.    

Much appreciation,


Vickie Saipale
Development/Event Manager

name: 16th Annual Mardi Gras Madness 5K/10K!
description:
About the Event

Join us on Sunday, March 1, 2026, as the Junior Chamber International of Santa Clarita (JCI) and the Santa Clarita Track Club proudly present the 16th Annual Mardi Gras Madness 5K/10K and Mini Madness 1K — benefiting JCI Santa Clarita and Students Off And Running (SOAR).

SOAR provides local youth ages 14–18 with a fully supported Los Angeles Marathon training experience — completely free for participants and their families — and is an Official Featured Charity of the 2026 Los Angeles Marathon.

What to Expect

Mardi Gras Madness is Santa Clarita’s premier family-friendly run/walk event, offering fun and fitness for all ages! Participants will enjoy a scenic USATF-certified 5K/10K course, chip timing, custom finisher medals, marathon-quality tech shirts, and a vibrant Health & Fitness Expo.

The festivities continue with a beer garden, great food, costume contest, games and giveaways, silent auction, celebrity hosts, and live entertainment. Whether you’re a seasoned runner, a stroller-pusher, or bringing your furry friend, Mardi Gras Madness welcomes everyone!

 
🏃‍♀️ COURSE INFORMATION
The MGM course is a USATF-certified, rolling 5K/10K circuit featuring scenic paseos, bridge overpasses, and sections along the beautiful South Fork River Trail.

Note: The 10K route includes a dirt equestrian trail from Mile 3.25 to Mile 4.85.
 
🎟 EARLY PACKET PICKUP
Skip the lines and pick up your race materials early!

📍 Saturday, February 28 | 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Location: Canyon Club Courtyard (rear entrance near H&M), Valencia Town Center

Please bring a valid ID to receive your 2026 - 8 One 8 Beer Garden wristband. No exceptions.

Due to overwhelming demand, onsite registration cannot be guaranteed this year.
 
🕗 RACE DAY SCHEDULE

6:30 – 8:00 AM - Check-In and Pre-Registration
7:25 AM - 1K Warm-Up
7:30 AM - 1K Start
7:55 AM - 5K/10K Warm-Up
8:00 AM - 5K/10K Start
9:30 AM - Awards Ceremony & Prize Drawings
 
🏅 AWARDS
Top 3 Overall Men & Women (5K & 10K)
Top 3 per Age Group:

  • 10 & Under
  • 11–14
  • 15–18
  • 19–29
  • 30–39
  • 40–49
  • 50–59
  • 60+
  • Top 3 Team Finishes
  • All 5K/10K finishers receive a custom medal, t-shirt, and goodie bag!

 
📍 EVENT DETAILS
Date: Sunday, March 1, 2026
Time: 7:00 AM – 12:00 PM
Location: Valencia Town Center, Valencia, CA 91355

name: 2026 Avenue of the Giants Marathon
description: The Avenue of the Giants is one of the most beautiful races in the world!  It runs through old growth redwoods and follows a natural creek in the middle of a state park.  Staged on "The Avenue of the Giants" in Humboldt Redwoods State Park, located in rural Northern California. Course is on a paved road that winds gently up hill but is mostly a flat, fast destination race.  With little to distract you, the tall trees inspire the athlete in each of us to be strong.  The course is certified and the marathon is a Boston Qualifying event.

name: 2026 Cal Tri Castaic Lake - 6.20.26
description:
2026 Cal Tri Castaic Lake - 6.20.25

18 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run), 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run) and 6 Youth Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

CASTAIC LAKE. 
The 35th annual Castaic Lake Triathlon takes place at scenic Castaic Lake just 20 miles north of Los Angeles. The Castaic Lake Recreation Area, located just north of Santa Clarita, is an 11,200-acre multi-use facility with two lakes, boating, world class fishing, hiking, walking, horseback riding, wake boarding, jet-skiing, camping, picnicking, kayaking, and sailing.  August is a great time to enjoy the water in the high 60s, and a staging area aptly named Paradise Cove. "Tri-cation" Friday night camping available through Castaic Lake.


THE COURSE. 
The swim course is a modified V shape in Paradise Cove at Castaic Lake, with 8 lifeguards in the water on paddleboards.  The bike course then goes out on back roads to limit your interaction with cars.  The bike course does include some U-turns on back roads to allow this, so athletes should slow down at the turn around points.  The run is primarily on the rolling trails overlooking Castaic Lake. 

WHO WE SUPPORT
All proceeds will benefit the Canyon High School Cross Country and Track Teams (we've been doing this for 33 years to support our programs).  

This is a great triathlon for new triathletes.  For years our coaches and athletes have encouraged new triathletes (young and old), and created a welcoming atmosphere of support.  We offer an enjoyable experience for triathletes of all experience levels.  


AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG).
Mid June temperatures are often cooler in the morning, with early morning fog burning off to reach the mid 80s.  Our event will possibly be around 60 degrees.

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 

Water temps in June typically range in the mid to high 60s.  Email updates will be sent out closer to the race with updates. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2026 Cayucos Turkey Trot
description:
Thanksgiving Day Family 5k Fun Run / Walk

Check-in and bib pick-up will start Wednesday, November 25th at the Cayucos Pier from 2-4pm.  Each registered participant will have an assigned bib number and Thanksgiving-themed running socks, while supplies last.

On race day, check-in will begin at 7:15am.  We are set to start at 8:30am so be sure to give yourself enough time.  Dogs, strollers, and kiddos on scooters are all welcome.  

All proceeds will equally benefit Cayucos Elementary School and the California Association of Highway Patrolman Widows & Orphans' Trust Fund.

Thank you for your incredible support, and we can’t wait to see on race day!

name: 2026 CHALLENGE
description:
🏁 2026 Challenge: Run, Walk & Bike 2,026 Miles in 2026! 🏁

 
Starts January 1, 2026 - Embark on an EPIC year-long fitness journey! Whether you choose to complete this SOLO or TEAM up with friends, the goal is to cover 2,026 miles between January 1 and December 31, 2026
 
🧍‍♀️ Solo Challenger
Take on the full 2,026 miles on your own. Every mile you run, walk, or bike counts toward your personal achievement.

 

👥 Team Challenger
Form a team of 2+ participants and divide the 2,026 miles in any way you choose. Each team member will receive their own Finisher's Medal and Race Shirt in the mail!

 

Registration Includes:
  • Finisher's Medal: Celebrate your achievement with a BADASS medal!
  • 2026 Challenge Shirt or Tank Top: Buttery-soft apparel to showcase your accomplishment.
  • Official "2,026 Miles" Sticker: Display your commitment proudly.
  • RaceJoy App: Sync your activities and track progress on the live leaderboard.

name: 2026 CVC San Diego Triathlon and San Diego Tri Series 5K
description:
Mark your calendars for event #2 of the San Diego Triathlon Series & the Triple Crown of Triathlon
📅 Sunday, August 16, 2026
📍 Chula Vista, CA – San Diego Bayfront

This Year, We are Back to the Fantastic ONE PARK Venue! Start / Transition/ Finish line/ and Beer Garden all in one place! See the beutiful new landscape and the Gaylord Hotel

Dive into one of San Diego’s most exciting and scenic multisport races of the summer! The CVC San Diego Triathlon & 5K is Event #2 in the prestigious San Diego Triathlon Series and part of the coveted Triple Crown of Triathlon. Whether you're a first-timer or a seasoned competitor, there’s a race here for everyone. 🌊☀️

Set against the calm, warm waters of San Diego Bay, this athlete-friendly race offers flat, fast courses, great for achieving your personal best—and even better for enjoying the beautiful coastal views while you’re at it. After your race, celebrate with friends and family in our on-the-water 🍺Seek Beer Co. - Beer & 🍸Margarita Garden and soak in those post-race vibes!

Race Options
INTERNATIONAL TRIATHLON
1,000 M swim - 38 K (23.3 mi) bike - 10K (6.2 mi) run 
Ages 16 & over

SPRINT TRIATHLON
500 M swim – 19K (11.6 mi) bike – 5K (3.1 mi) run 
Ages 13 & over

SPRINT RELAY
500 M swim - 19K (11.6 mi) bike - 5k run 
Ages 13 & over
SPRINT DUATHLON
1 mile run - 19K (11.6 mi) bike - 5k run 
Ages 13 & over

SPRINT AQUABIKE
500 M swim - 19K (11.6 mi) bike
Ages 13 & over

MINI TRIATHLON
200 M swim – 9K (5.8 mi) bike – 2.4K (1.5 mi) run
Ages 11 & over

ITSY BITSY TRIATHLON
100 M swim – 4K (2.3 mi) bike – 1.2K (.75 mi) run
Kids 7-10

SD Tri Series - Chula Vista 5K (3.1 mi) run

name: 2026 Disneyland® Half Marathon Weekend presented by HONDA
description:
In 2026, runDisney® is going to “Celebrate Happy” during the Disneyland® Half Marathon Weekend presented by HONDA, January 29–February 1. Happening amid the 70th anniversary of the Disneyland® Resort, this race weekend will be centered around some of the different ways to celebrate what delights us most. So come enjoy miles of smiles during a 5K hosted by Joy from Disney and Pixar’s Inside Out. Join Sorcerer’s Apprentice Mickey in an imaginative 10K. Run together with a friend as part of an “it’s a small world®” attraction-themed half marathon. And, for the ultimate achievement, take on the Dumbo Double Dare challenge made up of both the 10K and the half marathon. There are even Kids’ Races hosted by Stitch and morning yoga with Miss Piggy. As always, magic and one-of-a-kind medals are included.

 

Participants must attend the runDisney Health & Fitness Expo at least one day prior to their first event to pick up their race bib, participant shirt and pre-purchased merchandise. The Expo takes place Thursday, January 29 – Saturday, January 31.

name: 2026 Greater Sacramento Area Polar Plunge & Runs
description:
THE POLAR PLUNGE
Ready to brave the waters for Special Olympics Northern California? Join the Greater Sacramento Area Polar Plunge & Runs, a fun dip, skip or jump into the Bay for a great cause!  Don’t want to get wet? Register as a chicken and you'll be excused from plunging but still qualify for the incentive rewards and other festivities. 
 
THE RUN/WALK
In conjunction with the Polar Plunge, running enthusiasts can enjoy a scenic 5K timed trail run before the Plunge. Awards presented to the top 3 runners in each age category.  Those not ready for a 5K can participate in the One Mile Fun Run/Walk

name: 2026 Humboldt Redwoods Marathon, Half Marathon, 5K
description:
We'll forgive you if you have trouble concentrating on the road ahead of you while running The Humboldt Redwoods Marathon, half or 5K. After all, you'll probably be looking up at the old-growth redwood trees which tower over the course! This race is in Humboldt Redwoods State Park and the Half Marathon follows the second half of the iconic Avenue of the Giants Marathon course.

All courses are USATF Certified. The Marathon is a Boston qualifier. The race starts and finishes at the Dyerville Bridge.

name: 2026 Lake Chabot Trail Challenge (Half Marathon & 5K)
description:
“Beginning July 1, 2024, the “Honest Pricing Law” or “Hidden Fees Statute,” SB 478, makes it illegal for businesses to advertise or list a price for a good or service that does not include all required fees or charges other than certain government taxes and shipping costs.”

RACE INFO: We are so excited to celebrate the 42nd annual Lake Chabot Trail Challenge Half Marathon and 5K. This race is well regarded amongst serious trail runners in the outlying areas. The race begins at 8am for the Half Marathon and 8:30am for the 5K. Please arrive early so that you may find parking, pick up your bibs, use restrooms facilities, and be properly prepared to race before the start. Race takes place rain or shine and there are no refunds.

RACE COURSE: The half marathon course is a scenic, hilly loop, mainly on dirt fire roads.  The ridge-line views look down upon scenic Lake Chabot, surrounding grassy slopes, and eucalyptus groves.  Mt. Diablo and San Francisco Bay are visible along the route. There are water stations with first aid and radio support; we recommend bringing your own hydration as well.  The half marathon has a time limit of 3.5 hours. The 5k (3.1 miles) course is an out and back that has gentle rolling hills and consists mostly of paved surfaces.  This route includes one water station with first aid and radio support.

RACE FEE: Pre-registered runners will be guaranteed a t-shirt if registered by Sunday, May 10th, 2026.  The price for the 5K is $40 and Half Marathon $65. You must register by Saturday, June 6th. We will accept race day registration; however, the price for the 5K is $45 and Half Marathon $70. If you register on race day, we can only accept cash, check or Venmo.

There is a nominal fee (~$5) for Chabot parking lot. Free parking on Lake Chabot Rd and nearby streets.

RACE PACKET & BIB PICK-UP:  We will have race packet and bib pick-up on Sunday, June 7th starting at 7am at the Willow picnic site which is also the finish line area. We will not be mailing out any race packets or bibs. Both races are chip-timed.

T-SHIRT: Entry fee includes short sleeve, high quality t-shirts for registrations by May 10th so sign-up early.  There are no guarantee of t-shirts for runners registered after that date and on race day. We ask for those who did not get a shirt to check in after the race. Please ensure that you select the appropriate t-shirt size. We will not be doing any size exchanges from your original request.

AWARDS: Finisher's medals to those who complete their race.  Age division medals given to the top 3 in each of 12 age divisions in the half marathon and 9 age divisions in the 5K.

Photos:  Race photos are being provided by Darrell Lavin of Darrell Lavin Photography. You will receive an email post-race for instructions on how to access and purchase official race photos.

QUESTIONS: If you have any questions, please contact Rachel Lunt at teamlunt07@gmail.com.

DIRECTIONS: The entrance closest to the event's parking lot is: 17404 Lake Chabot Road, Castro Valley, CA 94546.  On Google Maps, this will appear as "Entry of Lake Chabot Parking Space."  The registration area and start lines are just a few minutes walk from the lot ( just follow the signs).

name: 2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.1.26
description:
2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.1.26. Started in 1978 as the Human Race Triathlon, Cal Tri Newport Dunes is the longest running triathlon in the world operating from the same location. Also started in 1978 was the Ironman World Championship Triathlon Oahu but it moved to Kailua-Kona, Hawaii in 1981. This serves as the Cal Tri Events National Championship Race with registration in the 1500-2000 range.

12 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run) and 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon,  RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

TO DO. Disneyland Park & California Adventure Park. Balboa Island Ferry. Newport Beach.

AIRPORT. John Wayne (SNA)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 60 F / 73 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 65 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2026 PRE-SALE Ride Santa Barbara 100
description:
Ride Santa Barbara returns for its 15th year!

RideSB100 offers four distinct courses to suit a range of cycling abilities – each course offering a world-class Santa Barbara cycling experience! 🚵🏻‍♂️

All courses start along the beach and follow the beautiful Santa Barbara beachfront before turning inland to experience all Santa Barbara has to offer. Cyclists will wind through some of the most exclusive neighborhoods in the country; experience the rolling foothills lined with citrus and avocado orchards and climb some of the most famous mountains in the country, all while experiencing some of the most beautiful views in southern California.

 

All cyclists will receive:

  • Official 2026 RideSB100 t-shirt
  • Official 2026 RideSB100 water bottle
  • Official RideSB100 musette bag with sponsor goodies
  • Fully supported aid stations
  • Mechanical support
  • Finish Line Festival with lots of food and beer
  • All Gibraltar Challenge finishers will receive a coin at the top of the hill.
  • Age group medals for Gibraltar Challenge
  • Option to buy event Jersey $105
  • And more!

All riders will receive an overall chip time and riders who participate in the Gibraltar Challenge will be ranked for the King and Queen of the Mountain (KOM/QOM) Jersey awards! 

 

RIDES*

 

100 mile

  • Over 9,400′ of climbing | Start Time: 7:00 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Tackle a challenging ride that begins at Chase Palm Park, rolls through Carpinteria, and continues into the scenic Lake Casitas region. Climb Toro Canyon and Ladera Lane before testing your legs on the Gibraltar Climb Challenge, a timed 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and over 2,500 ft of elevation gain. Descend, then join the 100KM Coastal Route along Cathedral Oaks through Isla Vista and past UCSB, finishing back at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100-mile/


100 KM + Climb 

  • Over 7,400 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s most stunning terrain, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Tackle the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and the steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then test your mettle on the Gibraltar Climb: a 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and a 2,551 ft elevation gain. After summiting Gibraltar, descend via the technical Painted Cave route, continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community, and return to a well-earned finish at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-climb/

 

100 KM Coastal Route 

  • 3,900 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for intermediate to experienced cyclists only
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s finest scenery, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Challenge yourself on the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then descend toward the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. From there, ride west through Isla Vista, take in breathtaking coastal views at Goleta Beach, pass the University of California, Santa Barbara, and finish back at Chase Palm Park.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-coastal/

 

34 miles 

  • Over 2,200 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 8:30 AM
  • Beginner to intermediate level cyclists 
  • Enjoy a stunning start along the coastline from Chase Palm Park before heading inland to San Ysidro Road. Tackle a gentle ascent on Mountain Drive (max 5.1% grade), then roll past the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. Continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community and finish back at Chase Palm Park. Perfect for those seeking Santa Barbara’s natural charm with just the right amount of challenge.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/34-mile/

*Event details and courses are subject to change. 

 

Charity

Ride to benefit MOVE Santa Barbara County! Help us raise needed donations and awareness for the great work they’re doing in Santa Barbara County. The mission of MOVE is to advocate for equitable county-wide infrastructure for walking, bicycling, and public transit and to empower and educate communities to choose active and sustainable forms of transportation. 

 

Refund Policy

All entry fees are NON-REFUNDABLE, no exceptions. Once we receive and accept your entry, you will not receive a refund if you cannot participate. You may do a one-time entry transfer to another event, person or year for $15.

For more information, visit our website ridesb100.com or e-mail our team at info@ridesb100.com.

 

Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter! 

Subscribe to our e-newsletter! 📧

name: 2026 PRE-SALE Thrive San Diego Half Marathon & 5K
description:
The Kaiser Permanente Thrive Half Marathon & 5K returns for its 10th year!

We’re excited to THRIVE with you on Saturday, November 7, 2026! More than just a race, it’s an invitation for the entire San Diego community to “Thrive” together—staying active, eating healthy, living well, and giving back. All courses start and finish at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, offering fast, flat stretches with beautiful Mission Bay views and refreshing ocean breezes.

 
Half Marathon: 
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Experience 13.1 miles of scenic San Diego beauty on a loop course that starts on Ingraham Street, winds along Mission Bay, and finishes at Ski Beach. Enjoy fast, flat stretches, picturesque bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes as you chase your personal best.
  • Go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon/ for more information.

 

Half Marathon Relay:
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Take on the Half Marathon Relay with a partner and split the challenge of 13.1 miles! Each runner will cover approximately 6.5 miles before handing off the "baton" to your teammate at Telecote Shores. This scenic route along Crown Point starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, featuring fast, flat stretches, breathtaking bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon-relay/.
 
5K:
  • Start Time: 7:30AM
  • The 5K is a scenic loop route along Crown Point that starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/5k/.
 
Entry Includes:
  • Exclusive Performance Tech Long Sleeve (Half Marathon & Half Marathon Relay) 
  • Official Thrive Short Sleeve Tech Tee (5K)
  • Racer Bib
  • Finisher Medal Unique to Each Distance
  • Chip Race Timing
  • Live Finish Results and Rankings
  • Award Winner Prizes
  • Overall & Age Group Awards
  • Access to Thrive Expo
 

Virtual Runners:
  • For runners who can’t make it to San Diego but still want to participate and benefit Make-A-Wish San Diego! Complete your distance anytime during race week and post your results to the virtual leaderboard.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/virtual-runners/

 

Charity:

Run to benefit Make-A-Wish® San Diego! Join us in granting wishes for children diagnosed with critical illnesses. Donate today to show your support for Make-A-Wish® San Diego on Race Day.

 

For more information on Make-A-Wish San Diego, visit thrivehalfmarathon.com/charity/.

All courses start and finish at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, offering fast, flat stretches with beautiful Mission Bay views and refreshing ocean breezes.

 
Half Marathon: 
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Experience 13.1 miles of scenic San Diego beauty on a loop course that starts on Ingraham Street, winds along Mission Bay, and finishes at Ski Beach. Enjoy fast, flat stretches, picturesque bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes as you chase your personal best.
  • Go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon/ for more information.

 

Half Marathon Relay:
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Take on the Half Marathon Relay with a partner and split the challenge of 13.1 miles! Each runner will cover approximately 6.5 miles before handing off the "baton" to your teammate at Telecote Shores. This scenic route along Crown Point starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, featuring fast, flat stretches, breathtaking bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon-relay/.
 
5K:
  • Start Time: 7:30AM
  • The 5K is a scenic loop route along Crown Point that starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/5k/.
 
Entry Includes:
  • Exclusive Performance Tech Long Sleeve (Half Marathon & Half Marathon Relay) 
  • Official Thrive Short Sleeve Tech Tee (5K)
  • Racer Bib
  • Finisher Medal Unique to Each Distance
  • Chip Race Timing
  • Live Finish Results and Rankings
  • Award Winner Prizes
  • Overall & Age Group Awards
  • Access to Thrive Expo
 

Virtual Runners:
  • For runners who can’t make it to San Diego but still want to participate and benefit Make-A-Wish San Diego! Complete your distance anytime during race week and post your results to the virtual leaderboard.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/virtual-runners/

 

Charity:

Run to benefit Make-A-Wish® San Diego! Join us in granting wishes for children diagnosed with critical illnesses. Donate today to show your support for Make-A-Wish® San Diego on Race Day.

 

For more information on Make-A-Wish San Diego, visit thrivehalfmarathon.com/charity/.

name: 2026 Silver Strand Half Marathon, 10 Miler, 12K & 5K
description:
🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️ Picture this: A heart-pounding, flat-out run along the closed Silver Strand Highway 79, with the majestic Pacific Ocean on your right and the stunning San Diego Bay on your left. 🌊

But hold onto your running shoes because it's not just a race – it's a BLAST! 🎉 As you tackle the half marathon, 12K, or 10-mile courses, you'll groove to the rhythm of the Taku Drummers, jam to the hottest beats spun by a DJ, and soak in live music that'll have you moving to the groove. 🥁🎵

And when you cross that epic finish line, your jaw will drop! 🏖️🌅 You'll find yourself right on the state beach, toes in the sand, and the ocean's gentle waves washing over the shore. But wait, there's more – get ready for the ultimate California Beach Party, featuring a live band and a buzzing beer garden! 🍻🎸

All of this unfolds as you conquer the iconic "Silver Strand" route from Coronado to Imperial Beach. 🌴

And just a stone's throw away is Coronado Island, seamlessly connected to downtown San Diego by a charming bridge. 🌉

But that's not all – when you participate, you're making a difference. Your involvement supports important causes: the Life Sports Foundation, Team Hoyt, and Islander Sports Foundation.

So, what's stopping you? Join us for the San Diego Half Marathon, 12K, 8 Miler, or 5K and prepare for a race day like no other! 🏆👟

Oh, and here's a little something extra – Special Discounted Pricing for All Branches of Our USA Military enlisted and Veterans (proof of Military ID required at Packet Pick-up). And let's not forget our first responders – Special Discounted Pricing for Police, Fire, FBI, and Border Patrol with valid ID.

Get ready to run, dance, and celebrate – this is going to be LEGENDARY! 🙌 #SilverStrandHalfMarathon"

All races will finish at Silver Strand State Beach. Please be sure to visit our Parking & Buses page to see parking options.

But hold onto your running shoes because it's not just a race – it's a BLAST! 🎉 As you tackle the half marathon, 12K, or 10-mile courses, you'll groove to the rhythm of the Taku Drummers, jam to the hottest beats spun by a DJ, and soak in live music that'll have you moving to the groove. 🥁🎵

And when you cross that epic finish line, your jaw will drop! 🏖️🌅 You'll find yourself right on the state beach, toes in the sand, and the ocean's gentle waves washing over the shore. But wait, there's more – get ready for the ultimate California Beach Party, featuring a live band and a buzzing beer garden! 🍻🎸

All of this unfolds as you conquer the iconic "Silver Strand" route from Coronado to Imperial Beach. 🌴

And just a stone's throw away is Coronado Island, seamlessly connected to downtown San Diego by a charming bridge. 🌉

But that's not all – when you participate, you're making a difference. Your involvement supports important causes: the Life Sports Foundation, Team Hoyt, and Islander Sports Foundation.

So, what's stopping you? Join us for the San Diego Half Marathon, 12K, 8 Miler, or 5K and prepare for a race day like no other! 🏆👟

Oh, and here's a little something extra – Special Discounted Pricing for All Branches of Our USA Military enlisted and Veterans (proof of Military ID required at Packet Pick-up). And let's not forget our first responders – Special Discounted Pricing for Police, Fire, FBI, and Border Patrol with valid ID.

Get ready to run, dance, and celebrate – this is going to be LEGENDARY! 🙌 #SilverStrandHalfMarathon"

All races will finish at Silver Strand State Beach. Please be sure to visit our Parking & Buses page to see parking options.

name: 2026 Solana Beach Triathlon & Duathlon and Solana Beach 5K
description:
Mark your calendar for July 26, 2026, and get ready for an unforgettable day of racing along the beautiful Solana Beach coastline. Whether you’re a first-time triathlete or a seasoned racer, this event has it all—an exhilarating ocean swim, a scenic bike ride, and a thrilling coastal run to the finish line.


Why You Should Join:
Prime Beach Location: Race in one of Southern California’s most picturesque beach towns
All Levels Welcome: From first-timers to pros, this triathlon is designed for everyone
Exclusive Finisher Medal & Swag: Walk away with a fantastic tech tee and a finisher’s medal
Support a Cause: This race benefits the Life Sports Foundation, helping foster children and at-risk youth live healthier lives through sports and fitness

Sprint Triathlon
1/4 mile swim - 9 mile bike - 5K run

Sprint Duathlon
1 mile run - 9 mile bike - 5K run

Sprint Aquabike
1/4 mile swim - 9 mile bike

Sprint Aquathlon
1/4 mile swim - 5K run

Solana Beach 5K

🏊 Ocean Swim with a Twist: Dive into the excitement with our surf-entry ocean swim. Safeguarded by dedicated lifeguards and supportive swim buddies, you'll experience the thrill of the Pacific in a safe and encouraging environment.

🚴 Cycle the Legendary Pacific Coast Highway: Pedal your way along the world-famous Pacific Coast Highway. With its breathtaking views and smooth terrain, the bike course promises both challenge and charm, perfect for setting personal records or simply enjoying the ride.
 
🏃 Run with the Ocean Breeze

🎉 A Finish Line Like No Other: As you cross the finish line, be prepared for a tunnel of high-fives, a cascade of cheers, and an atmosphere brimming with excitement. This is more than just the end of the race; it's a moment of triumph, a celebration of your achievement. Come Celebrate in the 🍺 Seek Beer Co Beer Garden!

Whether you're a seasoned triathlete, a duathlon enthusiast, or an aquabike aficionado, the Solana Beach event is tailored to offer a memorable experience. Embrace the challenge, bask in the coastal splendor, and make memories that will last a lifetime.

Join us for an event that’s more than a race — it's a coastal festival of sport, spirit, and community. Register now to be a part of this unforgettable adventure! 🌟

name: 2026 XTERRA WETSUITS Mission Bay Triathlon & San Diego 5K
description:
Mark your calendars for event #3 of the San Diego Triathlon Series & the Triple Crown of Triathlon
📅 Sunday, October 11, 2026
📍 San Diego, CA – Mission Bay

Proud Host of the 2026 USAT State Championships 🏆
The XTERRA WETSUITS Mission Bay Triathlon is proud to once again host the 2026 USA Triathlon State Championships — featuring Age Group, High School, and Club Championships!

Olympic Distance / Sprint Distance / Duathlon / Aquabike / Aquathlon

What This Means for Racers:
🥇 State Champion Titles
Compete for the honor of being crowned California State Champion in your triathlon division (Sprint or International), as well as in High School and Club categories. Olympic Distance / Sprint Distance 
🎽 Coveted State Champion Jersey
1st place winners in each age group, high school, and special category earn the exclusive right to purchase and wear the official California State Championship jersey.
🚩 Club State Championships
All State Championships also serve as the Club State Championships. Clubs (age group & high school) can earn the designation of Top Club in California and win a Club State Champion banner from USA Triathlon.

🎟️ Qualification for Nationals

Sprint Triathlon → Qualifies you for Sprint Nationals
International Triathlon → Qualifies you for Olympic-Distance Nationals
Top 35% of finishers or top 5 athletes (whichever is greater) qualify.
State Championships after June 1, 2026, qualify athletes for both 2026 AND 2027 Nationals.

🎓 High School Championships

Eligibility: Any student currently enrolled in high school and up to six (6) months post-graduation.
Exemption: All athletes who finish a State High School Championship race will automatically qualify for Sprint Nationals, provided they are age 15 or older by December 31, 2026.
🌍 Open to all athletes — residency in California is not required.

Why Race Mission Bay?
Race in San Diego’s iconic Mission Bay, claim your place on the podium, and showcase your achievement in the California State Championship Jersey. 🚴‍♂️🏊‍♀️🏃‍♀️

👉 Don’t miss your moment to race, win, and represent — Register today!

Join us at the birthplace of the sport for the XTERRA Wetsuits Mission Bay Triathlon!

2026 is the 38th annual XTERRA Wetsuits Mission Bay Triathlon benefitting Life Sports Foundation. San Diego is the Birthplace of Triathlon! In 1974, the first Mission Bay Triathlon was as a run-bike-swim-run event on Fiesta Island by the San Diego Track Club. Every year competitors from around the country and from around the world, come to Mission Bay to celebrate the birthplace triathlon.  We invite you to become part of this wonderful legacy event and become part of history!

The event offers races for adults and kids,  from complete beginners to seasoned Professionals. There are many different races going on simultaneously, and while a traditional Triathlon is Swim / Bike / Run, KOZ Events, the organizer of the San Diego Triathlon Series,  offers more of a Multisport Race. Our race is very inclusive and we make triathlon accessible to as many people as possible. We have the traditional Swim/bike/ Run Triathlon but we offer so much more. If you do not like swimming, we have the Duathlon which is a Run/ Bike/ Run, if you don’t want to bike then choose the Aquathlon Swim / Run, or if you don’t want to run choose the Aquabike  Swim/Bike. We even have a Mini Distance Triathlon for beginners that want to try out the sport. We even offer free training groups every week to help people get started, train, and get connected to the San Diego Triathlon Community.

name: 310K Run/walk powered by Leslie Cohen Law
description:
2025 Results at this link

https://www.racefoxresults.com/leslie-cohen-law-5k 

Leslie Cohen Law PC is once again proud to be hosting the 310K Run/Walk, a 5K event that raises funds for the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project. Now in its 15th year, the 310K is a community-driven race that takes place right on the beach in Santa Monica, drawing many returning runners and walkers year after year. The event welcomes participants of all paces—whether you're running to set a new personal record or walking with friends to support a great cause. With in-person and virtual options, the 310K offers a meaningful way to give back while enjoying one of the most scenic race routes in beautiful LA.

 

For the 2nd year in a row, we return to the California Incline!

This year, the 310K will take place on Sunday, November 22nd—a great way to kick off Thanksgiving week with purpose and community spirit.

Our new location last year got such rave reviews that we need to make it a tradition. We will once again start at the iconic Santa Monica Pier and run down and then back up the California Incline.

Our Beneficiary

Proceeds from the 310K support the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project (DAP), which provides free bankruptcy-related legal services to individuals and families across Greater Los Angeles. Through clinics, educational workshops, and one-on-one legal representation, DAP helps clients understand their rights, navigate the legal system, and find paths toward financial stability. DAP is part of Public Counsel, the largest pro bono legal aid organization in the United States. Leslie Cohen Law PC received the James King Community Service Award from Public Counsel in 2016 in recognition of the impact of the 310K.

name: 33rd Annual Brea 8K Classic presented by Brea Mall  - Race Starts at 7am!
description:
Join the Excitement at the Brea 8K Classic!


What started with just 68 runners has grown into one of Southern California’s most beloved community races—and this year, we’re going bigger than ever! Thousands of runners, walkers, volunteers, and supporters from across the country will come together for a day of fitness, fun, and purpose.

Why run with us?

A Scenic, USATF-Certified Course: Enjoy rolling hills and vibrant neighborhoods in beautiful Brea.
Unforgettable Energy: Live music, cheering crowds, and a post-race celebration featuring local food and drinks.
Make a Difference: Every step you take supports Brea Olinda High School’s award-winning music program—helping students access instruments, sheet music, and opportunities to perform and compete.


Your participation matters. This single event is the most impactful fundraiser for our city’s only comprehensive high school. By joining, you’re not just running—you’re investing in creativity, collaboration, and the cultural heartbeat of our community.

Ready to be part of something special?
Sign up today and experience the thrill of the Brea 8K Classic. Lace up, show up, and make an impact!

name: 41st Nature Made Great Race: Half Marathon, 5K, 10K, 15K, 10M, 1M
description:
The Nature Made Great Race is a celebration of running that features the incredibly scenic Chesebro Half Marathon mostly trail race, and on road: the Deena Kastor 5K, Old Agoura 10K, 15K Double Stack Challenge, Cronies 10.3 Mile Triple Stack Challenge and United Track 1 Mile run/walk.

Established in 1986, the Great Race has won many awards and accolades over the years including:

Best Half Marathon in Nation by Active.com
Voted #1 Running Event in L.A.
Selected a Top 10K in U.S. by Runner's World
Best Race Swag by Competitor Magazine
Best Post-Race Party by LA Sports & Fitness Magazine
Best Post-Race Party by Active.com
Best Post-Race Party by Runner's World
Best Brunch Run by Athlinks 

 

Runner Perks

  • Run on a beautiful, scenic and serene course
  • Custom-designed drawstring goodie bag with actual goodies
  • Premium technical running top (men's or women's cut, in short sleeve or long sleeve)
  • All finishers are rewarded with a beautiful, commemorative finisher’s medal
  • Two medals for finishers of the 10 Mile Triple Stack Challenge and 15K Double Stack Challenge
  • LA's #1 Post-Race Party with lots of quality free food, music and shopping
  • Live Results with RFID timing
  • Photographers on course
  • Plenty of aid stations
  • USATF certified and sanctioned courses
  • Well-marked routes
  • The Great Race Super Discount on Great Race apparel & gear (the earlier you register, the more offers you receive)
  • Sports & Fitness Expo
  • Free parking at the Expo
  • Free race day parking
  • Announcer greets you at beautiful Chumash Park at SoCal’s most active, fun finish line
  • Hundreds of Age Group Awards
  • Prizing: Audio/Video Equipment to Top Finishers in Select Races like TVs, Headphones, Music Players, etc.

Great Race runners comment year-after-year about the gorgeous scenery, the serenity and the most Most Beautiful Courses in Southern California!

So Much Fun!

name: 43rd Annual Providence Saint John's Health Center Brentwood Run
description:
🏃‍♀️ Join Us for the 43rd Annual Brentwood Run 🏃‍♂️

Be part of a beloved Brentwood tradition as the 43rd Annual Brentwood Run returns to San Vicente Blvd! This historic race features a flat and slight downhill course, making it a fast and enjoyable run or walk for participants of all levels. Beyond the race, enjoy a huge expo with local vendors and a dedicated kids area. Best of all, your participation benefits the Brentwood Library and supports the local community!

name: 46th Annual AMS 5K & Wellness Expo VI
description:
Locals know this as a popular and inclusive community event that offers a fun family environment focused on physical and spiritual Wellness. Participants walk, jog, run, and/or race. This event also includes a Stroller Competition and Costume Contest.  


For those racing, the fast and challenging 3.1-mile course includes certified timing and a large digital clock at the finish.


For EVERYONE, this event provides an opportunity for Wellness and to experience a fun-filled, all-inclusive activity & the American Martyrs community.

Visit Ferndale for the Foggy Bottom Milk Run! The race features a 4 Mile, 2 Mile, and 10 Mile course. Ferndale has been the home of the Foggy Bottom Milk Run since its inception in 1978.  A hidden jewel of California's Lost Coast, we are proud and honored to hold our event in this beautiful locale.

The race starts and finishes in downtown Ferndale, CA

name: 55th NorCal John Frank Memorial Run
description:
March 7, 2026

10-Mile USATF Pacific Association Road Grand Prix event.

Run a spring race along the beautiful Sacramento River Trail and across two iconic pedestrian bridges, the Diestelhorst Bridge and the Stress Ribbon Bridge, in Redding, CA.

Plus a 3-Mile Run/Walk and 1 Mile Run/Walk. Kids 14 and under run the 1 Mile for free.

Course Records:

$2900 in prize purse for 10-Mile, awarded to USATF Pacific Association members.
$2500 in course record prize purse for 10-Mile. $1000 for men/women open course records, $250 for men/women masters (40+ y/o) course records.

  • Women's Open: 55:23 (Sara Hall, 2016)
  • Men's Open: 48:38 (Brendan Gregg, 2022)
  • Women's Masters: 57:09 (Linda Smith, 2010)
  • Men's Masters: 50:47 (Sergio Reyes, 2022)

Packet pickup will be on Friday March 6, 2026, from 11am to 5pm, at Fleet Feet Redding, 1376 Hilltop Dr, Redding, CA 96003.
Race day registration opens at 7:30am at Lake Redding Park, 2225 Benton Dr, Redding, CA US 96003.

1 Mile starts at 8:30 AM.
10 Mile starts at 10:00 AM.
3 Mile starts at 10:05 AM.

name: 5K for Fragile X
description:
Superheroes are back once again!! 

Join us on Saturday, April 18th, 2026 for the 13th Annual 5K Walk/Race for Fragile X and celebrate our Southern California Fragile X Community! Click Here for Event Details for Participants 

Why race for Fragile X syndrome? 

Fragile X syndrome (FXS) is the leading known cause of inherited intellectual disability and the leading single gene cause of Autism. Fraxsocal’s mission is to promote public awareness and with your help we can accomplish this goal! Also, to provide a forum for families and children with FXS to meet & greet and create a stronger FXS community! We also support research for effective treatments and ultimately a cure for FXS. Treatments for Fragile X are likely to help people affected by autism, Alzheimer’s, and other brain disorders.

Fragile X Community 

A Family Fun Day will proceed after the walk with Family, Friends, Food and Fun!! It's a great time to chat with other families affected by fragile X syndrome (FXS) and it's also a nice opportunity for you to take your kid(s) or adult(s) with FXS or any disability for that matter, judgement free! 

How to participate:
  • Participate in person: Sign up to walk, run, bike, scoot or stroll (it's a very family friendly walk/run) All you do is click the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! Mark your calendar and be sure to arrive early so you can get your FREE t-shirt and goodies before we begin. 
  • Participate virtually: Sign up by clicking the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! (Make sure you have someone there in person to pick up your t-shirts otherwise you will be donating them to our organization in which we say, "thank you"! ) 
  • Start a Fundraiser: Whether you are participating in person or virtually you can start an individual fundraiser (starting goal is $250) and attach it to a TEAM (Starting goal of $2,500) in the honor of your Fragile X Super Hero.
  • Become a Sponsor:  Whether you personally, your company or a company you know are interested we have multiple packages to choose from! 
 
Race Fundraising Goal: $75,000 Last year we raised over $55,000!!! Let's see if we can top that!! Donations can be made by clicking the Donate Tab.
 
Share!

Inform your network of supporters! Use these Social Media graphic template to help you tell others that you are racing and/or fundraising! Invite them to race or donate in your honor or in the honor of your Fragile X Superhero.

 

More about our organization: 
FRAGILE X ASSOCIATION of SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA (FRAXSOCAL)
Our non-profit organization was formed to promote public awareness of Fragile X Syndrome with special emphasis on educators and health professionals; provide a forum for families and children with Fragile X to meet and share their ideas, concerns and problems; and support scientific research on Fragile X Syndrome.

name: 7 Summits Elevation Challenge
description:
Take on the world’s highest peaks on all 7 continents — virtually!

From Denali to Everest, you’ll climb a combined 133,390 feet of elevation gain in 2026.
Take on the challenge SOLO, or create a TEAM and split the elevation gain to conquer the combined goal together!
Track every foot of elevation through walking, running, hiking, cycling or any cardio machine that tracks elevation gain - as you battle your way from one summit to the next.
 
🏔️ Peaks & Elevation Goals
Mount Kosciuszko (Australia)
7,310 ft (2,228 m)
 
Mount Kilimanjaro (Africa)
19,341 ft (5,895 m)
 
Mount Elbrus (Europe)
18,510 ft (5,642 m)
 
Denali (North America)
20,310 ft (6,190 m)
 
Aconcagua (South America)
22,837 ft (6,961 m)
 
Vinson Massif (Antarctica)
16,050 ft (4,892 m)
 
Mount Everest (Asia)
29,032 ft (8,849 m)
 
TOTAL: 133,390 ft

name: 71st Annual Fontana Days Run
description: The Fontana Days Run Half Marathon began back in 1955 with a reported 200 participants. Race founders were unaware that the annual Half Marathon would grow to include over 2,000 participants. The Fontana Days Run provides participants with a safe, festive, and well organized event. The Annual Fontana Days Run features a Half Marathon, 5K Run, 5K Family Fitness Walk, and a Children's Half Mile Dash. Finish Line festivities include local vendors, exhibitors, entertainment, and food.

name: 7th Annual Super Bulldog Jog 5K Run/Walk
description:
The Bulldog Jog is a 5K run/walk for all ages.  Course will begin and end inside the school, however the majority of the 5K will run through our surrounding community residential streets.  Located exclusively on the school’s campus, will also be the “Health Fair," which will include “FREE” pre- and post-run festivities (beginning at 7am) featuring a variety of entertainment, as well as health and fitness information.  This event will offer not only finisher medals, shirts, and timed bib at a low cost to those who register, but also fun activities for the whole family at the Health Fair.

-----------------------------------------------------

El Bulldog Jog es una carrera/caminata de 5 km para todas las edades. El recorrido comenzará y terminará dentro de la escuela; sin embargo, la mayor parte de la carrera se realizará por las calles residenciales de nuestra comunidad circundante. Ubicada exclusivamente en el campus de la escuela, también se realizará la "Feria de la Salud", que incluirá actividades gratuitas antes y después de la carrera (a partir de las 7:00 a. m.) con una variedad de entretenimiento, así como información sobre salud y ejercicio. Este evento no solo ofrecerá medallas, camisetas y dorsales cronometrados a bajo costo para quienes se inscriban, sino también actividades divertidas para toda la familia en la Feria de la Salud.

name: 8th Annual KIWANIS  RESOLUTION 5K Run/Walk, and 10K Run/Walk
description:
KIWANIS Resolution Races are in-person runs at Mountain View Shoreline Park! We’ve both a 5K and 10K event to choose from, with Digital  Chip timing for both.

 

This year we are again running on Saturday January 3 to give  holiday travelers a chance to participate too. Start the new year out with a great run on a great day on the Bayland trails!. It's a beautiful location with free parking, great race, with post-race snacks and lots of awards.

 

Please note that no dogs or pets are allowed in Shoreline Park.

 

We will again have a 1K Kids run this year for ages 1-10 and this year all 1K participants will also receive a race T shirt. Plan on bringing all kids and the neighbors too! 

 

Race Day is Jan 3, 2026. The 10K starts at 10:00 AM and the 5K starts at 10:15 AM. All inside Mountain View Shoreline Park. Parking is free for all.  

 

All participants who register by December 15 will receive a specially designed race T-shirt.

 

Also please upload photos from your race experience to this website. We'd love to share your experience of the race. 

 

You may visit our permanent website WSJKrun.org for information about past races and Kiwanis current charitable work. Or Click HERE for more info about Kiwanis of West San Jose and/or HERE for specific programs information.

name: 9th Annual BRAVE Race 2026
description:
The BRAVE RACE is hosted by The Joyful Child Foundation - In Memory of Samantha Runnion (55-0794474).

The Joyful Child Foundation is dedicated to preventing crimes against children through programs that educate, empower, and unite families and communities.

Your participation benefits The Joyful Child's Be Brave-Be Safe Empowerment Programs.

You can choose to participate virtually or join us in person at Wolverine Stadium in Aliso Viejo, CA on Sunday, February 22, 2026

Participants can walk or run a 1K, 5K, 10K. Prize money to top 3 male and female in 5k and 10k.

name: A Merry Christmas Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎅 🎄  Join the Christmas Run! 🎄 🎅

Jingle All the Way: A Merry Christmas Run!" is a delightful Holiday run that reminds us of the true essence of Christmas – spreading love, giving selflessly, and cherishing the joy of togetherness with family, friends, and even strangers, all while getting a run in before the Christmas festivities! 

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)
