name: FTD Walk for Hope 5K
description:
Raising Awareness and Funds for Frontotemporal Degeneration

We are excited to announce the FTD Walk for Hope 5K, a community event dedicated to raising awareness and funds for Frontotemporal Degeneration (FTD), a devastating brain disorder that affects behavior, language, and personality. Unlike Alzheimer’s disease, FTD often strikes people in their 40's to 60's, leading to profound changes in relationships, work, and independence. There is currently no cure, and increased awareness and research funding are crucial.

Our walk supports the Association for Frontotemporal Degeneration (AFTD), a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. 

The FTD Walk for Hope 5K mission is to unite the community and honor those affected by FTD. All proceeds from this event will be donated to support The Association for Frontotemporal Degeneration's (AFTD) mission. Funds will be designated 50% towards AFTD's FTD Research efforts and 50% towards AFTD's Comstock Grants, which provides financial assistance to families affected by FTD. Any unspent California-designated funds as of June 30, 2026, will be redirected to support individuals diagnosed with FTD or their caregivers in other states. Together, we can bring hope to families and move on step closer to a future free of FTD.”

Details for the FTD Walk for Hope 5K:

  • Event date: Saturday, April 11, 2026
  • Registration check-in will open at 9:00 AM
  • Program will begin at 9:30 AM with a Welcome Address followed by the 5K fun walk

Thank you for considering this opportunity to make a difference. Together, we can bring hope to families and move one step closer to a future free of FTD.

name: Fullerton Fit 5K Trail Run
description:
Fullerton Fit 5K Trail Run and Health & Wellness Fair
Saturday, June 6th, 2026
8:00 - 11:00 AM
 

Join us for the City of Fullerton’s inaugural 5K Trail Run, a community celebration of fitness, wellness, and fun! Lace up your running shoes and experience a scenic dirt trail course that winds through the natural beauty of the Brea Dam area and alongside the Fullerton Tennis Center & Golf Course. This trail run is not stroller friendly and encouraged for children ages 10 and up. 

This event isn’t just about the race—it’s a full day of community connection. Enjoy the Health & Wellness Fair, featuring local vendors, fitness demonstrations, and resources to support your healthy lifestyle from 8:00 - 11:00 AM.

Come hungry and enjoy a variety of delicious healthy food trucks & vendors offering fresh bites and post-race treats. Whether you’re a seasoned runner, a weekend walker, or simply want to cheer on friends and family, this event has something for everyone. Be part of history and join us as we kick off a new Fullerton tradition!

Race Entry Includes:

  • Free Finisher's Photos & Video
  • Race T-shirt
  • Finisher Medal
  • Reusable Water Bottles

description:
Lace up, breathe in that fresh ocean air, and get ready for a high-energy run filled with groovy beats, sunny smiles, and nothing but pure seaside bliss. Let’s make every mile a celebration of movement, music, and good vibes!

Race Details

Start Location: Long Beach Location TBD
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the tables closest to Claremont Ave
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

name: Grapes of Wrath Triathlon, 5k & 10k
description:
What will you find at the Grapes of Wrath triathlon?

+ Finisher's Medal
+ Event T-Shirt
+ Finishers meal
+ Rosa Brother's Chocolate Milk
+ Free Race Photos


The Grapes of Wrath Triathlon is a fast and fun race in the central valley located east of Delano, CA. This event features a lake swim in Lake Woollomes, a fast and flat road bike course, and a run which is part trail and part paved finishes the race. Each athlete registered for the Grapes of Wrath Triathlon will receive a custom t-shirt, athlete goody bag, swim cap, post-race meal, and be eligible for raffle prizes and race awards three-deep in each division. Take the weekend and come up and enjoy this fun event with your family.

About the venue:

Three miles southeast of Delano, CA, nestled in the vinyards and orchards of the Central San Joaquin Valley is Lake Woollomes, a 300-acre reservoir with 4 miles of shoreline, making it a cozy location for water recreation.

Swimming is allowed here, making this destination perfect for hot summer days. There’s also a boat dock and a launch ramp for those wishing to take to the water. But, the use is restricted to non-powered boats, so only sailboats, SUPs, and kayaks can be used on the lake.  

This fast, flat course is the perfect place to get your next PR.

Note:
A USAT membership is required for the Triathlon, (but not the 5k/10k)  If you do not have one, you can purchase one during the registration process.

Each athlete registered for the Grapes of Wrath Triathlon will receive a custom t-shirt, athlete goody bag, swim cap, post-race meal, and be eligible for raffle prizes and race awards three-deep in each division. Take the weekend and come up and enjoy this fun event with your family.

About the venue:

Three miles southeast of Delano, CA, nestled in the vinyards and orchards of the Central San Joaquin Valley is Lake Woollomes, a 300-acre reservoir with 4 miles of shoreline, making it a cozy location for water recreation.

Swimming is allowed here, making this destination perfect for hot summer days. There’s also a boat dock and a launch ramp for those wishing to take to the water. But, the use is restricted to non-powered boats, so only sailboats, SUPs, and kayaks can be used on the lake.  

This fast, flat course is the perfect place to get your next PR.

Note:
A USAT membership is required for the Triathlon, (but not the 5k/10k)  If you do not have one, you can purchase one during the registration process.

name: Gratitude Wall
description: Drop in, slow down, and share a little gratitude! Visit our all-week Gratitude Wall to post a note about someone, something, or a special moment you’re thankful for.

name: Great Donut Run / Walk 5k
description:
Great Donut Run

Sunday, May 19, 2024

Irvine Valley College                                

Welcome back Donuteers!  We are so excited to bring the Great Donut Run back in person with more donuts then ever before!  If you haven't registered yet then donut hesitate and sign up today!   We've got an easy breezy 1 miler at 7:30 the 5k run/walk at 8:00am. Both races are open to all ages and abilities. Take all the time you need to finish. This is not a timed event. We've got yummy donut holes at the halfway point on the 5k to keep you carbed up along the way.  We also have the Donut Double Dare if you want to run the 1 mile and 5k back to back!  Double the fun Double the donuts!  For all the kiddies looking to earn their own race bling we start their races at 9:15.  We have several distances from 50 yards to half a mile, based on ages from zero (yes, under 1 year old! ) to 12 yrs old.  It's never too early to start dashing for donuts!  Whatever race you choose, you're donuts will be safely waiting for you!  We've also got gorgeous big bling finishers medals that you'll love!

The race starts and finishes in the same location at Irvine Valley College. The course is walker and stroller friendly.  It's all flat and fast and this is a non timed, family fun run.  This is a great way for first timers to get out and enjoy a race without any pressure or timelines!  Get your donut friendly gear on and win one of many costume awards!  We can't wait to see you! 

Online Registration closes on May 16th.  If you miss the deadline you can register at Packet Pick up at Road Runner Sports in Laguna Hills on Saturday, May 18th.  We'll be there from 12-4pm or you can register on race day but please come early! 

More info on www.GreatDonutRun.com

name: Green Valley Lake 5k/10k/& Half Marathon
description:
🌲 GREEN VALLEY LAKE 5K / 10K / HALF MARATHON
Saturday, August 2, 2025
Green Valley Lake, CA (Between Running Springs & Big Bear in the San Bernardino Mountains)

 
🕖 START TIMES
7:00 AM: Early Start Half Marathon (for those expecting to take 3.75+ hours)
7:30 AM: Standard Half Marathon Start
8:30 AM: Mass Start for 5K & 10K
 
🏞 COURSE HIGHLIGHTS
This is a breathtaking mountain race in the heart of the San Bernardino National Forest!

Start with a scenic ¾-mile out-and-back along the lake
Climb gradually up Green Valley Lake Rd and onto a forest service road
Enjoy a 400 ft elevation gain to an overlook at the 5K turnaround
10K and Half Marathon continue along rolling terrain on FS Road 2N13, through pine forests and rocky vistas
Course is part paved (1.5 miles), then transitions to dirt roads and trail
Water & aid stations every 1.5 miles
Get ready for that fresh air, mountain-made, above-the-clouds experience!

 
📍 LOCATION
Green Valley Lake – Just 40 minutes from Redlands, located off Hwy 18 between Lake Arrowhead and Big Bear.

Post-race activities take place in the Downtown Community Garden on Main Street.
Race HQ / Packet Pickup: Black Dog Social Club, 33231 Green Valley Lake Rd.

 
🥇 WHAT YOU GET
Custom, high-quality event t-shirt
Unique, huge finisher medal
Top 3 overall awards per race distance
Age group medals (3 deep in 5-year spans up to 80+)
Chip timing by Itz About Time
🏆 Age Groups:
10 & under, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80+
(Separate overall awards for each race distance.)

 
🏁 AWARDS CEREMONY – COMMUNITY GARDEN
9:15 AM – 5K Awards
9:30 AM – 10K Awards
9:45 AM – Half Marathon Awards
 
🧁 FOOD & FUN
Coffee ,pastries , street tacos, and more available for purchase packet pickup and race morning
Food available for purchase post-race
Live music at the Community Garden post-race
Hang out in a welcoming mountain community with big hometown vibes
 
🎽 PACKET PICKUP
Friday, July 31 3:00 PM – 6:30PM @ Black Dog Social Club
Saturday (Race Day): 6:30 AM – 8:30 AM @ Race Site
 
🏕 STAY THE WEEKEND
Make it a full mountain getaway!

Airbnbs in Green Valley Lake
Green Valley Lake Campground (0.5 miles from race) 
Giant Oaks Lodge, Running Springs (5 miles)
Rentals available at: green-valley-lake.com
 
🌅 FRIDAY NIGHT SUNSET RUN (Optional Add-On)
Friday, August 1 at 7:00 PM – Sunset Trail 5K
A fun, scenic, single-track 3.1-mile warm-up trail run.
💌 Email: carenfasttrack@aol.com to sign up.

 
🚴‍♀️ WANT TO RENT MOUNTAIN OR E-BIKES?
Visit Mountain Life Supply Co.
32855 Hilltop Blvd, Running Springs (past Valero Gas Station on right)

 
🌲 GIVING BACK
Proceeds benefit The Children’s Forest via the Southern California Mountains Foundation, empowering youth to become leaders in environmental stewardship.

Your support helps:

Train young Forest Rangers, Firefighters & Scientists
Maintain trails like The Exploration Trail
Support the Camacho family in memory of their daughter
We also proudly support:

The Green Valley Lake Community Garden (host of our awards)
The Local Museum, providing water support on the course
🙏 Donations welcome – Hit the "DONATE" button at registration!

 
FINAL NOTES
This is a scenic mountain course – come for the run, stay for the views!
A perfect escape from the summer heat and city smog
Come experience the camaraderie and community like no other!

name: Grievances & Gratitude Run – Embrace the Positive! 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
Grievances & Gratitude Run


Release. Move. Begin Again.

Skip the resolutions. Start the year with intention, movement, and joy.

Grievances & Gratitude is a feel-good New Year run designed to help you exhale, reset, and step into 2026 lighter—surrounded by community, movement, and positive energy. This is about letting go of what no longer serves you and making space for gratitude, clarity, and forward momentum.

You can write down everything you’re ready to release… or just one thing. You can take part in the experience—or simply show up and run. However you choose to participate, this event meets you exactly where you are.

Every participant receives a finisher medal, and the option to take part in our signature Let Go & Affirmation Experience—because new beginnings don’t have to be loud or rigid. Sometimes they just need movement and space to breathe.

 
How It Works
Let Go Before You Go
Before the run, write down anything you’re ready to release—grievances, frustrations, stress, or heavy thoughts. Place them into our “goodbye” containers and symbolically leave that energy behind.

Run Free
Head out on a scenic course and move your body with intention. Run or walk at your own pace, clear your mind, and let each step carry you forward.

Affirmations Await
After crossing the finish line, visit our New Year Mantra Board and select a positive affirmation to guide you into the year ahead. Leave with gratitude, purpose, and renewed energy.

This isn’t just a race—it’s a moment. A reset. A fresh start grounded in movement and community.

 
Why CaliFlow Runs?
CaliFlow Runs creates inclusive, high-energy, community-driven events that celebrate you. Our races are accessible, joyful, and thoughtfully designed to support physical and emotional well-being—without pressure, pretension, or upsells.

✨ Professionally chip-timed
✨ USATF-certified courses
✨ Free race-day photos
✨ No forced shirts. No gimmicks. Just good vibes.

 
Who Can Participate?
Everyone is welcome.
Runners • Walkers • Strollers • First-timers • Seasoned athletes
This event is for anyone ready to move into the new year with intention.

 
Course Information
Our courses are open, meaning you’ll share the path with other runners, walkers, and beachgoers. Please stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path at all times.

✔️ Clearly marked course
✔️ 3 on-course water stations
✔️ Restrooms available along the route
✔️ Friendly staff and volunteers throughout

 
Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
Bib Pick-Up: 6:15 AM
📍 Race Ready Athletics Tent

Start Times:
• Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
• 5K & 10K: 7:30 AM

 
Start Location
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd
Long Beach, CA 90803

 
Parking Information
• Free street parking available
• Metered parking: $2.00 per hour

 
Awards
🏅 Top 3 men and women in each distance receive awards
🎤 Podium ceremony at 9:00 AM

 
Start 2026 grounded, grateful, and moving forward—together.
Come for the run. Stay for the release. Leave lighter.

name: Griffith Park Resolution Run
description:
Celebrate The New Year With Us! Join us for 2026 and help us make it even better! We're giving out some goodies to the first couple registrations so don't miss out and register now!

 

Our Half Marathon course is roughly 90% on a trail with the remaining 10% on asphalt. Below is a quick overview of the course.

The start of the course is at Shane's Inspiration in Griffith Park.
Mile 1: Upper Old Zoo Trail
Mile 2: Bill Eckert Trail (Hills with beautiful views!)
Miles 3-5: Mainly downhill on asphalt
Miles 6-8: Rolling Hills (Tetris)
Mile 9: All downhill
Miles 10-13: Quick flat trail to the finish!

Our 12K shares the same start line as the Half Marathon.
Miles 1-3: You will pass through the old Griffith Park Zoo and zoom through some hills
Mile 4: All downhill
Miles 5-7+: Quick flat trail to the finish!

Our 5K is a nice and quick route around the golf course.

15K Relay - New for 2026!
Create a team of 3 and each run a 5K loop. Compete in any of our 3 divisions for the relay!
Coed, Male, Female

name: Griffith Park Trail Marathon Relay & 8K
description:
Join us for the Griffith Park Trail Marathon Relay & 8K, an unforgettable race experience celebrated as one of Runner’s World magazine’s 10 Best Races You’ve Never Heard Of in 2024! This iconic event is the perfect opportunity to push yourself, bond with friends, and take in the breathtaking beauty of Griffith Park. With a combination of scenic trails and challenging terrain, you’ll be in for the ride of your life. Whether you’re a seasoned runner or just starting out, join us for a solo run or bring a team for a relay. And with fully-stocked aid stations and an energetic volunteer crew, you’ll have everything you need to crush it. So come on, grab your running shoes, and let’s make this a moment to remember! Register now for a day of adventure, camaraderie, and lasting memories.
One of the largest urban parks in the country, Griffith Park is a 4,300-plus acre slice of runner heaven. The grounds include famous sites like the Abandoned Los Angeles Zoo, the Observatory, and the Hollywood Sign. There’s more than 30 trails totaling around 50 miles for runners and hikers. Join us for the Griffith Park Trail Relay Marathon and get a taste of what the second largest city park has to offer.
  • All participants will receive a premium short sleeve women's or men's cut t-shirt. (Guaranteed shirt size if you register by May 17!)
  • Relay run is chip timed for fast & accurate results.
  • $1500 in Cash prizes for the Open division
  • Trophy/Plaque for the top 3 teams in each recreational division
  • Finisher’s medal for all participants
  • Limited Edition Badges (Relay Only)
  • 3 well supported aid stations with medical staff (2 on course, 1 at start/finish)
  • Food and refreshments at the start/finish area.
  • Music from multiple live DJs
  • Multiple Food Trucks
  • Access to the exclusive GPTMR packet pickup sale and raffle at Fleet Feet Burbank

name: HANG ON, LET  ME OVERTHINK THIS 5K/10K
description:
CHASING CLARITY, ONE MILE AT A TIME...

Welcome to the HANG ON, LET ME OVERTHINK THIS 5K/10K! It's the perfect event for beautifully over-caffeinated minds that won’t stop spinning—until your feet start moving! Whether you’re jogging, walking, or power-pondering your way through the miles, this run invites you to move your body and let your thoughts… run themselves out. 

Sign up for the HANG ON, LET ME OVERTHINK THIS 5K/10K, complete it anytime and anywhere, and help give back to a great cause! Every entry gets you a custom high-quality shirt that is sure to be your new favorite, a cool finisher medal, along with a donation to Stand Up To Cancer in order to help SU2C get one step closer to its mission of making everyone diagnosed with cancer a survivor!
RUN NOW. OVERTHINK LATER.

TO JOIN: 

  • Register for the HANG ON, LET ME OVERTHINK THIS 5K/10K before March 31st, 2026
  • Complete a 5K (3.1 miles) or 10K (6.2 miles) at your convenience any time anywhere (no deadline)!
  • Celebrate your accomplishment by sharing on social media! #HangOnLetMeOverthinkThis #IRun4Movement

name: Happy New Year 2026 - 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon  by Califlow Runs
description:
Happy New Year 2026


🎉 5K, 10K & Half Marathon
📍 Long Beach, CA
📅 Date: January 1, 2026

Start the year off on the right foot—literally! Celebrate the first day of 2026 with the Happy New Year 2026 Run in sunny Long Beach. Whether you’re chasing a personal best, kicking off a new fitness journey, or just looking for a fun and festive way to begin the year, this race has it all.

Event Highlights


🌟 Fresh Start: Kick off 2026 with a scenic run along Long Beach’s gorgeous coastline.
🏅 New Year’s Medals: Cross the finish line and claim your sparkling custom medal to commemorate your achievement.
🎉 Festive Atmosphere: Enjoy the cheers, camaraderie, and good vibes as we celebrate a brand-new year together.
📸 Photo Ops: Capture your first victory of the year with stunning backdrops and festive décor.
🥂 Post-Race Celebration: Toast to your success with refreshments and fun after the race.

Why Join Us?


There’s no better way to welcome the new year than with a healthy, positive, and energizing experience. Start the year strong, share the joy with fellow runners, and make this January 1st one to remember.

Registration Includes
✅ Timed race with a scenic course
✅ Exclusive Happy New Year 2026 finisher medal
✅ Free Race Day Photod
✅ Post-race refreshments and entertainment

Schedule


📅 Race Day Check-In: 6:15AM
🏁 Start Times:

Half Marathon: 7:00AM
10K: 8:00 AM

name: Harvest Hustle – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
It's the Harvest Hustle, let's boogie! Welcome to our new course at Hansen Dam Recreational Area

Details

Start Location: Hansen Dam Recreation Area,11770 Foothill Blvd., Lake View Terrace, CA. Ranger Station Area, Google Maps
Parking: There are free parking lots nearby the start

Event Schedule

6:30am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Course

5k & 10k – this 5k route is used for the 5k (done once), 10k (done twice)
Half Marathon – this 4.4-mile route is used for the half marathon (done 3 times)

More About the Course: This is a looped course. Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations along the way.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Email us at events@hightideruns.com

name: Have a Heart for Kids 5K Run/Walk
description:
The Have a Heart for Kids 5K Run/Walk is a fundraiser for the Yuba City Education Foundation.  The proceeds benefit students and their families within the YCUSD community. 

Start and Finish will be on the River Valley High School track with an 8:45am warm-up and announcements and a 9:00am start.  Breakfast will be served at 9:30am and awards at 10:00am.

Registrations are open until the day of the run, however T-Shirts orders cut off on Wednesday, February 18, 2026.

name: HDR Miles Mania
description:
Here is a chance for runners of all ages to race the MILE -- FOR FREE!! 

  • This is a FREE EVENT!  There will be no race shirts, but there will be participation ribbons and age group 1-3 place ribbons. 
  • The races will be held by age and grade level beginning at 8 am and Noon!

The West Antelope Valley Education Foundation (WAVE) and the High Desert Runners are hosting these races on the track at Joe Walker Middle School as part of the Empowering Youth Festival.

  • The festival runs from 9am to 1pm. 
  • This is a fun event for families to bring their children and participate in the day’s activities! This year's vendors and demonstrators are still being lined up, but some of the vendors at our last festival included Robotics Teams from AV High School District, free bike repair by Lancaster Sunrise Rotary and Lakay’s Cycling Club, and activities provided by Lancaster and Palmdale City Parks and Recreation. We also enjoyed Quartz Hill Karate demonstrations, dance, and cheerleading performances throughout the event. The outdoor activities included the Go Green BMX Show, Excel Tennis, WAVE Kindness Rock Painting, 4-H Club, and local food trucks. Two of the favorite community service vehicles were the Waste Management Trash Truck, and the AMR Ambulance.

Two of the favorite community service vehicles were the Waste Management Trash Truck, and the AMR Ambulance.

name: Heart & Soles Run
description:
Hit the pavement on Saturday, April 25, 2026 in support of children's health and wellness at the 13th Annual Lam Research Heart & Soles Run! All 5K/10K registrations include:
  • Short sleeve dri-fit tech shirt
  • Finisher medal
  • Bib with professional race timing
  • Fast and scenic course around Santa Clara University
  • Post-race refreshments
Founded in 2014, the Heart & Soles Run is a 5K/10K race that takes place in the spring of each year. The scenic course circles around the beautiful campus of Santa Clara University and along nearby tree-lined streets. After the race, enroll the kids in the Kids Run, visit vendor booths, and enjoy the celebratory atmosphere in the finish area. 
Your registration supports local nonprofits that provide students with equitable access to exercise, nutrition, and well-being resources. In total, the event has raised nearly $1 million in support of children’s health and wellness. Event proceeds are donated to the following youth organizations:
  • Boys & Girls Clubs of Silicon Valley
  • Santa Clara County Office of Education
  • YMCA of Silicon Valley

name: Heart and Sole Valentine's Run 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon
description:
Celebrate love, fitness, and fun at the Heart & Sole run along the beautiful Santa Monica coast! Whether you're running solo, with a partner, or with friends, this Valentine 's-themed event offers a scenic 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon course that promises breathtaking ocean views and a vibrant race day atmosphere.

 

 Every runner will receive a unique heart and sole-themed finisher medal

Start your Valentine's celebration early with a fun-filled day at Heart & Sole! Share the love and register today for a race that will leave your heart racing and your soul inspired.

Why Calilflow Runs?
CaliFlow Runs is dedicated to creating inclusive, energetic, and community-driven running events that celebrate you. We bring people together to promote health, wellness, and positive vibes through races that are accessible, fun, and infused with the unique culture of the Golden State.


Who Can Participate? Everyone - Runners, Walkers, Strollers - All are welcome


About Our Courses: Our courses are open, which means you'll be sharing the path with other runners, walkers, and beachgoers. Safety is our top priority, so please stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path. The courses are well-marked, with water stations and restrooms available along the way.

 

Course Information: https://www.caliviberuns.com/w/CaliVibeRuns/Page/SantaMonicaCourse


Bib Pick-Up and Start Times:
Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM End 7:35 AM at the Race Ready Athletics Tent
Half Marathon Start Time: 7:00 am
5K, 10K, 15K & 10 Miler Start Time: 7:30 am
Start Location: 5100 E Ocean Blvd 
Long Beach, CA 90803
 
Parking Information: Street parking is available, but be sure to read the signs carefully as street sweeping occurs daily. We recommend parking in the paid lot near the start line, which ranges from $10 to $12. If you arrive before the lot attendant, you can pay at the machine near the entrance.


Awards: 
The top 3 men and women in each distance will receive a medal.
Podium awards ceremony for 5K/10K at 8:45 AM
Podium awards ceremony for half marathoners at 9:30 AM

name: Heart of Cool Trail Run
description:
Are you looking for a fun run for a great cause? If so, HoC 5k, 10k and half marathon is just what you are looking for!  Proceeds from this race go directly back to youth of BOMUSD (Black Oak Mines Unified School District) to inspire their future success through agriculture, engineering and VAPA (Visual and Performing Arts).  In addition, a percentage of the funds will also be used to scholarship a child to attend Camp Taylor, a camp specifically designed for youth with heart disease. 

Register by September 30 to receive a HoC cotton t-shirt with registration.  All half marathon participants receive something new for 2025 (TBD).  Check out our Instagram or Facebook page for a photo of the design.

This is a family friendly event and we highly encourage you to bring the whole family!  We offer a family discount package for immediate family members for the 5k and 10k distance!  If you want to participate in the event without your child, take advantage of our $8 per child - child care for children ages 3 and up!  We will have a post race pancake breakfast. 

The Heart of Cool Trail Run traverses some of the best trails Cool, CA and the Sierra Foothills have to offer.  Run on the same trails as many of the famous local (and world renowned) events such as Western States 100 Mile, Way too Cool 50k, Rio Del Lago 100 Mile, and many more!

To reduce waste and the possibility of littering our trails, this will be a cup free event.  Be sure to bring a cup or water bottle that can be refilled at aid stations.

Packet and bib pick up will be on Race Day.

Registration will be available online until the start of each event!

We can always use volunteers for this event. If you are able to lend a hand during the race, or the day before, please click on the Volunteer tab.

name: Hell Of A Half Marathon & 2 Person Relay
description:
IF IT DOESN’T CHALLENGE YOU…IT WON’T CHANGE YOU

YES, THE COURSE IS CHALLENGING, THE WEATHER IS HOT, BUT WHAT ELSE WOULD YOU EXPECT AT THE HELL OF A HALF MARATHON?!! OH, AND DON'T WORRY, THERE WILL BE A LOT OF OTHER CRAZIES WHO WILL JOIN YOU DURING YOUR 13.1 JOURNEY, ON THE ROAD LESS TRAVELED....

IT'S ONE THING TO FINISH A HALF MARATHON, BUT TO SAY YOU COMPLETED THE HELL OF A HALF MARATHON, IS BIG TIME BRAGGING RIGHTS!

RACE START TIME: 7:00 AM

 
WHAT MAKES THIS RACE STAND OUT:

2nd Race - Run The Valley Half Marathon Series

  • 11 AID STATIONS - Loaded with Ice, Water, Sponges, Gatorade, GU's, AND A LOT OF FUN!
  • We also encourage you to carry your own hydration
  • Relay Shuttle Transportation
  • Music DJ'S on the course
  • Post-Race Party! Party Vibe at the Finish Venue
  • Tulare County Fire Department Hoisting their US Garrison Flag at the Start/Finish Venue
  • FREE Breakfast w/Rushbowl & Rocio’s Catering 
  • FREE Race Photos
  • FREE Race Tracking with RACEJOY
  • FREE Live Results on Phone
  • Michelob Ultra Beer Garden. Yes, that's FREE too!  
  • Michelob Ultra Stage "It's a Party in the Park"
  • Top 3 Age Group & Relay Awards
  • Overall Male/Female Awards 
  • Top Relay Awards (3 Divisions)
  • Women's Tech Tank Top
  • Men's (Unisex) Short-Sleeve Tech Shirt
  • PRO~PT at the Finish Line for your Post Race 
  • Awesome Finishers Medal

name: Hensley Off Road Races
description:
Hensley Lake's Buck Ridge Trail has everything a rider and runner could want! Soaring single track, competitive turns and rock gardens, hills to make you cry and hills to make you fly! Sunday, February 2nd, Hensley Off Road Races 10k Trail Run & Mountain Bike Race is almost here! We have some amazing Finisher Medals for the 10k & MTB race, MTB Awards,10k Age Group Awards, and 10k Overall Awards! All runners will also receive a custom event shirt.  Don't miss out register today

Packet Pickup- Saturday, February 1st from 3pm-5:00pm at Fleet Feet Sports Fresno. 
9447 N Fort Washington Suite 106 Fresno, CA 93739

Race Day Packet Pickup/Registration: Sunday, Feb. 2nd- 10k: 7-750am MTB Race 8:45-9:45

We are so excited to be back in 2025 for the Hensley Off Road Races! 
Please take a few minutes to review the information below, especially the directions to the race start. In years past we have had people that end up on the wrong side of the lake, we don't want that to be you, so plan ahead and review the directions below.

Hensley Lake Directions: Click here for Google Map Directions.

*If you’re using GPS please ensure it is taking you to the Buck Ridge Recreation Area on the east side of Hensley Lake. *

Packet Pickup: Saturday, Feb. 1st from 3-5pm at Fleet Feet Sports Fresno located at 9447 N Fort Washington Suite 106 Fresno, Ca 93730

Race Day Packet Pickup: Sunday, Feb. 2nd from 7-750am at Hensley Lake Buck Ridge Recreation Area. MTB Packet Pickup 8:45-9:45am.

*There will NOT be any race day registration*

Start Time: 10k Run will start at 8am. The MTB race will start near 10am
Parking: There is a $10 self pay fee at the main gate of the Buck Ridge Recreation Area, please make sure to self-register and pay the day use fee. Hensley Lake also participates in the America the Beautiful Pass Program if you have one you can display it. 

Please allow extra time to pay your parking fee, unfortunately the park is not allowing us to hand out self pay envelopes prior to race day. They will also not be onsite to collect payment, the only method will be the kiosk at the entrance.

 Once you enter through the main gate of the Buck Ridge Recreation Area you will follow the road straight and then turn left into the boat parking lot. If this lot is full there are two others just past it.  Then it will be a short walk back towards the gate and the Start/Finish area will be on your left.

If you arrive early enough there is a small parking lot near the start/finish, this will fill up very quickly though. NO double parking or parking on the shoulder. 

The new kiosk outside the Buck Ridge gate takes credit card payment. 

There is absolutely no parking on the shoulder of the roadway or in any place that will obstruct access.  The park rangers will issue citations. 

Race Start Location: Will be just inside of the Buck Ridge Recreation main gate on the right hand side (north side).

MTB Race Numbers: Will need to be attached to the front of your handlebars with the number facing out. We will have twist ties to attach them with. Failure to properly attach your number will prevent us from recording accurate results.

10k Ride & Run Participants: If you signed up for the ride & run you only have to complete 1 lap for the MTB Ride. If you want to complete more please confirm with the timing tent before the race starts and ensure you start with the correct group. 

Cat A is 3 laps-CAT B is 2 laps CAT 1 & Juniors is 1 Lap.  You may not switch events once the race starts, if you don't finish your laps you will be listed as DNF, not moved to another group. 

Shirts: If the shirt size you registered for does not fit please wait until after the race to switch it out for another size. 

Course Markers:  The course will be marked with the following: signs with directional arrows and  orange ribbon. The course should be very easy to follow so long as you follow the markers.

name: Heroes 4 Hearing 5K
description:
Avoid lines on race day:

Pick Up Your Bib and shirt on Saturday August 16th at Sports Basement from 11am to 1pm.

Place

Shoreline Aquatic Park
200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802



HearAid Foundation presents our 4th Annual Heroes for Hearing 5K Fundraiser.

Be inspired by heroes overcoming their hearing loss. Run with heroes who bring the gift of hearing. Become a hero.
  
 
Join us on Sunday, August 17th on the water front, behind the aquarium, in Long Beach, California (or virtually) as we celebrate our recipients and those who helped give the gift of hearing! Let’s run and walk together so we can keep on giving this precious gift. All participants who register by July 25th are guaranteed to receive a t-shirt, and ALL participants are guaranteed to have lots of fun!

Join us for an exhilarating run through the marina and along the shore with views of the Queen Mary in Long Beach, California. Whether you're up for a 5k or the Kids Run, this event promises a memorable experience amidst the natural beauty of the shoreline.

Event Details:

Location: Shoreline Aquatic Park, 200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802

Bib Pickup: Starts at 7 am
Race Start Times:
5k: 8:00 am Kids Dash: 9:15 am

Parking Available a short walk away at the multi-level aquarium parking lot. Fees in the lot are by the hour, click this link for more details.


Course Map: https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6274860286/

Course Description:

The race starts and ends behind the aquarium, next to Pierpont Landing.

5k runners will follow the scenic path around along the marina, through Shoreline Village and out along the jetty where you will have a majestic view of the Queen Mary before heading back to the start.

Water station will be at the entrance to the jetty and you can stop here twice during the run/walk if you need to.

Course Time Limit: 1 hours and 45 minutes. You must cross the finish line by 9:45 a.m.

What You Get:

All participants will receive a finisher's medal, finish line treats, and free downloadable race photos.
Race results will be posted on our website within 12 hours of the race.

Gear Check: Personal items can be stored with our staff.

Water Station on the course, with water and electrolyte beverages.

Race Photos: Our course photographer will capture your journey, and you can download your photos for free within 24 hours of the event.

Results: Published on RunSignup within 12 hours of the race.

Refund and Deferral Policy:

Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds, please purchase the inexpensive insurance if you think there is a chance you might need to back out and will want a refund instead of considering it a donation to the charity. 


Who Can Register:

Everyone is welcome! Our races are open to participants of all ages, abilities, and races. Whether you're an experienced runner, a casual jogger, or a first-time walker, you're invited to join us. Parents can bring their children and strollers, as we believe in creating an inclusive and welcoming atmosphere for all. Come and be a part of this fun and rewarding race experience!
We look forward to seeing you in Long Beach for a day of fitness, fun, and camaraderie. Get ready to lace up your running shoes and create lasting memories in this beautiful setting!

name: Highland Y Run
description:
Every year the Highland YMCA welcomes runners and race enthusiasts of all ages and abilities to participate in a chipped or unchipped race.  The Highland Y Run is a fundraising event for the Highland YMCA that offers a scenic 5K or 10K route through the beautiful city of Highland, CA. All net proceeds from the Highland Y Run benefit the YMCA Financial Assistance program.  Through our Financial Assistance Program, the YMCA offers scholarships to Highland youth and families who may be unable to afford our programs.  By participating and supporting the Highland Y Run, you work alongside the Y to build strong kids, strong families and strong communities.  
The first 500 participants will receive a participation medal, run shirt guaranteed during pre-registration (1/6/2025)

name: Hike: Potato Chip Rock
description:
7.5 miles out and back | Hard Difficulty | Elevation Gain 2,130 feet | City of Poway, CA

Start the year with a climb and a view! Join us for a 7-mile challenging scenic hike up Mount Woodson to the iconic Potato Chip Rock — one of San Diego’s most famous photo spots. We’ll take in stunning lake and mountain views, get some fresh air, and snap a few fun photos at the top. 

Safety Tips: Shade is extremely limited on this trail. Wear lightweight non-cotton clothing and head covering (hat). Use sunblock. Must carry 2L of water, coupled with electrolyte tablets. Wear a trail shoe with good traction. Bring a small backpack to carry your water, snacks, and other hiking essentials. Trekking poles recommended if you have them. Come prepared with a fully charged cellphone.

name: Hike: Pyles Peak Trail!
description:
6.2 miles out and back | Hard Difficulty | Elevation Gain 1,788 feet | Mission Trails reginal park / estimated 4Hr hike 

HIKE: PYLES PEAK TRAIL

Sunday, February 22, 830 AM, FREE

Have you always wanted to hit two summits in one day! Here is your chance to do both Cowles and Pyles peak in one go. This 6-mile trail is rated as difficult and has no shade. Be ready to challenge yourself and bring at least 2 liters of water and a hat. bring a lunch if you get hangry. 

Safety Tips: Shade is extremely limited on this trail. Wear lightweight non-cotton clothing and head covering (hat). Use sunblock. Must carry 2L of water, coupled with electrolyte tablets. Wear a trail shoe with good traction. Bring a small backpack to carry your water, snacks, and other hiking essentials. Trekking poles recommended if you have them. Come prepared with a fully charged cellphone.

name: Hill Canyon Trail Trot 5k
description:
Lace up your trail shoes and join us for the inaugural Hill Canyon Trail Trot, a scenic run along the creek through canyon trails and oak-lined paths. This fun, family-friendly race welcomes runners, walkers and hikers of all levels. 

100% of the proceeds supports the Stepping Stones Riding Program, whose mission is to connect horses and people regardless of circumstances and wealth with low cost riding lessons and horse experiences. 

Whether you're chasing a PR (fast and fun course)  or just want an incredible morning outdoors with friends, the Hill Canyon Trail Trot 5K is the perfect way to kick off your weekend while supporting a great cause. We can't wait to see you there!

Register now to lock in Early Bird pricing!  $35.00 ( plus registration fee )   December 2025 through January 2026!

Medals awarded for 1st, 2nd and 3rd place age group winners, M & F .  Age groups: 13 & Under, 14-19, 20-29 30-39,40-49,50-59,60-69,70 & over.

Kiddie K finishers will receive participant awards.

name: Hoag Kids Run The OC
description:
The Kids Run the OC is a 10-12 week program in which students accumulate 25+ miles through fun games & activities led by a volunteer coach at their school. The goal of the program is to build a lifelong love of fitness in all students, while building healthy habits and making new friends. The last mile of the training program is run at The Kids Run Final Mile Event during the first weekend in May. The Kids Run The OC Final Mile Event is presented by Hoag Hospital.

For safety purposes, this event is limited to children from participating schools ONLY. Not sure if your school is involved this year? Check HERE.

PLEASE NOTE: Participants in this event are limited to children and select coaches. Please do not register for this event as an adult or parent.

name: Hollywood Sign Run | Hike - 8M | 8K | 5K | Kid
description:
Experience the thrill of the Hollywood Sign Run/Hike in Griffith Park—now featuring a scenic out-and-back course to the Hollywood Sign Viewpoint! Take in sweeping views of Downtown Los Angeles, the Griffith Observatory, and a stunning close-up of the world-famous Hollywood Sign.
Whether you're a seasoned trail runner or a hiking enthusiast, this event offers an unforgettable adventure for all levels. Traverse iconic trails, soak in the natural beauty of the park, and connect with fellow outdoor lovers along the way.
Challenge yourself, take in the views, and be part of an inspiring day in one of L.A.’s most legendary landscapes.
 
All participants receive the following items and perks:
  • Picturesque, scenic, and well marked out and back courses
  • Panoramic views of the Observatory, Downtown Los Angeles, and an up close view of the Hollywood Sign (8M Only)
  • Stunning views of Glendale, DreamWorks Campus, and the Los Angeles River
  • Enjoy unparalleled views of the San Fernando Valley, Warner Bros. Studios, and the Disney Animation Building. Plus a special turn-around at Cathy’s Corner, the iconic film location from the Academy Award-winning movie La La Land.(8K only)
  • Ultra-soft, ultra-comfy premium gender specific short sleeve t-shirt*
  • Unique Finisher’s medal for all participants
  • Special award for Overall and Age Grade Division Winners
  • Prize from our sponsors for overall winners
  • Free Photos (w/ Mt. Lee and the Hollywood Sign, the Observatory, and DTLA, 8M Only)
  • Fast and accurate chip time results
  • Course Aid Stations (1-4) with medical staff
  • Volunteer Support
  • Gear check
  • Finish Line Fruit, Snacks, and Refreshments
  • Flexible deferral and transfer options
 
*Guaranteed T-Shirt Size Deadline is January 5th, Men or Women's cut

name: Honor Run 2026 - KCSEBA
description:
Kern County Sheriff's Employees' Benefit Association 12th Annual Honor Run

Proceeds raised from the event will be donated to the Kern County Sheriff’s Employees’ Benefit Association and will be used to assist the families of our fallen deputies by providing scholarships for the children left behind.  In addition, a portion of the money raised will be used to support the Sheriff's Activities League (SAL) supervised youth activities and programs throughout the county.

Race Day registration for 5K and 10K begins at 7:00 a.m. and ends at 7:45 a.m.  

5K and 10K runs will start at 8:15 a.m.  Race Day Registration will be $50*

Kids 1K race day registration begins at 7:00 a.m. and ends at 7:45 a.m. 

Kids 1K run will start at 8:00 a.m. Race Day Registration will be $10*

*does not include online processing fees

Online registration will close at 8:00 a.m. on Monday, March 2, 2026.  (Shirt size guaranteed if registered prior to February 5, 2026)

The race will begin at Section 2 of Hart Park with parking located around the park and near the site of the run.

This year, there will be a pre-race packet pick-up that will occur on Thursday, March 5, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. at the Kern County Regional Training Center.  The Regional Training Center is located at 962 Norris Road, Bakersfield, 93308. 

After the race - medals will be awarded for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place in each division and a runners raffle!

We look forward to seeing you and thank you for supporting this great cause!

Participants in the event are also welcome to walk the race route.  Strollers are welcome.  Runners who want to bring their leashed dogs for the run are welcome to do so.  There will be water bowls at the turnaround points for your canine buddies!!!

name: Hope in Every Step 5k
description:
Join us for the Hope in Every Step 5K Run/Walk, a community-driven event dedicated to spreading hope, resilience, and support for those in need. Whether you're a seasoned runner or taking your first steps toward a healthier lifestyle, this event is for everyone!

 

Set against the beautiful trails of Tuolumne River Regional Parkway, participants will run or walk a 3.1-mile course filled with encouragement, camaraderie, and a spirit of togetherness. Every step taken represents strength, perseverance, and the collective power of hope.

 

Proceeds from the event will benefit the Sole Support Sponsorship Program. Gather your friends and family, lace up your running shoes, and be part of a movement that turns every stride into a symbol of hope!

name: Hornitos Run
description:
The legend of Hornitos continues, with the 48th Annual Indian Gulch Hornitos Run hosted by the Merced Running Club.  Come run the historic Hornitos foothills on this road race through some of California's most beautiful range land. Select from 2, 5, and 10-mile out & back courses from the town of Hornitos to Indian Gulch. 

 

Join us for this race at the Hornitos Central Park, where you will find the starting line. All three distances are an out-and-back course along Hornitos Road. There will be aid stations at the turnarounds for the 5- and 10-mile distances. The 2-mile turnaround will be clearly marked on Hornitos Road. The total pre-registration fee for all events is $40, which includes all fees. Same-day race registration will be available for $50 per person, race day from 7:00 - 8:00 AM, cash and checks only. 

 

Packet pickup will be held race-day morning from 7:00-8:00 AM at Hornitos Park, near the start line. T-shirts will be given away for all  pre-registrations, and available first-come first-serve to same-day registrants. New this year will be professional chipped timing, provided by BizzRunningCompany. Top finishers in each 10-year age group earn a unique, race-themed award! Race registration includes a continental breakfast, and well-stocked aid stations at the 5- and 10-mile turnarounds. This year, proceeds continue to benefit the Mariposa High School Track Team, and additional donations can be made directly to the track team through this website. 

 

This is a plastic-cup-less event. Please bring your own cups and/or drinking bottles for water at aid stations. Also - as much as we love babies and dogs, we do not recommend them for this race as it is run on an open road with a narrow shoulder. Walkers are welcome on the 2 and 5 mile course; 10-mile participants should be ready to run!

 

“Golden Horseshoe” Awards go to the first male & female finishers in all age divisions: 1-9/10-19/20-19/30-39/40-49/50-59/60-69/70+

 

Merced Running Club Members: Use your Coupon Code to receive $5 off registration!

name: Hungry Dog Dash 2026
description:
Whether you are a serious distance runner or a casual weekend warrior, come join us for the 13th annual Hungry Dog Dash 5K run/walk on Sunday, February 8, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. The course will be fast, flat and beautiful as you run along one of San Diego’s most spectacular waterways in Liberty Station, Point Loma.

We look forward to once again hosting runners and walkers of all skill levels and ages at our USAT&F certified course and sanctioned event.

This race is very DOG FRIENDLY! Feel free to bring your leashed, four-legged running buddy to enjoy the run with you.

All proceeds from The Hungry Dog Dash fundraiser go to the Point Loma High School Cross Country Team.  The event also helps raise awareness with younger students in the community about the PLHS running program. We hope you will join us for this community and family event promoting fitness and healthy lifestyles! Finish line activities will include live music, food, drinks, a local business vendor village and fun for everyone.

Please note: The deadline for us to order t-shirts is JANUARY 25, 2026. After that date we cannot guarantee shirts &/or sizes.

Thank you for your support!

PACKET PICK UP INFORMATION  Race packet pick-up is on Saturday, February 7th from 11:00am-2:00pm.  Packet pick up will be at Road Runner Sports located at 5553 Copley Drive, San Diego CA 92111. Each Packet picked up at Road Runner Sports earns PLHS $1.50!

https://stores.roadrunnersports.com/ca/sandiego/running-shoe-store-101.html

We strongly encourage participants to pick up bibs on Saturday to avoid long lines on race day.  If you registered after the guaranteed t-shirt deadline on 1/25, you have a better chance of getting a shirt on Saturday. 

If picking up your packet on race day, please give yourself ample time.

name: Huntington Lake Triathlon, 5k & 10k
description:
What will you find at the Huntington Lake triathlon?

+ Finisher's Medal
+ Event T-Shirt
+ Pancake breakfast
+ Rosa Brother's Chocolate Milk
+ Prizes and Giveaways
+ Complimentary Race Photos

The Huntington Lake Triathlon is a fun and challenging race in an incredible location in Lakeshore, CA near the China Peak Resort. This event features a lake swim in Huntington Lake, a challenging road bike course, and a ‘high altitude’ run, which is part trail and part paved, finishes the race. Each athlete registered for the Huntington Lake Triathlon will receive a custom t-shirt, athlete goody bag, swim cap, post-race meal, and be eligible for raffle prizes and race awards three-deep in each division. Take the weekend and come up and enjoy this fun event with your family.

Note: A USAT membership is required for the Triathlon, (but not the 5k/10k)  If you do not have one, you can purchase one during the registration process.

Parking: There is a $10 vehicle entrance fee.  We recommend car pooling if possible.

Volunteer: Earn a future discounted multisport or free run! Transferable and never expires.

name: Impact 5K:  Dash Thru the 80s
description:
IMPACT 5K:  DASH THRU THE 80s STRIKES BACK!

Join us on FEBRUARY 22nd for a day to support addiction recovery!

Check in starts at 6AM, the 5K starts promptly at 8am.  Join us for an inspiring and impactful day at the second annual Impact Drug & Alcohol Treatment Center 5K Run/Walk at the picturesque Hahamongna Watershed Park in Pasadena. This exciting event is designed to bring together our community in support of a healthier, safer, and more vibrant Pasadena.

COME IN YOUR BEST 80s GEAR!  

We will be rocking to the sounds of 80s tribute band THE SKINNY TIES

Dash Thru the 80s will host a costume contest with amazing prizes and judged by KROQ's Megan Holiday!

Impact has been active in the treatment of addiction for men and women for over 50 years.  Our ability to continue this level of care comes because of the generosity of our supporters.  This event, and the funds raised, will go a long way toward making sure that we can continue the simple promise we make to everyone still lost in the fog of addiction:  we're here when you're ready.

We can't wait to see you all at Hahamongna Park!

name: Ironstone Vineyards Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, March 29, 2026 starting at 10:00am for an exciting new event that features Ironstone Vineyards. Ironstone Vineyards is a premier Calaveras County destination with Wine Tasting, Dining and Estate Tours. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine and camaraderie this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: IRVINE 4th of July-Red, White, & Blue 5k & 1 Mile
description:
Click here to LOOK UP your bib number that you got assigned

https://runsignup.com/Race/FindARunner/?raceId=60114

 

So Cal’s 4th of July RED, WHITE, & BLUE 5k & 1 Mile

Saturday, July 4, 2026 | 8:30 AM
Irvine Valley College – Lot 5
5500 Irvine Center Dr., Irvine, CA 92618
(Entrance off Jeffrey. All other campus entrances will be closed.)

 
Flat and fast out-and-back course entirely on the Irvine Valley College campus
8:30 AM Mass Start, following a live National Anthem performance
Professional National Anthem singer will kick off the race
Live Fife & Drum Corps will entertain before the race and be available for fun photo ops
(Insider tip: ask them about their running times—they're cross-country athletes under those uniforms, adding authentic talent to this historical tribute!)
Patriotic atmosphere with live music, great selfie moments, and a vibrant community vibe
Bring your best FREEDOM energy and come ready to race, run, jog, or walk this healthy, high-spirited way to start your 4th of July
Custom shirts, huge finisher medals, chip timing, and age group awards
 

Bib & Shirt Pickup
Race Morning Pickup:
Begins at 6:30 AM in Lot 5
– Includes music, a selfie booth, and the awards area
– You may pick up for others; no ID required

Optional Early Packet Pickup:
Friday, July 3 | 2:00–5:00 PM
Location: Manassero Farms at Irvine Valley College (enter off Jeffrey)
33 Irvine Valley, Irvine, CA 92618

Race Day Schedule
6:30 AM– Race Day Registration & Bib/Shirt Pickup Opens
7:00 AM– Live Fife & Drums + Heritage Song Performances
8:00 AM – Diaper Dash (50 yards out & back)
8:05 AM – 1-Mile Fun Run (Can run with kids or as part of the combo option)
8:15 AM – Opening Ceremony + “Born in the USA” Singalong & Warm-Up
8:30 AM – 5K MASS START
9:15 AM – Overall Winners Announced
9:30 AM – Age Division Awards Begin

 

Food & Refreshments
Bring cash for fun food options at the finish line! Here's what to expect:

Specialty coffee drinks from a local coffee vendor
Delicious cookies from Galletina’s
Fresh fruit to refresh post-race
Our FAMOUS Street Tacos and Tamales—a crowd favorite!
You can pre-purchase food vouchers as an add-on during registration.

 
🎖 What’s Included with Registration🎖
Custom 4th of July themed race shirt (front and back design)
Huge 4-inch custom-cast finisher medal
Chip-timed results with a custom race bib
Water and fruit at the finish line
Eligibility for age group and overall awards
 
🏆Awards
Top 3 Male & Female Overall
5K & 1-Mile Age Group Awards (3 deep in 5-year increments):
1–10, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80–84, 85+
 
Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Important Note for Combo Runners (5K + 1-Mile)
If you are running both the 5K and the 1-Mile:

Use only one bib at a time
Stash your unused bib away from the start/finish mats
If doing the 1-Mile Fun Run with your kids, wear your Fun Run bib and leave your 5K bib at the first aid/water station tent near the finish line
Following these steps helps avoid timing issues and ensures your results are accurate. Thank you!


Weather
Rain or shine—the event will go on! Celebrate your freedom and fitness this 4th of July.

 
🚗 Parking
Irvine Valley College requires a $5 parking fee per vehicle
You can purchase online during registration or pay on race day
Display your parking pass on the driver's side dashboard
Entrance allowed only from Jeffrey Road (Irvine Center Dr. entrance will be closed for the course)
Race staging takes place in the southeast corner of Lot 5, between the Manassero Farm Stand and the two-story Performing Arts building. We are the only event on campus that day.

 
Hosted by Caren Ware Events
Professionally chip-timed by Itz About Time
Offering fun, fitness, and community for everybody—and every BODY!

name: Island Spring Half Marathon
description:
Event Date: April 26th, 2026
We kick off the Island Race Series with a fundraiser for the Alameda Hospital Foundation. 2026 is special because we have added a Half Marathon to this event
Run both the Spring Half and the Island Festival Half and receive a customer "half and half" hoodie. 
This race will take place at Faction brewery and feature all the beautiful views, flats course and post race expo that you are used to at our September event.

 

Event Schedule:
  • 4/23 - 4/25/26 ~ Packet pick up: Lauren's Closet 1420 Park St. Alameda. Ca. 10:00am - 5:00pm
  • 4/26/26 ~ Race morning registration opens at 6:45am: Faction Brewery 2501 Monarch st / Alameda Point
     
General Overview: 
All of the runs will showcase parts of Alameda point, new parks on the west end of Alameda, the USS Hornet and coastal trails. the course is flat and fast with the 10k returning to be part of the USATF 10K circuit. 

 

there will also be music from DJ Mike, food and and age group winner awards presented by Burneikis law. Come enjoy a fun local race with a community feel, and support a great beneficiary in the Alameda Hospital Foundation. 
 
Race Details

Race times are as follows:
  • Half Marathon - 7:45am
  • 10K - 08:00am 
  • 5k - 08:15am
  • Family fun run time TBD 9:45am

name: Judgment Day Half Marathon, 10K & 5K Run/Walk
description:
THE LAST RACE IN OUR SERIES, JUDGMENT DAY...ONE OF THE BEST COURSES IN THE VALLEY!

HALF MARATHON DESCRIPTION:

A VERY SCENIC COURSE. IT STARTS & FINISHES AT THE HISTORIC SAM LYNN BALLPARK. YOU WILL RUN OUT THE BACK GATE TO THE PAVED KERN RIVER PAVED TRAIL (EAST) INTO THE PANORAMA VISTA PRESERVE (DIRT TRAILS) FOR A 3.5 MILE LOOP, AND THEN BACK ONTO THE KERN RIVER PAVED TRAIL TO CHINA GRADE ROAD.  RUNNERS WILL TURN RIGHT ONTO THE ALFRED HARRELL HWY/CHINA GRADE LOOP (CLOSED ROAD) - YES THAT'S A CHALLENGING 1 MILE CLIMB UP TO THE PANORAMA BLUFFS, BUT EVERYONE LOVES IT, AND JUDGMENT DAY WOULDN'T BE THE SAME WITHOUT IT! ONCE AT THE TOP, YOU WILL CONTINUE THROUGH PANORAMA PARK ALONG THE BLUFFS WITH AWESOME VISTA VIEWS, BEFORE SWEEPING BACK DOWN (CLOSED MANOR STREET EXIT) TO THE PAVED RUNNING TRAIL ALONG THE KERN RIVER, AND FINISHING BACK INSIDE THE BALLPARK. 

10K COURSE DESCRIPTION:

OUR 10K WAS INTRODUCED IN 2025, AND IT DID NOT DISSAPPOINT!

YOU WILL START WITH THE HALF MARATHON RUNNERS, STARTING INSIDE THE HISTORIC SAM LYNN BALLPARK, AND RUNNING OUT THE BACK GATE TO THE PAVED KERN RIVER PAVED TRAIL (EAST). AT MILE 2.8, THERE WILL BE "SPLIT" WHERE THE HALF MARATHON GOES LEFT, AND THE 10K COURSE GOES RIGHT, AND UP THE 0.40 MILE DIRT TRAIL, ABOUT 190' ELEVATION GAIN (STRAVA CALLS IT BLUFF HILL). ONCE AT THE TOP, YOU WILL JOIN THE PANAROMA PAVED TRAIL, AND CONTINUE THROUGH PANORAMA PARK ALONG THE BLUFFS WITH AWESOME VISTA VIEWS, BEFORE SWEEPING BACK DOWN (CLOSED MANOR STREET EXIT) TO THE PAVED RUNNING TRAIL ALONG THE KERN RIVER, AND FINISHING BACK INSIDE THE BALLPARK. 

THESE COURSES HAVE EVERYTHING! START/FINISH INSIDE THE BALLPARK ON GRASS, PAVED TRAILS, DIRT TRAILS, PAVED (CLOSED) ROADS, AN UPHILL, A DOWNHILL, AND LOTS OF FUN!!  

5K COURSE DESCRIPTION:

START & FINISH FROM INSIDE SAM LYNN BALLPARK, IT'S AN OUT & BACK, ALL ON THE KERN RIVER (PAVED) TRAIL. IT IS FAST & FLAT!!

HALF MARATHON & 10K START TIME: 7:30AM
5K START TIME: 7:40AM

Aid Stations at Miles: 1.4, 3.6, 6.1, 7.1, 9.1, 10, and 11.6.

Porta Potties at Miles: 1.5, 3.6, 6.1, 7.1, 10, and 11.5

WHAT MAKES THIS EVENT STAND OUT?

  • Plenty of Aid Stations, and they are FUN and go ALL OUT FOR YOU!!
  • Interactive Race Day Experience with RaceJoy
  • Live Results Texted to Phone
  • FREE Hot Breakfast, Made Fresh
  • FREE La Rosa's Fruit Bars 
  • FREE Race Photos

  • Water, Electrolit, and GU, on the Course

  • Top Age Group Awards

  • Men's Race Short-Sleeve Shirt
  • Awesome Finisher Medals

Celebrate America’s independence with the July 4th Freedom Run — where every stride honors liberty, courage, and the spirit of freedom.
Whether you walk, jog, or race your heart out, come together to move for what unites us all.

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Juneteenth Freedom Run/Walk
description:
The Juneteenth Freedom 5K/5 Mile Run is an event that goes beyond just a race. Juneteenth commemorates the day when 250,000 slaves in Texas, which became the last bastion for slavery during the final days of the Civil War, were declared free.

All participants in the live and virtual race will receive a tech shirt and medal. The live 5K/5 Mile race will have placement awards.

NEW THIS YEAR: Kids' age group awards and cash prizes for breaking the course record for the 5K and 5 mile races.

The 5 Mile race is a 20-point race in the Central Valley Runner of the Year series.

name: JW House Hope Run
description: Join us at Vasona Lake Park in Los Gatos for the JW House Hope Run, a 5K and 10K supporting families in medical crisis run by the JW House Student Board. Both races begin at 9:00 AM at the Pier Parking Lot and follow a scenic course along the lake and the surrounding park trails. We are open to all runners, walkers, and teams! The course is fully accessible and stroller-friendly, perfect for all families and participants of all levels of experience. All proceeds benefit JW House and help keep families together during medical emergencies.

name: Kaweah Lake Bottom Trail Run
description:
Get ready to join the fun as we roll out the Second Annual Kaweah Lake Bottom Trail Run - a fun and scenic adventure along the empty Kaweah Lake Bottom! After an incredible sold-out inaugural race (two weeks early!), we're thrilled to welcome back our runners for another unforgettable day on the trails.

Enjoy breathtaking views, perfect fall weather (God willing), and a friendly community atmosphere as you take on either the 5K or 10K course. Whether you're chasing a new PR or just out to enjoy nature with friends, this event is all about having fun, great company, and a little bit of post-race celebration!

Delicious post-race food, music, and fellowship await at the finish line - all while supporting a good cause. Spots will be limited again this year, so mark your calendar, signups open May 14, 2026. This year will be even better than last year.

All proceeds to benefit St. Anthony Retreat & Conference Center. St. Anthony is a peaceful and naturally beautiful setting for individual and group retreats, as well as both religious and secular conferences and gatherings. St. Anthony Retreat Center provides meeting space, dining and overnight accommodations for up to 100 guests. St. Anthony Retreat Center is located adjacent to the newly built Santa Teresita Youth Conference Center. For more information about St. Anthony's and Santa Teresita Youth and Conference Centers please visit their website at stanthonyretreat.org  

Parking is limited so try to CARPOOL if possible.

All Finishers Receive: 

  • Lake Bottom Finisher Tee
  • Custom Wood Medal 
  • FREE Race Photos
  • Finish Line Snacks 
  • Chip timing with live results

name: Kerman Almond Festival Scholarship Fun Run/Walk
description:
The event kicks off with a 5K Run/Walk at 9 am, funds raised go towards an Agriculture Scholarship. All family members are invited to join the fun! Following the Run/Walk, the Festival will begin at 11:00 am. Enjoy live entertainment, a variety of food vendors, an Almond Baking contest, Kids zone with bounce houses, an Agricultural-Related Photo Competition, Wine Tasting, Arts & Crafts, Car Show and much more!

The Kerman Almond Festival Fun Run/Walk is a family event with a Kids run for 12 and under and a 5K Walk or Run for participants 13 and older.

name: KID-FIT Family Fun Run 5K & 1K - All Ages
description: The KID-FIT Family Fun Run 5K offers fun for the entire family.  Competitive runners will enjoy the USATF certified and sanctioned 5K flat course. Those who want a leisurely stroll can enjoy the trail too.  All ages of students from area towns can participate in order to reap one of the scholarships awarded to the youth age groups.  Little children will enjoy the 1K and get their very own real medal!  Fun family events afterwards.  Check out the pictures of last year's race in the photos section (click on MORE tab) to see how much fun everyone had!

name: Kids’ Winter Olympics
description: Get ready for the Italian Winter Olympics at Turner Field! Kids will step into the role of Olympians for the day, competing in four safe and exciting Winter Olympics events while earning medals, celebrating teamwork, and discovering the spirit of sportsmanship. The winter-themed games, San Diego style, include a Bobsled Relay, Snowball Toss, Biathlon, and Ice Dance Freeze.  Price includes Medals, certificates, flag coloring, competition, and awards.

name: Kiwanis El Segundo PTA Run for Education 5K/10K
description:
Register before price increase at midnight April 13, 2026 

Pre-Race Day Packet Pickup: Thursday April 23rd 5-8pm, Friday April 24th 11am-7pm 

Online Registration Closes at 8pm on Friday, April 25th.  
Race Morning Packet Pick Up and In-Person registration will open at 6:30am on April 26th.
  • 5K Run/Walk is an easy-to-moderate hill course loop through local neighborhoods on closed streets. The 10K Run essentially runs the 5K loop twice.
  • 1K Fun Run for kids ages 6 to 10. 1/2K Fun Run for kids ages 2 to 5. All youth, 10 and under, registered for the 5K receive a free Fun Run entry.
  • Event includes large Post Race Finish Line Expo.
  • USA Track and Field (USATF) Sanctioned Event (26-33-160500) with Certified Courses (CA21007TEB and CA21021TEB).
  • Chip timing. Mile markers. Multiple water stations.
  • This event is a USATF Southern California Association (SCA) 2026 Road Running Grand Prix Series Event.
  • Proceeds benefit the El Segundo Unified Schools, supporting students pre-K-12th grade. 
  • Start/finish: El Segundo High School, 640 Main St, El Segundo, CA 90245. 
  • All 5K, 10K, and Fun Run participants receive custom die cast finisher medals.
  • All registrants receive custom race t-shirt (while supplies last) and goodie bag.
  • Awards: Top 3 Overall Male and Female 5K and 10K Winner Trophies; Medals for Top 3 in each age category: 0-8, 9-10, 11-12, 13-14, 15-17, (0-12 and 13-17 for 10K), 18-23, 24-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80 plus.  Team type winners each receive special medals. 
EVENT WILL BE HELD RAIN OR SHINE

name: Kiwanis River Run
description:
🌊 Kiwanis River Run – A Race with Purpose and a View!

Lace up your shoes and hit the trail for one of the Central Valley’s most scenic and feel-good races of the year! Join us for the 4th Annual Kiwanis River Run — where the beautiful San Joaquin River meets community spirit, outdoor fun, and a fantastic cause: supporting the Pediatric Trauma – Injury Prevention Program at Valley Children’s Hospital.

🎉 FOUR Distances – Something for Everyone!

     ✔️ 10K Trail Run – NEW scenic river trail!
     ✔️ 5K Run/Walk – Perfect for all fitness levels
     ✔️ 2-Mile Fun Run/Walk – Timed but low-key (no placement awards)
     ✔️ Kids’ 1/4 Mile Fun Run – Open to ages 10 & under (non-timed)

name: L.A. CHINATOWN FIRECRACKER 5K/10K/KIDDIE/PAW'ER DOG RUN/WALK & BIKE RIDE
description: L.A. Chinatown Firecracker Run Committee, Inc. (LACFRC) is a 501(C)(3) non profit organization with a non-salaried group of volunteers who donate their time and energy to organize and stage events and programs; promoting health, fitness, and cultural awareness to the greater Los Angeles community. All proceeds are reinvested in the community and surrounding areas in support of elementary schools and other non-profit organizations, providing service and programs that benefit local neighborhoods.

name: LA Classic Turkey Trot
description:
Join us for the 3rd Annual LA Classic Turkey Trot! Our event offers a 5K run/walk through beautiful Griffith Park in Los Angeles as well as a 5 Miler and 15K for those looking to challenge themselves! Run through the start and finish line at the Shane's Inspiration area in Griffith Park!

Whether you're running for a PR, running for fun, or walking, there's no better way to start the Thanksgiving holiday! Costumes are encouraged!

name: La Jolla Cove Swim
description:
Iconic Open Water Swim held in La Jolla, California the first Sunday after Labor almost every year since 1916. 

There are four swim events available on race day. 

  • 250 Meter kids race "Garibaldi Grommets"
  • 1 Mile "Sea Lions"
  • 3 Mile "Leopard Sharks"
  • 4 Mile "Whole Enchilada" Swimmers compete in both the 1 mile & 3 mile events  - there is about an hour between the 2 swims.

All swimmers receive an event t-shirt. All finishers receive a finisher's medal. There are Age Group Medals awarded that follow U.S. Masters Swimming age brackets. For the kids race it is by individual year. 8 year olds will only be competing with 8 years etc up through 12 years of age.

name: La Jolla Half Marathon & 5K
description:
The La Jolla Half Marathon is one of America's most picturesque and beautiful point-to-point races. Starting at the Del Mar Fairgrounds, the course follows a scenic coastal route before reaching the challenging climb to the summit of Torrey Pines State Park. The course then rolls atop Torrey Pines mesa, continues down through residential La Jolla Shores, and finishes at La Jolla Cove.

For those interested in a shorter option, the La Jolla Shores 5K offers a mostly downhill course and features some of the most scenic views of the last 3.1 miles of the half marathon course.

name: Laguna Hills Memorial Day Half Marathon, 5K & 10K
description:
Join us on Memorial Day to celebrate all of the great Americans and their families and supporters who have earned the right to be honored and cherished on Memorial Day each year.  The event will have three timed-races on May 26, 2025. The Half Marathon is on a picturesque and challenging course that showcases the beauty of Laguna Hills and the surrounding cities.   The 5k and 10k runs will tour the streets of Laguna Hills, and offers a distance and challenge for runners of all ages and abilities.  Children can be a part of the event by registering for the Kids Run.

*** ALL RACES START AT 7 AM ***

name: Lake Hodges Trail Duathlon
description:
THE LAKE HODGES TRAIL DUATHLON RUN | BIKE | RUN

TRAIL DUATHLON Run | Bike | Run is our one of a kind experience during our annual Lake Hodges Trail Fest. Challenge yourself and compete as and INDIVIDUAL or bring friends along for the challenge and compete as a TEAM.

We are a CUPLESS race series. Please make sure to bring some form of hydration vessel for your event. There will be no cups at aid stations.

name: Lake Hodges Trail Festival
description:
THE LAKE HODGES TRAIL RUNS & TRAIL DUATHLON- RUN | BIKE | RUN

is an annual trail running experience you don't want to miss. We offer something for the whole family to enjoy. Choose from the Lake Hodges 50K, 15K, 10k, 5k, and bring the kids for the the 1 Mile Kid's Fun Run!

 50K is a great introduction into ultra marathons, ideal for all running levels.

NEW! 25K is a great day on the trails, ideal for all running levels.

 15K is a beautiful courses for exploring new trails and accomplishing race goals.

 10K course challenges the runner with a 1,000ft gain but with a beautiful reward of the view from the summit of Bernardo Mountain Peak.

 5K is an old favorite with a new twist, exploring the lakes shore. Great for a quick run or walk.

 Stroller Trail 5K a new way to run on the trails with your little one.

The Kid’s 1 Mile Fun Run is open to children 10 and younger. This is a non-timed run. All kids receive a finisher’s medal and other treats.

 Trail Duathlon- Run | Bike | Run is our one of a kind experience to a weekend of racing. Challenge yourself and compete as and INDIVIDUAL or bring friends along for the challenge and compete as a TEAM.

We are a CUPLESS race series. Please make sure to bring some form of hydration vessel to carry hydration for your event. There will not be cups provided at aid stations.
