name: Race for Open Space
description:
Big Sur Land Trust's 2026 Race for Open Space is a one-day trail running event dedicated to fostering an appreciation of natural spaces in Monterey County and celebrating the health benefits of time spent in nature. This annual event invites runners and hikers of all ages to find wonder among Monterey County’s most iconic landscapes. This time of year will provide participants with sweeping views of green ridge lines punctuated by colorful wildflowers.

Centered around Palo Corona Regional Park, participants are invited to choose their adventure by registering for a 5K, 12K, 25K, or 35K+ trail run. Each course promises a spectacular journey through sections of the Palo Corona Backcountry, normally closed to the public. A one-mile Fun-Run will be offered for individuals of all ages and abilities.

Race for Open Space’s technical partner, Inside Trail Running, will oversee the start/finish line, trail-marking, aid stations, and participant timing/results. All activities will be offered in compliance with public health and safety guidelines. Our community is deeply passionate about our mission to inspire love of land across generations, conservation of our unique Monterey County landscapes, and access to outdoor experiences for all. 

On the day of the event, community partners and businesses such as Alvarado Street Brewery will help participants celebrate crossing the finish line with beer, food, and interactive tabling displays.

name: Race Through California 1M, 5K, 10K, 13.1, 26.2 - Now Only $15!
description:
Complete this race anytime in 2026
 
Our Race Through America Virtual Race Series continues! Each month we will race through a different state, until we've race through all of the states in America! For this race we will be racing through the great state of California!
 
We will be donating 15% of each registration to a charity* who is the leading domestic hunger relief organization with a nationwide network of 200 food banks. We hope to help feed thousands with our Race Through America Series!
 
What:  This is a virtual race. You choose to complete 1 Mile, 5K, 10K, 13.1, 26.2 or 50 Miles. You complete your race on your own and submit your time to us.  Then we ship your medal directly to you.
 
When: Complete your race anytime in 2026
 
*Medals and bibs will ship out within 2 to 5 days of signing up. 
 
Where:  You choose the course and you time yourself (you’ll report your finishing time to us).
 
Why:  To celebrate the beautiful state of California!
 
COST:  $18, which includes your medal, bib and at least 15% of every entry will be donated to charity.  

*Charity Disclaimer:
We are not a nonprofit organization — we simply believe in supporting great causes whenever we can. A portion of your race registration is donated to a charitable organization. Over the last 13 years we have donated more than $1 million to charities around the world. 

Due to certain legal restrictions, we're unable to publicly list specific charities associated with each event. However, you're welcome to email us at support@virtualrunevent.com for more information on which charity this race benefits and to get a list of our charity donations throughout the years.

description:
The Race to Cure Sarcoma (RTCS) Los Angeles brings together hundreds of members of the community who have been impacted by this disease. Each year, the Sarcoma Foundation of America raises awareness and funds for much-needed research, through RTCS events across the country. JOIN US for our annual event in Los Angeles! 

TOGETHER WE CAN FIND A CURE.

name: Race to the Flagpole
description:
The Race to the Flagpole is a community oriented race through beautiful wine country in Livermore California. The event is organized by the Livermore Granada Boosters, a local organization that has been celebrating the excellence of scholar athletes in Livermore since 1949. 

We accomplish our mission by promoting scholar athletic events with thousands of photos/video posted on our website, social media, and newsletter. Throughout the year, we recognize top individual and team achievements with Wall of Fame photos, posted throughout the community. At the end of each school year we host our Olympian Banquet for all varsity athletes and coaches. At this event, we recognize high character athletes of Livermore and Granada High Schools in 70 Varsity Sports. We induct past athletes into the Livermore Hall of Fame and award $16,000 in Scholarships to the top boy and girl student athletes from each high school.

All proceeds from the Race to the Flagpole supports these activities.

name: Radiant Futures 5K
description:
We’re lacing up for a purpose! Join us for the 3rd Annual Radiant Futures 5K: SOLE Purpose, where every step you take helps build a safer, more radiant community. Together, we’ll walk, run, and move forward in solidarity with survivors, raising awareness and support to end domestic violence and human trafficking.

This year’s 5K Run/Walk takes you through the beautiful Fountain Valley Sports Park and the scenic Mile Square Regional Park. This year's, will NOT be a certified 5K Run/Walk due to construction. 

All participants will receive a finisher medal, finish line photos and video, and access to the post-race celebration expo.

Bring your energy, your community, and your sole purpose, to make every stride count for safety, healing, and hope.

Register today before spots fill up!

name: Ramona Wine Country 5K
description:
Be sure to grab your family, friends, coworkers and come join us for one of the most fun filled events in Southern California, the Ramona Wine Country 5k. It takes place at the breathtaking Backcountry Gardens and is part trails with a splash of mud run plus a healthy dose of Mother Nature’s obstacles mixed in for fun. You’ll also find some hills, streams, boulders and much more. Not your average 5K! Everyone can do it as long as you have the drive and determination to keep going, not quit and in the words of Joe Dirt, “keep on keepin’ on." 

It’s a 1.5 mile two loop course. If two loops are too many, feel free to enjoy the single loop option. 

Oh, and don’t miss out on the Charity Solo & Team Beer Mile after the 5K is finished. All you gotta do is drink 4 beers and run 4 x400 meters Fastest individual or 2-4 person team earns the bragging rights.  

Once the fitness is over, you’ve gotta then join us across the road at the award winning Ramona Ranch Winery for a FREE wine tasting, after party with live music, and killer pizza for purchase from the Pizza Trolley. If you didn’t know, Ramona Ranch is also San Diego’s only Certified Sustainable Vineyard and Winery.  

REGISTRATION INCLUDES;
- FREE Ramona Ranch wine tasting
- Finisher’s medal
- Race swag
- Ramona Radio playing tunes
- Pizza for purchase from the Pizza Trolley
- FREE Parking 

A portion of the proceeds help support the life changing OPERATION REBOUND – FRONTLINE TO FINISH LINE: CAF’s Operation Rebound® program strengthens the mental and physical well-being of veterans, military personnel and first responders with permanent physical injuries by providing them opportunities to use sports and fitness to re-integrate into our communities and by empowering them through sports.

name: Ramona Wine Country 5K
description:
Be sure to grab your family, friends, coworkers and come join us for one of the most fun filled events in Southern California, the Ramona Wine Country 5k. It takes place at the breathtaking Backcountry Gardens and is part trails with a splash of mud run plus a healthy dose of Mother Nature’s obstacles mixed in for fun. You’ll also find some hills, streams, boulders and much more. Not your average 5K! Everyone can do it as long as you have the drive and determination to keep going, not quit and in the words of Joe Dirt, “keep on keepin’ on." 

It’s a 1.5 mile two loop course. If two loops are too many, feel free to enjoy the single loop option. 

Oh, and don’t miss out on the Charity Solo & Team Beer Mile after the 5K is finished. All you gotta do is drink 4 beers and run 4 x400 meters Fastest individual or 2-4 person team earns the bragging rights.  

Once the fitness is over, you’ve gotta then join us across the road at the award winning Ramona Ranch Winery for a FREE wine tasting, after party with live music, and killer pizza for purchase from the Pizza Trolley. If you didn’t know, Ramona Ranch is also San Diego’s only Certified Sustainable Vineyard and Winery.  

REGISTRATION INCLUDES;
- FREE Ramona Ranch wine tasting
- Finisher’s medal
- Race swag
- Ramona Radio playing tunes
- Pizza for purchase from the Pizza Trolley
- FREE Parking

name: Redondo Beach Super Bowl Sunday Race
description:
Join more than 8,000 race enthusiasts at Southern California’s greatest Super Bowl Sunday Celebration! Now in its 48th year, the Redondo Beach Super Bowl Sunday Race is a great way to celebrate the biggest day in sports and enjoy the picturesque sites of Redondo Beach: the Pacific Ocean, the Redondo Beach Historic Pier, the Marina in King Harbor, the Wyland whale mural, ocean breezes, fresh air and beautiful Southern California winter weather. Run, walk, or stroll in the Redondo Beach Super Bowl Sunday 10K Run, 5K Run/Walk, 5K Stroller Walk, Big Game Challenge, Kids 1K or Baby Buggy 10K. 

Participants and guests can also enjoy great food, beverages and a variety of running accessories at the 2-day Health & Fitness Expo.  
Start your Super Bowl Sunday on a healthy, fun and festive note and finish in plenty of time to enjoy America’s Classic - Super Bowl!

You can pick up your race bib and shirt at the Health and Fitness Expo:
Saturday, Feb. 7, 10:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m.
Sunday, Feb. 8, 6:00 a.m. - 11:00 a.m.

Expo & Start/Finish Lines Located at:
200 Portofino Way
Redondo Beach, CA 90277

name: Resolve2Run
description:
Resolve2Run team

This run benefits the Chicago Park School PTA, the Chicago Park 4-H Club, and the Peardale/Chicago Park Firefighter’s Association.
Course: Begins across the street from Chicago Park School, winds through beautiful back country roads and trails, along Rollins Lake shore, and parts of the Old Emigrant Trail,(dirt & paved terrain). No dogs are allowed on course. After Dec 19, registration does not include a race t-shirt.

The Resolve2Run 5K/10K/Walk is an annual fundraiser for the Chicago Park 4-H Club. Our club, the oldest continuously running 4-H Club in California, has been firmly planted in this community since 1929. We are committed to the youth of Nevada County, providing amazing opportunities for our 100+ members to learn and grow through our many projects, such as raising animals (beef, sheep, swine, goats, rabbits and poultry), sewing, fine arts, crafts, aeronautics, website design and development, biking, survival skills, cooking and much more. We have an emphasis on serving our community and giving back through service projects such as our Annual Fire Safe Clean Up for the elderly who are unable to care for their property. We also partner with Chicago Park School PTA and Peardale-Chicago Park Volunteer Firefighters to provide this run which is an opportunity to start the new year with healthy habits. We felt that it was important to have a run available at the time when people are making resolutions, giving them the chance to begin right away, starting with this race.

Funds raised through this event enable us to keep the enrollment costs for our members reasonable, enabling more youth to participate. We also provide scholarships for graduating seniors who have excelled in leadership and service within our community. We are participants in buying animals at the Nevada County Fair’s Youth Livestock Auction, enabling more youth to succeed in their projects and making sure they’re able to participate in the following year, as well as we’re buyers at the DC Delegates Cake Auction each year enabling youth to spend a week in our nation’s capitol learning about government and history.

We appreciate all those in our community who have supported us and we hope to reciprocate in as many ways as possible!

name: Ride 4A Reason 2026
description:
Ride 4 A Reason has 3 different routes for cyclists of every level and experience, and there's always a virtual option for those that prefer to ride with us in spirit! 

110 Miles - Ride all the way from Oakland to Sacramento!  The century ride begins at Oakland Technical High School and passes through beautiful bay area communities on the way to Sacramento. 

68 Miles - Start in Suisun City and enjoy some of the most delightful miles of R4R.  This route begins at the Suisun City train depot, and riders can choose a shuttle bus from Oakland Tech (leaves at 8 AM) or take the train/drive a car to the Suisun City train station. 

45 Miles - Our most family friendly route starts in Vacaville and has less than 600 ft of elevation gain, making it a perfect ride for anyone who is newer to long-distance cycling. This route begins at a park in Vacaville, and riders can take a shuttle bus that leaves at 8 AM from Oakland Tech to the ride start.

All rides end in Sacramento at the State Capitol with a catered lunch and a rally to celebrate the riders and highlight the need for more education funding.  Riders can choose to reserve a seat on the shuttle bus back to Oakland Tech or take Amtrak back to Oakland/Jack London Square.

name: Ride Santa Barbara 100
description:
Ride Santa Barbara returns for its 15th year!

RideSB100 offers four distinct courses to suit a range of cycling abilities – each course offering a world-class Santa Barbara cycling experience! 🚵🏻‍♂️

All courses start along the beach and follow the beautiful Santa Barbara beachfront before turning inland to experience all Santa Barbara has to offer. Cyclists will wind through some of the most exclusive neighborhoods in the country; experience the rolling foothills lined with citrus and avocado orchards and climb some of the most famous mountains in the country, all while experiencing some of the most beautiful views in southern California.

 

All cyclists will receive:

  • Official 2026 RideSB100 t-shirt
  • Official 2026 RideSB100 water bottle
  • Official RideSB100 drawstring bag with sponsor goodies
  • Fully supported aid stations
  • Mechanical support
  • Finish Line Festival with lots of food and beer
  • All Gibraltar Challenge finishers will receive a coin at the top of the hill.
  • Age group medals for Gibraltar Challenge
  • Option to buy event Jersey
  • And more!

All riders will receive an overall chip time and riders who participate in the Gibraltar Challenge will be ranked for the King and Queen of the Mountain (KOM/QOM) Jersey awards! 

 

RIDES*

 

100 mile

  • Over 9,700′ of climbing | Start Time: 7:00 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Tackle a challenging ride that begins at Chase Palm Park, rolls through Carpinteria, and continues into the scenic Lake Casitas region. Climb Toro Canyon and Ladera Lane before testing your legs on the Gibraltar Climb Challenge, a timed 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and over 2,500 ft of elevation gain. Descend, then join the 100KM Coastal Route along Cathedral Oaks through Isla Vista and past UCSB, finishing back at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100-mile/


100 KM + Climb 

  • Over 6,600 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s most stunning terrain, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Tackle the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and the steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then test your mettle on the Gibraltar Climb: a 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and a 2,551 ft elevation gain. After summiting Gibraltar, descend via the technical Painted Cave route, continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community, and return to a well-earned finish at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-climb/

 

100 KM Coastal Route 

  • 4,000 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for intermediate to experienced cyclists only
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s finest scenery, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Challenge yourself on the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then descend toward the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. From there, ride west through Isla Vista, take in breathtaking coastal views at Goleta Beach, pass the University of California, Santa Barbara, and finish back at Chase Palm Park.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-coastal/

 

34 miles 

  • Over 2,200 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 8:30 AM
  • Beginner to intermediate level cyclists 
  • Enjoy a stunning start along the coastline from Chase Palm Park before heading inland to San Ysidro Road. Tackle a gentle ascent on Mountain Drive (max 5.1% grade), then roll past the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. Continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community and finish back at Chase Palm Park. Perfect for those seeking Santa Barbara’s natural charm with just the right amount of challenge.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/34-mile/

*Event details and courses are subject to change. 

 

Charity

Ride to benefit MOVE Santa Barbara County! Help us raise needed donations and awareness for the great work they’re doing in Santa Barbara County. The mission of MOVE is to advocate for equitable county-wide infrastructure for walking, bicycling, and public transit and to empower and educate communities to choose active and sustainable forms of transportation. 

 

Refund Policy

All entry fees are NON-REFUNDABLE, no exceptions. Once we receive and accept your entry, you will not receive a refund if you cannot participate. You may do a one-time entry transfer to another event, person or year for $15.

For more information, visit our website ridesb100.com or e-mail our team at info@ridesb100.com.

 

Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter! 

Subscribe to our e-newsletter! 📧

name: Ring Out the Old – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
CHOOSE YOUR MEDAL RUN! Join us for the exhilarating "Ring out the Old" race, featuring a range of distances to suit every runner's preference. Runners have a chance to earn a unique "old" medal from High Tides Runs or our esteemed parent company, Mercury Runs. Our coveted High Tides Runs are available here!

Race Details

Location: Woodley Park, 6076 Woodley Ave, Encino, CA 91316
Parking: Free parking in the lot; more is available on Woodley Ave

Event Schedule

6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10k start
7:30am – 5k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10k)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Courses

5k route: Runners do one loop – route here
10k route: Runners do one loop – route here
Half Marathon: Route is the 10k route PLUS an added out and back to make it the full distance. Runners do two laps – route here

More about the Course
The race routes go across the grass, under the road through a tunnel, and enter the park. The 5k loops the lake and returns. The 10k and half head to the other side of the park, going under the bridge, and then journey back along a different path.

Our courses are on open paths so please be considerate of other park users!

On-Course Support
Multiple water stations are located along the routes. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, and other snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk and runner turn signs

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

name: Riverpark 5k Summer Series
description:
Join us for the 2nd Annual Riverpark 5k Summer Series!  This is a run/walk event, with the course being located on a bike path and sidewalk.  5k event starts at 6:00pm each week, and Free Kids 1k is at 5:45pm.  The starting and ending point is located at Windrow Park.  Each race is limited to first 150 registrants!

T-Shirts will be for sale at the event, or online for $20 or FREE T-shirt by registering for at least 2 of the 3 races. 

As this is a series, awards will be given to the top 3 in each age category at the conclusion of Week 3 (7/24) at Window Park.

Choose to participate with us for 1, 2, or all 3 weeks!  Plus, there is a discount for registering for all 3 races (full series)!  Each finisher in the Kids 1k races receives a finisher medal!  100% of the proceeds go towards Rio Mesa Cross Country and Track teams.

Course map is located here.

Check-in for bibs will be located in the park starting at 5:00pm each week.

Series Points for Riverpark 5k:

Age Group Points are given based on what place you get in your age group each week (please note age is based on your age on the last day of the series). If you don't place in the top 9 in your age group, you get 1 point for participating each week. Age groups are: 1-12, 13-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+.

1st Place - 10 Points

2nd Place - 8 Points

3rd Place - 7 Points

4th Place - 6 Points

5th Place - 5 Points

6th Place - 4 Points

7th Place - 3 Points

8th Place - 2 Points

9th or greater Place - 1 Point

For all inquiries, please email rapidorunning@gmail.com

name: Rock It in El Moro Canyon 6K & 10 Miler
description:
Run it, hike it, and rock it on the trails of beautiful El Moro Canyon. Treat yourself to a 6K or 10 mile run or hike with challenging climbs, descents and beautiful views of the Pacific Ocean. There's nothing like reaching the finish line on a course like this! Your memories will live on through the race photos included in registration, the shirt you'll proudly wear, and your finisher medal.  Course maps are here

Races subject to weather conditions and may be rescheduled due to rain or other event and venue restrictions. Participants will be automatically transferred to the new date, and no refunds will be given.  Please note that parking at California State Parks is $15 per vehicle, payable to the park attendant on site.  Carpool if you can!

Crystal Cove State Park - Moro Canyon lot parking opens at 6:00am.  Packet pick up opens at 6:45am in the lower Moro Canyon parking lot. 8471 N Coast Hwy, Laguna Beach, CA 92651

name: Rotary Mission Ten - Half Marathon, 10 Mile and 5K
description:
Race Day Registration and Packet/Bib pickup begins at 7:15am on January 31st, 2026

This event is in its 42nd year. It is sponsored by the Rotary Club of Hollister and all proceeds go to benefit local scholarships and charities. San Juan Bautista is a small California Mission town just off Hwy 101 approximately 50 miles south of San Jose. The four races: 1/2 marathon, 10 miles, 5k and 1 Mile kids fun run, all start and finish in front of the historic and beautiful San Juan Mission. The area is rural and the course takes runners through farm land and up the Anzar hills. Medals are awarded three deep in standard age categories. The 1/2 marathon (USATF cerfitied)  and 10 mile races  are particularly good training for upcoming spring marathons. Theme teams encouraged and trophies will be awarded to top teams. (Please keep costumes family friendly)

Fees include Long sleeve dri-tech t-shirt and finisher medal. Great training for marathon base. All races except fun run timed w/awards.



2026 Mission 10 Race Day Frequently Asked Questions & info

 

Race Day Registration, Check in & Bib Pickup:

7:15am at Mission lawn


Shirt Pickup:

7:15am at Mission lawn after check-in. 


Race Times:

8:15am - Half Marathon

8:30am - Kid’s 1 Mile Fun Run

9:00am - Ten Mile

9:15am - 5k


Race Day Prices:

Half Marathon - $70

Ten Mile - $60

5k - $45

1 Mile Fun Run - $15 


Theme Team Check in and Awards:

7:15 am – 8:00am: Registration and group entry photos.

8:30 am – Trophies Awarded to top 3 teams and winner photos taken.


Changing of Races:

Need to change from one race to another? You can do that on our registration page at mission10.com or ask for Bill Tiffany at check in on race day. 

Parking:

Street parking is available around the Mission and adjacent streets in San Juan. There is also parking available at San Juan Elementary School parking lot and adjacent field at the Alameda.


Water Stations:

Refillable water bottle station at Mission lawn. Standard water stations with paper cups along all courses.


Bathrooms:

Portables located at start/finish across from the Mission. One bathroom around the 3.5 mile from start/finish area for participants. One bathroom located by the old Mission Jail near the start/finish.


Strollers:

Families with strollers welcome in all races.


Dogs:

Well behaved dogs are welcome to run with their humans.


Medal Pickup:

Please pickup medals at the medal table after completing your race just past the finish line.


Finisher Times & Race Awards:

Finishing times will be available online at Mission10.com under RESULTS

name: RPV's Run For Myles
description:
Experience an unforgettable adventure along a picturesque road course with breathtaking views of the majestic Pacific Ocean. This nonprofit event starts and finishes at the Point Vicente Interpretive Center in Rancho Palos Verdes, CA, and directly benefits the preservation of the city's beautiful trails.

Participants are invited to enhance their impact by becoming individual fundraisers or by creating fundraising teams.

Bib pick up will be on Friday, January 30th from 4-6p at Village Runner Redondo Beach and on race day starting at 7am. Pick up your bib on Friday to avoid lines.

If you are having someone else pick up your bib, shirt and bag, they will need two things:

1. A copy of your ID (printed on paper or on their phone)
2. A printed signed copy of the waiver. You can download and print the waiver from this link

If you are picking up your own bib, you only need to bring your ID, you can sign the waiver in person.

No bibs will be given out without ID and a signed waiver. The lawyers and our insurance company require us to be strict on this, sorry for the inconvenience.

Parking is available at two locations:

Point Vicente Interpretive Center (Until 7AM ONLY)

31501 Palos Verdes Dr W
Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275

Rancho Palos Verdes City Hall

30940 Hawthorne Boulevard
Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275
(*Shuttles will transport participants from City Hall to and from the Point Vicente Interpretive Center.)

The event kicks off at 7 AM with registration open to the public for check-in. At 7:45 AM, announcements are made, and a warm-up session takes place to prepare participants. The 10K race begins promptly at 8 AM, followed by the 5K race at 8:15 AM. At 9:45 AM, the Kids’ Fun Run race takes place. Afterward, at 10:15 AM, there are announcements and awards to recognize outstanding participants.

name: Ruff Run California
description:
Join Us here for our annual obstacle run designed for people and their pups! Over 20 obstacles and growing every year- this course will test your training, your bond and your willingness to just let loose and have great time! This 20 acre course is more than just getting dirty!!! Our obstacles range from mud and water to thinking and strategy to test your bond with your pup!! Are you a team??Every year we add more challenges!  After party with music, games and vendors! Come spend the day in the beautiful high desert at 4200 ft above sea level! 

Follow our Facebook page Ruff Run California for all the info and details as well as pics from the last event!

name: Ruff Run presented by Paws of Coronado
description:
Calling all dogs (and their humans)! The Ruff Run presented by Paws of Coronado is a 5K run/walk celebrating our furry friends. Come on out to Tidelands Park on Saturday, March 7th for some tail-wagging fun! 

 

Run For A Cause

Help support the vision on Paws of Coronado for every animal to have a safe and loving forever home.

 Make an additional donation with your registration to help provide PAWS of Coronado with the instant ability to fund essential medical care, finance emergency surgeries, provide behavioral support, and make vital improvements to the shelter facility! To learn more about how your donation aids PAWS of Coronado, go to pawsofcoronado.org/. 

 

Participant Perks:

  • Official Ruff Run Dog Water Bowl
  • Exclusive Doggie Finisher Medal (can also be used as dog tag!)
  • T-shirt for Your Human!
  • Doggie Bag (Swag Bag)
  • Live Finish Results and Rankings
  • Overall & Age Group Awards
 Important Note: Our furry friends must be social and on a non-retractable leash during the run! For the safety of all dogs and humans alike!

 

Event Details

  • Run or walk a 5K with your favorite furry friend; starting/finishing at Tidelands Park on Coronado Island
  • 1.5 mile course for walkers and dogs of any ability
  • 1 aid stations available for both humans and dogs
  • No virtual race this year. If you can't join us on race morning, please email contact@easydaysports.com and we will ship your doggie for a small shipping fee!
  • Awards: all runners will be timed. Overall and age group division awards are reserved for participants who run with the dog. 

 

RACE WEEKEND AT A GLANCE:

  • 7:00am  Race Day Registration and Check-in at Coronado Tidelands Park 2000 Mullinex Dr, Coronado, CA 92118
  • 8:00am  5K & 1.5 Mile Start
  • 9:15am  Awards Presentation
  • 9:30am  Event Concludes

*Subject to Change

name: Run by the Sea
description:
Run by the Sea returns to lovely Wilder Ranch State Park on Sunday, October 4th! This unique Half Marathon, 12K run, and 4K run/walk meanders along the gorgeous coastal bluffs of California's Central Coast in Santa Cruz and consists mostly of flat, packed dirt trails. Participants will enjoy scenic coastal views while passing along the bluffs and Wilder Ranch park trails. Get ready to take in the natural beauty of the Monterey Bay, the serene flats of Wilder Ranch's meadows, and maybe even catch a glimpse of some dolphins - no other race is quite like it!

Now in its 101h year, Run by the Sea is organized by the Santa Cruz Track Club and benefits the track club's youth program, Bike Santa Cruz County, and Santa Cruz Mountain Trail Stewards.

name: Run for Austin's Lungs
description:
Run for Austin’s Lungs is a family-friendly 5K walk/run held in honor of baby Austin, who is bravely battling chronic lung disease. Join us to celebrate his first birthday, raise awareness of his Chronic Lung disease, and support his ongoing medical care. Every step taken helps give Austin the breath of a brighter future.

The entire registration fee (minus the $4 processing fee) goes directly to Austin’s care. After you register, the site will ask if you’d like to make an additional donation—this can simply be left at $0, meaning your total charge will be $54 for race registration.

If you’d prefer to support Austin without registering for the race, you can do so by selecting the Donate button instead of Sign Up.

name: Run for Breast Cancer 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎀 Join the Fight: Breast Cancer Run! 🎀

Lace up and make a difference at our annual Breast Cancer Run! Together, we can raise awareness and funds to support those affected by breast cancer. 

Enjoy a spirited day filled with community, inspiration, and hope. Let’s unite for a cause that touches us all and run for a future without breast cancer! Sign up now and help us make a lasting impact!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

For all the Coffee Lovers, this run is for you! You’ll love the shirt we send you. Set a goal, bring a friend, and join this super fun 5K/10K/13.1 Half-Marathon! The first 5 runners, we'll send you some coffee.  😊 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!

Team Glo Volunteers:

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

For all the Coffee Lovers, this run is for you! You’ll love the shirt we send you. Set a goal, bring a friend, and join this super fun 5K/10K/13.1 Half-Marathon! 

Overview:

Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.

This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

Introducing the "Run for Mental Health" - an empowering journey towards well-being! Run with purpose, run with heart for someone you know who is on that difficult journey like all of us. 
Let's break the stigma and stride towards a healthier mind! Your run can make a difference! 💙

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

Join us for the Keep Going Run for Mental Health – a powerful event to raise awareness, help reduce stigma and start conversations around mental well-being.  Support those who need it most, while improving your own mental health through the joy of movement.

Let's break the silence.  Let's keep going.  Let's make a difference.

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: RUN FOR RUSS
description:
Come out and join us at the annual “Run For Russ” 5K Run and Community Walk on Saturday, February 7, 2026. This event serves as a tribute to honor the memory of fallen Chino Police Officer Russ Miller who was killed in the line of duty by a drunk driver on February 1, 2000. We expect over 1,000 attendees this year and would like to invite you, your family and friends to show their support by participating in this great community event. All proceeds from the event go toward the Chino Police Officers Foundation which provides assistance to youth, individuals, and organizations within the city of Chino that are in need of financial assistance. For more information and history about our event and organization click HERE.


Registration includes event t-shirt, water, snacks and a pancake breakfast provided by the Chino Kiwanis Club.

• Natural fibers

name: Run for the Planet – 5K, 10K, 10M, and Half Marathon
description:
Join us for a thrilling celebration of loving our planet, environmental stewardship, and movement!

Details
Start Location: Long Beach Location TBD
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)
Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course
Course TBD 

More about the Course
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details
Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, San Diego, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

name: Run Juneteenth Day 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
On Juneteenth, we remember resilience, honor progress, and run toward a brighter future.
Join the Juneteenth Day Run — an event that celebrates freedom, community, and the unbreakable human spirit.
Let’s make every mile matter.

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)

name: Run Like a Hero: 4th of July 5k
description:
Join us for a 4th of July celebration, the Run Like a Hero 5k presented by Chico Striders and Chico Running Club. Race proceeds benefit Chico Striders Run Strong Scholarship presented to graduating high school senior athletes. Our theme this year is Run Like a Hero- wear your favorite hero costume or best Independence Day attire!

Date: Saturday July 4th, 2026 @ 7:30am
Registration: Will be available until 11:30pm on July 3rd. No race day registration is available.
Location: Sycamore Field, Bidwell Park - (Google Map)
Parking: At Vallombrosa Way, CARD HQ parking lot on Vallombrosa Ave or Woodland Ave

Bibs and Timing: Bibs will be given to all race entrants. Packet pick-up will be at Fleet Feet Thursday July 3rd between 11am-1pm. Bib pick-up can also be done the day of the race at Sycamore Field, starting at 7:00am. Timing will be performed by Chico Running Club.

Discounted Registration: Chico Striders and Chico Running Club Members receive $10 off race registration, select the Striders/CRC option Team option. For non members please select No Team. Please do not register for the discounted race fee if you are not a running club member.

Refreshments: Drinks and snacks will be provided after the race. Please stay after completing the race to cheer on other participants as they cross the finish.

Volunteers: Not ready to participate? Volunteers are needed and welcome for this race. Please click on the volunteer tab in the RunSignUp menu to sign up.

Race Insurance: Is provided by a RunSignUp partner. Chico Running Club does not provide or administer race insurance should participants elect to purchase it.

name: Run Like It's Recess 5K
description:
Join us for the 14th Annual Run Like It’s Recess 5K Run/Walk, 1K, and Toddler Run

​

5K Start Time: 9 am

1K Start Time: 10:15 am

Toddler Run Start Time: 10:45

​

This annual event is hosted by Newcomb Academy PTSA, which serves Newcomb Academy (Grades K–8), a public school in the Long Beach Unified School District.  
A school fundraiser and a way to promote health and fitness to the entire area. This family-friendly event is open to all ages and fitness levels. Stroller and wheelchair friendly.  

​

​

​

Medals will be given to all finishers with awards for the top three 5K finishers in each age group. FREE shirt and goody bag guaranteed if registered by January 7th, 2026 at 11:59 pm, after that date your shirt may not be available.


The Course: Flat, fast, and scenic. It takes place at El Dorado Park East in Long Beach, near the train and playground area. If you’re looking to set a personal record or if you just want to take it easy and take in the scenery, this is the perfect course.

name: Run Through the Pines | 5K and 10K
description:
This will be the 47th Run Through the Pines

Save the date and please follow us on our Run Through the Pines Facebook and Instagram page.

The Run Through the Pines is a destination run and a San Bernardino, Rim Mountain Community Event. It is one of the longest "running" runs in Southern California (the first one was in 1979). It features a 10K and 5K run (or walk) around Lake Gregory and through a pine tree forest.  Runners (and walkers) can enjoy a semi-paved course at a 4,720-foot elevation, which makes it a perfect little challenge for mountain locals and especially our friends from down the hill. Race day staging is at the San Moritz Lodge “Meadow” area near the Lake Gregory Company bait and tackle shop. We encourage participants of all levels, children in strollers, pets on a leash, and especially teams/groups.

Lake Gregory is located in Crestline, a charming little town filled with one-of-a-kind shops and restaurants. We encourage all runners to stay the weekend and enjoy the town.

Questions? Email the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District, info@rim-rec.org. 

Featured Events:

10K

5K

 

Registration

We prefer all participants pre-register online for a quicker check-in on the day of the run. Participants may also register on the day of the run. Same-day registration will be open onsite from 6:30 am on August 8.

Registration Dates & Fees: 

Until April 30 - $40 per participant 

May 1 - August 7 - $50 per participant 

Same Day Registration (August 8) - $60 per participant 

Run T-shirts are not included in registration fee. T-shirts are $20 per shirt. 

Timing & Awards 

RFID CHIP TIMED by ITZ ABOUT TIME  Top three overall trophies and age division awards 3 deep in the following categories: 10 & under, 11-14, 15-19. 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80 plus. 

Tentative Schedule of Run Day

6:30 AM     Check-in / Same day Registration

8:00 AM    10K Start

8:30 AM 5K Start

9:30 AM    Awards

Additional Features:

Music, water, post refreshments. 

Sponsors  

The Run Through the Pines is a mountain community event hosted by the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District and the Lake Gregory Company. The run relies on sponsors and/or local businesses and organizations to enhance the runner's experience on race day. If you would like more information on how to become a sponsor, please call the Park District Office, (909) 337-7275. 

Volunteers 

We love our volunteers and honestly, the event couldn't happen without them! We are currently looking for Registration and Race Kit Pick-up volunteers, Water Station Volunteers, Start/Finish Line Volunteers, and lots of course marshals to ensure a safe and fun event for everyone. Contact the Park District Office if you would like to volunteer. 

Parking

Parking is offered onsite at the San Moritz Lodge and in Lake Gregory parking lots. Please do not park directly in the Crest Forest Senior Citizens parking area or near their building, you will be towed. 

Questions? Email the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District, info@rim-rec.org.

name: Run to FosterHope
description:
FosterHope Sacramento Presents its 5th Annual Run to FosterHope!


Saturday, June 13th  @ William Land Park

Join us at FosterHope Sacramento's 5th Annual Run to FosterHope on Saturday, June 13th, to support our community-based programs that help stabilize and support children and youth in crisis, while providing hope for a better future. Our 5th Annual Run to FosterHope is the perfect opportunity for us to celebrate our 40th anniversary of providing hope and healing in our community! 

 

We're excited to bring back our 5k and free kids run! Scheduled on Saturday, June 13th in beautiful Land Park in Sacramento to celebrate 40 years of FosterHope! Enjoy a beautiful day at the park while helping youth in your community! 

 

The 5K course is flat and will utilize the trails in William Land Park located next to Fairytale Town, Funderland, and the Sacramento Zoo, making it an ideal route for runners and walkers. 

 

There will also be vendors, food trucks, info booths, and kids activities -  Making a fun event for everyone. All paid registrations will receive a T-Shirt and Finishing Medal. (late registrations are not guaranteed a T-shirt on race day). Join us for a day dedicated to Fostering Hope!

 

Race Day Schedule

Registration/ Packet Pickup:  7:30 am - 8:20 am

3k/5k Race Begins: 8:30 am 

Kids Fun Run Dash:  9:45 am 

Family Fun Festival:  10 am - 1pm

During the Family Fun Festival we will host a raffle for some amazing prizes and be joined by some amazing vendors! 

 

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is the race timed?

A: Yes, with chipping and timing run by A Change of Pace!

 

Q: Can I run with a stroller?

A: Yes, and we’ll have activities and games for the whole family to enjoy after the race concludes.

 

Q: What’s the course like?

A:  Runners will run two loops for the 5k on the road inside of William Land Park! The Start/Finish line is located by the Village Green at the corner of Freeport Blvd and Sutterville Rd.

 

Q:What time should participants arrive?

A: Registration opens at 7:30 and the race begins at 8:30. At registration you can pick up your bib and shirt!

 

About FosterHope Sacramento


Since 1985 FosterHope Sacramento has been providing services for El Dorado, Placer, San Joaquin, Yolo and Sacramento Counties. For 40 years FosterHope has directly impacted the lives of youth and families within the greater Sacramento region providing care, community and support. As a California licensed, 501(c)(3) nonprofit Foster Family Agency (FFA), our Care Homes are located from Stockton to Shingle Springs and from Tahoe City to Sacramento.
Federal Tax ID: 68-0073413

name: Run Your Heart Out – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag


Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

description:

Price increases to $45+fees on January 11. Walk-up Registrations will be $50+fees. Don't wait!

*Processing Fee To Be Added At Checkout

Woodley Park Section 1, Lake Balboa
6076 Woodley Ave.
Los Angeles, CA 91316

 

We're thrilled to announce the 16th Annual Run/Walk for WeSPARK 5K/10K happening on Sunday, February 22 at Woodley Park in Lake Balboa! Rally your family, friends, and teammates - it's time to move together in support of WeSPARK Cancer Support Center. With options for every pace and age, there’s truly something for everyone.

Join us for a fun-filled, family-friendly day!

  • Commemorative T-shirt & Finisher Medal for all registrants
  • Age Division Awards: 1st, 2nd & 3rd place in each group
  • NEW! Kaya Award Medals for our four-legged friends
  • Vendor Expo with community partners
  • Raffle prizes & great music

Race Highlights

  • Chip-timed 5K & 10K Courses around scenic Lake Balboa - fast, flat, and perfect for seasoned runners or casual walkers.
  • Kids FUN RUN (Ages 3–11): A short, spirited dash in Woodley Park.
  • Stroller-friendly & Dog-friendly: Bring the whole family!  

New this year, all registered dogs can compete for the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place "Kaya Medal” - a special award created in loving memory of Kaya The Husky.  

Packet Pick-Up Begins @ 7:30am

Race Begins @ 9:00am

 
All proceeds benefit WeSPARK Cancer Support Center! Learn more at www.wespark.org

Price increases to $45+fees on January 11. Walk-up Registrations will be $50+fees. Don't wait!

*Processing Fee To Be Added At Checkout

 

RACE LOCATION:
Woodley Park Section 1, Lake Balboa
6076 Woodley Ave.
Los Angeles, CA 91316

 

We're thrilled to announce the 16th Annual Run/Walk for WeSPARK 5K/10K happening on Sunday, February 22 at Woodley Park in Lake Balboa! Rally your family, friends, and teammates - it's time to move together in support of WeSPARK Cancer Support Center. With options for every pace and age, there’s truly something for everyone.

Join us for a fun-filled, family-friendly day!

  • Commemorative T-shirt & Finisher Medal for all registrants
  • Age Division Awards: 1st, 2nd & 3rd place in each group
  • NEW! Kaya Award Medals for our four-legged friends
  • Vendor Expo with community partners
  • Raffle prizes & great music

Race Highlights

  • Chip-timed 5K & 10K Courses around scenic Lake Balboa - fast, flat, and perfect for seasoned runners or casual walkers.
  • Kids FUN RUN (Ages 3–11): A short, spirited dash in Woodley Park.
  • Stroller-friendly & Dog-friendly: Bring the whole family!  

New this year, all registered dogs can compete for the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place "Kaya Medal” - a special award created in loving memory of Kaya The Husky.  

Packet Pick-Up Begins @ 7:30am

Race Begins @ 9:00am

 
All proceeds benefit WeSPARK Cancer Support Center! Learn more at www.wespark.org

Rain or Shine!

name: Runnin' To The Rig
description:
Embrace the BHS Legacy and Join us for our 2nd Runnin' To The Rig 5k Run/Walk!

Saturday, February 21st - Shot Gun Start at 8:30am and Check-in at 7:30am

Runners Start on Morrow Field / Walkers Start on Griffith Field Stadium / Embrace the Legacy Tour meets at the Water Tower near the concessions stand at Griffith Field.

Day of Race Registration 7am - 8am at Check-In Desk at Table on Morrow Field.  Cost is $40/pp

We invite you to participate with us in this FUNdraising endeavor to build community and raise funds. Our 5k course is designed as a nostalgic run/walk throughout our historic campus ending near the famous football tunnel in Griffith Stadium.   Our 2K walk will meander around campus and even through some of the buildings.  The Walk will start after the Run.  Medals given to all finishers!          

Race T-shirts can be purchased during registration for an extra fee if you pre-register  by January 30th.  We can not guarantee sizes if you register after January 30th. 

Plan to hang around after the race for pictures and selfies on historic Griffith Field. 

Don't wait, come join the fun! We are grateful for your support of Bakersfield High School. Go Blue! Once a Driller, Always a Driller!

 

Bib & T-shirt Pickup

You can pick up your race packet and t-shirt at the stadium parking lot near Griffith Stadium.

Fri. Feb. 20,  3:30-6 pm
Sat. Feb. 21,  7-8 am

name: Running Fence Run - Celebrating Christo & Jeanne-Claude's "Running Fence" - a 24.5-mile fabric fence in Sonoma & Marin Counties installed in September 1976
description:
A 2,516-Year Echo: Marathon to Running Fence​
​
On September 12, 490 BC, the Athenians defeated the Persians at the Battle of Marathon. A messenger—Pheidippides—ran from Marathon to Athens to announce the victory.​ His route measured 24.5 miles, the distance of the first Athens Olympic Marathon in 1896. The distance was changed to 26.2 miles for the 1908 London Olympics.​
​
In 1976, Christo & Jeanne-Claude’s "Running Fence" stretched 24.5 miles across Sonoma and Marin — the same length as Pheidippides’ legendary run. Christo conceived of the "Running Fence" in October 1972, following American Frank Shorter's graceful marathon victory at the Munich Olympics. The "Running Fence" was controversial requiring years of public debate before installation permits were approved. The Running Fence - Watson School Historic Park memorializes the project.

Runner's World magazine revealed a key running connection: Bob Urie, who supplied fabric for Christo's projects, was both a marathon runner and an organizer of the 1976 New York City Marathon. Despite critical dismissal of the "Running Fence' at the time as being "meaningless", it embodied themes of running and the democratic freedoms that originated in ancient Athens. Christo, having fled Soviet-bloc oppression, characterized his creation as "a scream of freedom."​ More details at RunningFenceRun.org


2026, on September 12, Runners return to the beautiful Sonoma County rural landscape of Running Fence to celebrate: ​

  •   The 50th anniversary of Christo & Jeanne-Claude’s "Running Fence"  exhibited in 1976 from September 10th - 21st.​
  •   The 2,516th anniversary of the Battle of Marathon  - September 12, 490 BC.​

Choose your distance, 5K, 10K, 1/2 Marathon, or modern 26.2 Mile Marathon, and challenge yourself while supporting great causes.

name: Running for the Rescues – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Race Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route & 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent within 24 hours of the event. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question?
Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Running Is For The Birds - 5K, 10K, Kids Run - Earth Day Celebration
description:
Amigos De Bolsa Chica, in conjunction with Bolsa Chica State Beach is hosting a run/walk/beach cleanup for Earth Day! 

Run for the Birds, Run for the Planet, Run for Earth Day at a local 5k/10k near you!

Run and walk along the beach on a flat, fast, and paved course.  The event is at Bolsa Chica State Beach, Saturday April 25, 2026 -- all races start at 8:00 AM, but be there beforehand for FREE BEACH PARKING! 

You can register to run/walk a Plover Dash 5K, Brown Pelican 10K, Fuzzy Feathers fun run (for the kiddos), 5K Plogging (picking up litter while jogging), 10K Plogging, or a Beach Clean Up with State Beach!

Every participant in the Plover Dash 5K, Brown Pelican 10K, and Plogging events will receive:

🏅 Custom Commemorative Medal – designed exclusively for this event.
👕 Limited-Edition Race Shirt – created by a local artist, featuring a different Bolsa Chica bird each year (a collectible piece of art you’ll want to wear proudly).
📸 Free Race Day Photos – downloadable and shareable, NO hidden costs.
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards – recognition for top finishers in multiple categories.
⏱️ New & Professional Chip Timing – results automatically synced to Athlinks.
🎪 Finish Line Festival – with vendors, product samples, music, and HB community vibes.

🌴 Race Day Details
📍 Location: Lot 25, Bolsa Chica State Beach
🕖 Check-in: 7:00 AM - 
🏁 5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM
🦜 Kids Fun Run: 9:00 AM
✅ FREE Beach Parking — but we encourage you to go green!
🚲 Bike to the event and enjoy our safe-keeping Bike Valet just steps from the start line.
🎒 Gear Check Available – store your personal items securely while you run.

**Fuzzy Feathers Kids Run participants receive commemorative medals & special prizes for their participation**

Check in begins at 7am in lot 25 at Bolsa Chica State Beach.  5K and 10K begin at 8am.  Kids fun run starts at 9am.  

✨ Bonus Highlights

  • Environmental Impact – proceeds go to educational programs for children, schools, & the public; optional plogging categories combine running with cleanup.

  • Community Connection – a welcoming event for runners, walkers, families, and volunteers!

Proceeds help the Amigos de Bolsa Chica's (a 501c3 non-profit established in 1976) efforts to offer environmental leadership roles to all by providing community-based education programs centered on the Bolsa Chica that create greater awareness of coastal California's threatened biodiversity. 

There is a family friendly expo before and after the race, showing what the Amigos de Bolsa Chica is all about.  Look at Bolsa Chica Ecological Reserve water samples through microscopes, learn about the wetlands and the birds that visit there, and explore what we can do to protect the environment and the wildlife of the wetlands.

Join us this Earth Day — and make your miles matter. 🌎💚
