description:
The Ruth McKenzie Table Mountain Preserve (2960 acres) is located between Friant and Prather, on the north side of Auberry Road. The main gate is 3.3 miles uphill from the intersection of Auberry Road and Millerton Road.

The McKenzie Preserve was acquired in trust from The Nature Conservancy in 1998. The property had previously been placed in a trust by its owner, Ruth Bea McKenzie, who wanted it to remain in ranching and open space after her death.The McKenzie Preserve is primarily grassland and oak woodland that slopes upward toward the basalt lava table lands that give the preserve its name.

The preserve includes a significant portion of one of the flat-topped tables that are visible from the road. In spring, rain water collects in the table’s low spots, forming vernal pools. Since the basalt is impermeable, these pools hold water for several weeks or months until it eventually evaporates. The pools provide habitat for rare plants and crustaceans that “come to life” in the presence of the water. When the pools dry up in late spring, these crustaceans become seeds or cysts in order to survive the rest of the year. On the far side of the table formations, out of sight of Auberry Road, the land slopes steeply down to the San Joaquin River. These north-facing slopes sustain an excellent mix of pine forest and chaparral. The preserve also includes a 47-acre parcel along the creek on the south side.

name: Ryan's Ranch Run
description:
Ryan’s Ranch Run is a community-driven 5K, 10K, and Kids Mile hosted at the breathtaking Thousand Hills Ranch in Pismo Beach—Ryan Teixeira’s family ranch and the heart of his legacy. This unique event blends scenic running routes with a meaningful mission, raising funds for Central Coast Athletics Foundation (CCAF) and 17 Strong, an organization founded in Ryan’s honor to provide Victory Trips to young adults battling life-threatening illness.

Runners and walkers of all ages take on a mixed-terrain course with rolling hills and the spirit of community all around. Race day begins with the inspiring 17 Strong Victory Lap, followed by the Kids Mile and the 5K/10K races. After crossing the finish line, participants enjoy a lively festival with live music, local vendors, delicious food, raffle prizes, and family-friendly fun.

Ryan’s Ranch Run isn’t just a race—it’s a celebration of resilience, community, and giving back. Each step supports two impactful nonprofits and helps continue Ryan’s legacy of strength, joy, and living life to the fullest.

name: San Diego 4th of July 5k
description: We are hosting the 1st annual San Diego 4th of July 5k in honor of Ethan Hamilton. It's a non profit event giving kids scholarships to play sports that otherwise wouldn't be able to. Giving back to the community and our future. The 5k run/walk will take place at 8am and there will be a Kids 1K Fun Run at 9:30am. In-N-Out Burger will be there serving burgers and Karl Strauss is sponsoring a beer garden.  Give aways from the San Diego Padres, SD Wave FC, Rancho Bernardo Inn, SD Gulls Hockey Club, Orangetheory, UC San Diego and many more will be raffled off along with other amazing raffled off items. Each participant will receive a raffle at packet pick up on Thursday, July 3rd from 1-6pm. Packet pick up will be located at SHAY Realtors 16611 Dove Canyon Rd. San Diego, Ca 92127. Come out for a wonderful community event, celebrating the 4th of July and honoring an amazing man who gave so much to so many!

name: San Diego 50 & Trail Runs
description:
2026 RUNNERS GUIDE: CLICK HERE

                              SAN DIEGO 50M | TRAIL MARATHON | RELAY | HALF MARATHON | SUMMIT CHASE 10M | VALLEY 5M | STROLLER 5K | KID'S 1 MILE

                       

The San Diego 50M is a great introduction into ultra marathons or your first 50M distance, ideal for all running levels.

The San Diego Trail Marathon is a staple in the trail marathon events. Enjoy a fast trail while getting to summit its high point of Raptor Ridge. 

NEW Sand Diego Trail Marathon Relay is a new format to our classic Trail Marathon. Run 13.1 before passing off to your team mate to run the last 13.1 miles finishing at our Official Finish Line. * Note there will not be a shuttle. Easy Pick Up Drop Offs available at the Piedras Parking Trail Head Parking Lot.

The San Diego Trail Heavy Half Marathon is a beautiful courses for exploring new trails and accomplishing race goals as it gives you just that little more than a half marathon.

NEW Summit Chase 10M conquer and claim the CROWN on the fast out and back course up to the top of Raptor Ridge. The fastest time out and back claims the crown.

NEW Valley 5M our flat 5 plus mile event gives you a introduction distance and amazing valley views.

NEW Stroller Trail 5k our flat 5k (3.1 Mile)  event gives you a super flat course to get out with your little ones and enjoy the day.

The Elevated Youth 1 Mile is open to children 10 and younger. This is a non-timed run. All kids receive a finisher’s shirt/medal 

                                                           Whether you sprint, run, walk, jog, or hike this event you do not want to miss.

                                             We are a CUPLESS race series. Please make sure to bring some form of hydration vessel to carry hydration for your event. There will not be cups provided at aid stations.

NEW Valley 5M our flat 5 plus mile event gives you a introduction distance and amazing valley views.

NEW Stroller Trail 5k our flat 5k (3.1 Mile)  event gives you a super flat course to get out with your little ones and enjoy the day.

name: San Diego Beach & Bay Half Marathon
description:
The San Diego Beach & Bay Half Marathon is an award-winning loop course along some of the best of San Diego’s coastline. Experience beautiful beaches to picturesque bays, you’ll run past SeaWorld, Belmont Park, Mission Beach, Pacific Beach, and Sail Bay — the best of San Diego in one unforgettable course.

With only 165 feet of total elevation gain, this is one of California’s flattest and fastest half marathons — perfect for chasing a  PR or enjoying the ultimate destination race in San Diego.

Register today and join us on April 11, 2026.

name: San Diego Holiday Half Marathon & 5K
description: The San Diego Holiday Half Marathon is a fast 13.1-mile course that starts on Penasquitos Drive in front of the Hotel Karlan (formerly, the Doubletree Golf Resort) then travels SW along Carmel Mountain Rd (your only ‘real’ hill at mile 1.5), along the 56 bike path and finishes at the beautiful Torrey Pines State Beach (pictured above!). The race includes a 711-foot net elevation drop along the “rolling” downhill bike path, which also makes it a personal best candidate. This popular winter half has been a sell-out event every year. Get your end-of-the-year PR!!!

name: San Diego MLK 5K Walk / Fun Run
description:
RESULTS:  Timed Race Results!

Walk, jog or run!  Join us on Harbor Dr. to celebrate MLK weekend in a healthy fashion with a scenic Embarcadero experience!  This 5K Walk / Fun Run celebrates the legacy of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and his dream to improve the equal participation of all in healthcare, education and workforce development.  We're inspired to help move our community toward a more healthy way of living.  What better way to do that than with the objective of completing a 5k.  Bring your family and friends (human and furry) to the Embarcadero and get moving with us!  See you at the starting line! 

 

We hope to inspire those who have never taken part in a 5K walk / run, to participate.  This event promotes health, fitness, and a general sense of well-being through a fun and engaging manner.

 

"School" option with age based pricing intended to be free for school age kids is active.  

 

We encourage you to post your photos on Social Media with #SDMLK5k.  

 

Registration includes the following. 

  • Official 5K walk / fun run Shirt.
  • Medal
  • Runners Bib
  • Chip race timing

 

5K details:

  • Start Line Location: 1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Start Time: 9:00AM
  • Finish Line Location:  (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Scenic 3.1-mile course down Harbor Dr., crossing into Seaport Village continuing along the harbor coastline and looping around back to the start.  
  • Timing offered.

 

1 Mile Cruiser Walk / Run:

  • Start Line Location: 1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Start Time: 9:00AM
  • Finish Line Location:  1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Scenic 1-mile course down Harbor Dr., crossing into Seaport Village to loop around back to the start.
  • No timing.

 

Virtual participation:  (Anytime & Anyplace!)

For participants who can’t make it to the site but still want to participate and benefit the San Diego Alpha Foundation (501c3)!  Please sign up with the virtual option.  Complete your distance anytime & anyplace during race week and post your results to the virtual leaderboard.  Your race shirt and medal will be mailed to you within 2 weeks of the event date.  

 

Race packet pickup:

  • Date:   Fri. 1/16
  • Time:  3pm - 8pm
  • Place:  Neighborhood House Association (Kearny Mesa):  5660 Copley Dr, San Diego, CA 92111.

You can also pick up the day of the 5k onsite during check in.  

 
Sponsorship Opportunities:  Please visit us here.-->MLK Weekend Sponsorship Info.

 

San Diego Alpha Foundation is a 501(c)(3) organization.  EIN 46-3297383.  We support the Zeta Sigma Lambda Chapter of Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. in fostering brotherhood, promoting academic excellence, & providing unparalleled service to the community.

name: San Fernando Valley Mile
description: The City of San Fernando invites you to lace up your shoes and run or walk your best mile! Set in the vibrant heart of San Fernando, this one-mile race is perfect for runners and walkers of all levels. The course starts at 8th Street and Maclay Avenue, taking you down the iconic Maclay Avenue and finishing just before 3rd Street. Whether you're racing for speed or strolling for fun, this is your chance to experience the energy and charm of San Fernando in a whole new way!

name: San Joaquin River Trail 10k/25k/50k
description:
Come out and run some of the best trails in the valley along Millerton Lake and the San Joaquin River. 

More info at: www.SanJoaquinRunning.com

Start/Finish: At the S. Finegold Pinic Area, located at the end of Sky Harbour Road in Friant, CA. Sky Harbor Road is located on the West side of Table Mountain Casino off of Millerton Rd. in Friant, Ca. Take Sky Harbor Rd North for approx. 6 miles and it will dead end at the South Finegold Picnic Area where parking is located. 

Start times: 50k – 0630am  •  25k – 0700am  •  10k – 0730am 

Packet Pickup/Check in: Race day at the Start/Finish area. Please arrive arrive early to get your bib, check in and hit the bathroom. NO RACE DAY ENTRIES.

Race Day Check In: 0540-0620am for 50k runners  •  0600-0655am for 25k runners •  0640-0725am for 25k runners <br /><br />

Pacers: Allowed for the 50k at Mile 16 (SJR Gorge/Aid Station #3&4)

Official cutoff for the Finish line will be 5:30pm 

Lodging: If you're traveling from out of town the nearest places to stay will be in Clovis, CA and Fresno, CA.

Camping: Camping is available on the North side of Millerton Lake and also near the 50k turnaround at the San Joaquin River Gorge Mgmt area, each is about a 30 min drive from the Start/Finish. No camping is available at the Start/Finish.

Refunds/Transfer: No refunds after 09/01/2024. Bib transfers are allowed until 10/01/2024.

Crew access: Crew access at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area near the Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground-Mile 14.5 for 50k 

Aid Stations: Aid stations will be almost every 5 miles along the course. They will have water, sports drink, gels, fruit, snacks and basic first aid. 

Drop Bags: Need to be marked "Drop bags" with bib# conspicuously written on it. They will be at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area, Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground.

name: San Joaquin River Trail Half Marathon & 10K
description:
Come out and run some of the best local trails and a half marathon course that will kick your butt. With approx. 2500' of elevation gain this course won't be your typical stroll in the park. Over 90% single track trail in the foothills, this course could easily become your new favorite. Awards will be given out to top 3 overall Male and Female and 3 deep in age-groups.

 

All Participants Receive: 
Custom Finisher medal
Custom event shirt
Custom Race Awards for Overall & Age Groups

Early Bib/Shirt Pickup
When: Friday, March 6th From 3:30-5:30pm
Where: Fleet Feet Sports Fresno 9447 N Fort Washington Suite 106 Fresno, Ca 93730
 
Race Day Bib/Shirt Pickup 
When: Saturday, March 7th 6:30-7:50am in the Start Area
 
Race Location 
San Joaquin River Gorge Special Recreation Management Area
40060 Smalley Road Auberry, CA 93602
Click here for Google Map Directions
Parking
 
Please Carpool if possible. Parking is available near the Start/Finish in the Aholul Campground, additional parking is also available in the lower & upper parking lots and on cleared dirt areas along the roadside, not on the shoulder. 
We will have volunteers directing you upon reaching the Gorge Area
 
Please DO NOT park in the Equestrian Area. 
 
If you arrive late parking will be available down on Smalley Rd.
 
Please do not block the roadway or driveways.
 
 
Race Start Times 
Half Marathon: 8:00am
10k: 8:10am
 
Course Information 
Both the 10k and Half Marathon courses are challenging with steep hills and rough terrain. If you have not run in this area before please know that this course will take you much longer than a road Half Marathon or 10k. With that in mind please plan to carry a handheld water bottle and your preferred nutrition. 
 
Aid Stations: There will be one aid station for the 10k around mile 4. It will have water, GU Gels, Skratch and other snacks.
The Half Marathon Course will have Aid Stations at mile 4, 6, 9.6, & 11.7  
Please make sure any trash stays at the aid station, do not drop it along the course. 
 
Course Markers:  The course will be marked with the following: signs with directional arrows and orange ribbon. The course should be very easy to follow so long as you look for the markers.
 

 
Weather Forecast for Auberry, CA:

 
Awards
Both Half Marathon and 10k Finishers will receive a Finishers medal.
The Half Marathon & 10k will have awards for Top 3 Overall Male & Female finishers.
The Half Marathon & 10k will go 3 deep in 10yr Age Groups for men and women.
 
Post Race
Once you finish we will have refreshments waiting for you.
Please feel free to hang out and enjoy the area and cheer on your fellow runners as they finish.

Custom Finisher medal
Custom event shirt
Custom Race Awards for Overall & Age Groups

Early Bib/Shirt Pickup
When: Friday, March 6th From 3:30-5:30pm
Where: Fleet Feet Sports Fresno 9447 N Fort Washington Suite 106 Fresno, Ca 93730
 
Race Day Bib/Shirt Pickup 
When: Saturday, March 7th 6:30-7:50am in the Start Area
 
Race Location 
San Joaquin River Gorge Special Recreation Management Area
40060 Smalley Road Auberry, CA 93602
Click here for Google Map Directions
Parking
 
Please Carpool if possible. Parking is available near the Start/Finish in the Aholul Campground, additional parking is also available in the lower & upper parking lots and on cleared dirt areas along the roadside, not on the shoulder. 
We will have volunteers directing you upon reaching the Gorge Area
 
Please DO NOT park in the Equestrian Area. 
 
If you arrive late parking will be available down on Smalley Rd.
 
Please do not block the roadway or driveways.
 
 
Race Start Times 
Half Marathon: 8:00am
10k: 8:10am
 
Course Information 
Both the 10k and Half Marathon courses are challenging with steep hills and rough terrain. If you have not run in this area before please know that this course will take you much longer than a road Half Marathon or 10k. With that in mind please plan to carry a handheld water bottle and your preferred nutrition. 
 
Aid Stations: There will be one aid station for the 10k around mile 4. It will have water, GU Gels, Skratch and other snacks.
The Half Marathon Course will have Aid Stations at mile 4, 6, 9.6, & 11.7  
Please make sure any trash stays at the aid station, do not drop it along the course. 
 
Course Markers:  The course will be marked with the following: signs with directional arrows and orange ribbon. The course should be very easy to follow so long as you look for the markers.
 

 
Weather Forecast for Auberry, CA:

 
Awards
Both Half Marathon and 10k Finishers will receive a Finishers medal.
The Half Marathon & 10k will have awards for Top 3 Overall Male & Female finishers.
The Half Marathon & 10k will go 3 deep in 10yr Age Groups for men and women.
 
Post Race
Once you finish we will have refreshments waiting for you.
Please feel free to hang out and enjoy the area and cheer on your fellow runners as they finish.

name: San Mateo PAL's 5K Run/Walk and Wellness Fair - 2026
description:
San Mateo PAL in collaboration with Stride for Awareness present:

 

PAL's 5K Run/Walk and Wellness Fair

 

Join us May 30, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. - Noon at Seal Point Park in San Mateo. This day is dedicated to supporting health and mental wellness, encouraging community partnerships and educating about diverse resources.

5K Run/Walk (Participation Fee) 
Start the day with a 5K Run or Walk on the bay trail at Seal Point Park! Strollers and dogs are welcome with mindfulness to other participants. Race T-shirt included in registration. 

Stay after the 5K Run/Walk to attend our FREE Wellness Fair at Seal Point Park that starts at 9 a.m.

****When registering for the 5K, you don't need to register for the Wellness Fair. This is included in your ticket purchase.****

 
Wellness Fair (Complimentary) 
Join San Mateo PAL for the Wellness Fair at Seal Point Park starting at 9:00 am. This fair features community, health and wellness vendors.

The Wellness Fair is FREE to all event attendees! 

-----------------------------------------------------

Start/Join a Team for the 5K Run/Walk!  
*Prize Opportunity! The Team Lead with the highest team participation on event day will win an exclusive prize.  

Create a Race Group/Team 
During registration, you will be asked the question: "Would you like to join or create a Group/Team?" Select “Yes.”  

Choose a Group Type:  

Friends and Family
Team Building
Student/Youth Groups 
Come up with a Group Name. Some ideas could be:  

Wellness Warriors 
Advocates for Awareness 
Not Fast, Just Furious 
Run Like the Winded 
Students for Mental Health 
Sole Mates 
Complete registration. Your group is now active!   

Join a Group 

Method 1 

During registration, you will be asked the question: "Would you like to join or create a Group/Team?" Select “Yes.” 

Choose the Group Name you would like to join.  

Method 2 

On the event page, navigate to the menu tab labeled “More.” Select “Group/Teams.”  

You will see a list of active groups. If you see the name of the group you want to join, click the green “Join” button. You will then be asked to register for the race to join the group.  

-----------------------------------------------------

This a community event that brings us together to support and raise awareness about the importance of health and mental well-being.

Join us on this empowering day because you and your mental health matter!

name: Sandman Tri
description: The Sandman Triathlon is one of Santa Cruz County’s oldest triathlons, having held its inaugural race in 1985, in the infancy of the sport. The Sandman is a fundraiser for the local State Parks, Lifeguard operations, and the Junior Lifeguard program. Proceeds help fund scholarships for underprivileged kids so they can receive high-quality water safety education. The Sandman Triathlon is a USAT-sanctioned event.

name: Santa Anita Derby Day 5K
description:
Race like a champion before enjoying elite horse racing. This family-friendly event has something for everyone, so gather your loved ones and get ready for an unforgettable day!

Event Highlights:
  • Scenic Course: Run or walk a 5K through the picturesque Los Angeles Arboretum, surrounded by lush greenery and stunning botanical gardens, before finishing on the iconic Santa Anita Race Track.
  • Kids' Races: Young runners can join the fun with two options—a 6-furlong race for ages 7–12, or a quick Homestretch Dash for ages 6 and under—both on the legendary horse track.
  • Post-Event Entertainment: Enjoy the lively post-race expo featuring music, food, a complimentary beer for participants 21+, and the annual Spring Carnival.
  • Free Admission to Derby Day Horse Races: All participants receive complimentary admission and parking to the Derby Day horse races.
  • Medals, Shirts & Timing: Every participant gets a finisher medal, an official event shirt, and chip timing to track your performance.
    Important Information: Registration fees are non-refundable and non-transferable.

name: Santa Barbara Running Association Resolution Run
description:
The Santa Barbara Running Association (SBRA) offers a great way to start the New Year!

Resolve to race into 2026 by joining us at Leadbetter Beach for an invigorating Santa Barbara waterfront 5K & 10K run or walk on New Year’s Day.

Runners will receive a discounted price for choosing to run both the 10K & 5K.

Runners under 18 years of age pay only $20 (plus fees), please use the following discount code when registering: UNDER18

SBRA Adult Members receive $10 off, SBRA Junior Grand Prix members race for FREE! Discount codes will be sent to all SBRA members. 

SBRA events benefit the greater running community, school, youth and club running programs throughout Santa Barbara County.

Looking for even more of a challenge, participants can double up and race both events!

 

 

Event details - January 1st, 8-11:00 AM:

9:00 AM, 5K (3.1 Miles)
9:45 AM, 10K (6.2 Miles)

 

Event options:

5K (3.1 Miles), Run or Walk (Junior Grand Prix Race)
10K (6.2 Miles), Run or Walk (Grand Prix Race)

Or do both races for the New Year’s 15K Double!

 

Race Location:

SB Waterfront Path – Start/Finish line area – Leadbetter Beach, Santa Barbara CA.

 

Packet Pickup:


Packet pickup/late registration opens at 8:00 am at Leadbetter Beach.

 

SBRA Grand Prix:

The 10K run is the inaugural SBRA Grand Prix event for 2026 (5K for the Junior Grand Prix).

Compete against fellow runners throughout the year in Santa Barbara’s best races!

Become a member of the SBRA and sign up for the Grand Prix by going to: https://sbrunning.org/

 

Registration Pricing:


All races are $50. Runners are allowed to “double up” for 15k of racing for an additional $10. Runners planning to do both races can do so for just $60.

SBRA members receive a $10 discount on registration.

Runners under 18 are only $20!  Just use the discount code provided above during registration process.

SBRA Junior Grand Prix members race free!

name: Santa Fe Springs Totally 80's 5K Fun Run/Walk
description:
The City of Santa Fe Springs is excited to announce the 2026 5K Fun Run/Walk! Celebrate the Totally 80s theme by rocking bright colors, headbands, and leg warmers while you run. This year, enjoy a new route with fresh city sights! Grab your 5K shirt with registration (while supplies last) and get ready for a fun, family-friendly run. Don’t forget to invite your friends and family to cheer you on!

Council welcome begins at 7:30 a.m.  followed by the Kids 1/4 Mile Dash, and ending with the 5K.

name: Santiago Canyon College’s Hawk's Flight 5K
description:
Join us on Saturday, March 21st, for the annual Hawks Flight 5K Run/Fun Run/Walk at Santiago Canyon College. Nestled at the foot of the stunning Santiago Mountains, our scenic campus offers a perfect setting for runners and walkers of all levels. Experience a fast, runner-friendly course that winds through lush landscapes and top-tier facilities. Whether you're aiming for a personal best or simply enjoying the view, come spread your wings and take flight with us on this unforgettable race day!

 

All proceeds from the event will be donated towards a scholarship for one female and one male student from one of our local high schools.

 

Entry fee:

  • $25 Early Registration
  • $30 Regular Registration
  • $35 Day-Of Registration

 

All runners will receive a free t-shirt with the official Hawk's Flight logo!

 

Award Tiers

Ages 30 and below (1st place, 2nd place, 3rd place)

Ages 31-40 (1st place, 2nd place, 3rd place)

Ages 41-50 (1st place, 2nd place, 3rd place)

Ages 51 & above (1st place, 2nd place, 3rd place)

All Hatchling Trotters receive a medal!

 

Award Times
5K Award Ceremony - 8:30 AM
Hatchling Trot Awards Ceremony - 8:45 AM

 

Early Race Packet Pick Up
Friday, March 20 - 9 AM - 6 PM
Gymnasium/Parking Lot 7 

Race Day Packet Pick Up
Saturday, March 21 - 6 AM - 6:45 AM
Gymnasium/Parking Lot 7

name: SAR Wild Run
description:
An event for the entire family, join us for this Fresno County Search And Rescue FUNdraiser!  Starting 1/4mi North of the intersection of Dinkey Creek Rd. & Fishing Club Rd, on the South side of Shaver Lake, experience the beautiful Sierra scenery of Shaver Lake, breathtaking meadows, forests and cool streams all for a good cause. Participants receive a technical event shirt, unique medallion, chip timing and BBQ prepared by the Fresno County Sheriff's Search and Rescue Team!

The 10k Trail Run is a 20 point race in the CLASSIC Runner of the Year Series.

name: Sasquatch Trail Run
description:
There is noises coming from the Dry Creek Preserve...Just before summer Sasquatch makes an appearance for just one day in the month of May. Are you ready to race through the Dry Creek Preserve and come face to face with Sasquatch? This Premier 5k has high end Swag and is a family friendly event. Bring your camera and let's hope you aren't the slowest runner

This is a Live Race and on Private Property

All Finisher's Receive:

  • Sasquatch Finisher T-Shirt (Size not guaranteed after 5/4/25
  • Custom Medal for all Adult Participants
  • FREE Race Photos
  • Bananas and Muffins
  • Music
  • Chip Timed with Live Results

Age Groups: 19 and under, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+

Kids Race (Age 12 and under)

  • Sasquatch T-shirt
  • Sasquatch Kids Finisher Medal
  • FREE Race Photos
  • Kid Snacks

Who we Support

A large portion of proceeds will be donated to Dry Creek Preserve in Woodlake, CA. The property is 152 Acres and is free to the public.

Sequoia Riverlands Trust is a nonprofit organization that owns and manages six nature preserves including Dry Creek Preserve. It is our mission to keep these beautiful places open for the public. Accordingly, there is no fee to visit our preserves. However, we do ask that you donate to help us keep these spaces available for generations to come.

Event organized by Sierra Cascades Muiltisport Productions

name: SCAD Research Inc. - Giving Tuesday Campaign
description:
Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection (SCAD) is a little-known and often misunderstood cause of heart attacks. Most patients are young, healthy, active women who have none of the typical risk factors for heart disease. Although less common, SCAD can affect men as well. It can recur—and it can be fatal. More research is urgently needed to identify the causes and determine the most effective treatments.

SCAD is the #1 cause of heart attacks in women under age 50, including pregnant women and new mothers.

This holiday season, we invite you to support this vital work. Your contribution helps fund research that brings us closer to answers, improved treatments, and lives saved.

Be part of our Giving Tuesday campaign!
SCAD Research, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Your donation is tax-deductible.

name: Screenland 5K
description:
5k Starts at 9:00 am.

Follow the yellow brick road with Dorothy, Toto and the Munchkins pursued by the Wicked Witch of the West, experiencing legendary movie and television experiences. Finish on the red carpet with Scarlett O'Hara, Rhett Butler and paparazzi at our star-studded 9th Annual family fun 5K adventure in the Heart of Screenland.  This year's costume contest theme is "Glitz, Glamour, Glory & Gold."

All participants will receive a commemorative bib, official time, medal, shirt, on-course support and entertainment, entrance into the post-race party, and free downloadable event photos.

Beach to City Challenge

Screenland 5K + BRA Run = Bonus bling featuring the fabulous Greta Garbo! 

This cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor called Culver City home, so we are celebrating her with the Beach to City Challenge! 

You must do both events back to back. You can do the Screenland 5K and then either the 5K or the 15K at the BRA Run and you will be able to claim the bonus medal at the finish line festival of the BRA Run on August 24, 2025 at Dockweiler Beach.  If you missed Screenland in 2024, you can start the challenge at Screenland in March and finish it at BRA Run in August.

We will be publishing a list of those who are qualified on the BRA Run website in August, before that event. You can check there to make sure we have you on the list after you register.

Sign up for both events at the same time or register for the BRA Run at the finish line festival after the Screenland 5K in 2025, and get a discount on registration.

More info about the BRA Run 5k & 13K at www.BRArunLA.com.

name: SD HipHop 5k
description:
SD HipHop 5K Run/Walk

October 18, 2026

Gather the family to come out and celebrate a fun and festive run/walk at the 7th Annual SD HipHop 5k. And we our proud to announce that we are also offering a virtual challenge.You can run, cycle, walk, swim or roll a certain distance in one day or a couple of days to equal  3.1 miles. Anyone of any ability can participate and it can be completed at any location, at your own pace. Please note that the Virtual Challenge event will not be an officially timed event.

Onsite registration will start at 6:00 am and will close at 7:45 am. The race will start promptly at 8:00 am. Runners and walkers are encouraged to bring their lounge chairs and canopies to attend the festival after the 5k Run/Walk.

Packet pickup location and time: Please find our Hip Hop 5K booth at 1655 Euclid Ave, San Diego, CA 92105 anytime between 10:30AM-3:00PM. 

 

Please note that registration fees are non-refundable. Additional race information can be found at www.sdhiphop5k.com

We also have sponsorship opportunities available. Please fill out the Sponsor form at www.sdhiphop5k.com. 

*This is a family-friendly and kid-friendly event. *T-shirts are give-aways and are given away to registrants until we run out

name: Shadow of the Giants 50k & 20k Run
description:
Event Information:

 36th Annual Shadow of the Giants 20k & 50k
Experience the Magic of the Sierra National Forest
Join us for the 36th Annual Shadow of the Giants 20k & 50k, an unforgettable race through the scenic and historic trails of the Sierra National Forest. 

Time Limit for 50k: 8 hours - 9hours with an Early Start

Important Notice: Pets are not allowed on the trail, so please leave your furry friends at home.

Pre-Race Accommodations and Dinner
For those interested, we are offering the option to stay onsite the night before the race on Friday, June 6th at Camp Green Meadows in the dorms. Additionally, join us for our traditional pre-race lasagna dinner on Friday, June 5th at approximately 5:45 PM in the Green Meadows Dining Hall.

Race Day Schedule
50k Start Time: 7:00 AM
20k Start Time: 7:15 AM
Early Starts Available: 6:00 AM (Early starters are not eligible for overall awards, they are eligible for Age Group Awards)

Course Information
Detailed course maps and updates will be provided, closer to the race day

Aid Stations: Located roughly 5-7 miles apart, our aid stations will be well-stocked with food, Gels, Electrolyte drink, water, Coca-Cola, ginger ale, and a variety of sweet and salty snacks.

Guidelines:

No pacers.
No dogs.

Poles are permitted.
Fun and smiles are mandatory!

Post-Race Celebration
After the race, you’re invited to hang out at Green Meadows to cheer on fellow runners. Post-race food and beverages will be provided in the Dining Hall. Bring a chair, a pop-up tent or umbrella, and enjoy the camaraderie.

BIB Pickup

When: Friday, June 5th
Time: 3:00 PM - 5:30 PM
Where: Camp Green Meadows Outdoor School in Fish Camp, CA, in the Cafeteria
Race Day Bib Pick-Up:

When: Saturday, June 6th
Time: 5:40 AM - 6:45 AM
Where: Cafeteria at Camp Green Meadow Outdoor School
Note: No pets or dogs are allowed on the Green Meadows Campus, except for service animals.

Staying at Camp Green Meadows
Arrival: Do not arrive before 1:15 PM on Friday, June 5th
Check-In: Begins at 1:30 PM in the Cafeteria. Bunks are first-come, first-served. No check-ins after 8:00 PM.
What to Bring: Bedding, pillow, sleeping bag/blankets
Shared Space Etiquette: Respect others and keep noise levels down. Quiet time starts at 9:00 PM.
Facilities: Showers and restrooms available onsite.
Trash: All trash must be removed before departure.
Camping: Tent camping is not allowed on campus. There is dispersed camping in the area. 
Parking: Large or oversized vehicles like RVs are not permitted on campus. You may park on nearby Forest Service Roads.

Pre-Race Dinner
If you’ve purchased a ticket for our pre-race dinner, it will start around 5:45 PM - 6:00 PM in the Cafeteria at Camp Green Meadows. The dinner will include lasagna, salad, bread, and drinks. No additional tickets will be sold as meals are prepared based on pre-orders.

Parking Guidelines
Do Not Block Roadways: Ensure clear access in and out of Green Meadows.
Parking Locations: Once the parking lot at Green Meadows is full, you may park on the shoulder of the camp entrance or on the dirt road shoulder just before the camp entrance. Do not block roadways.
Alternative Parking: You may park off Jackson Road near the final turn down onto the single track that leads to the finish line. It’s a pleasant half-mile walk from there with no parking issues.
Changing Distances
You may switch to the 20k distance at any time up until race day. Changes can be made at bib pick-up or at the timing tent at the start/finish area.

Course Cutoff
The cutoff time for completing the 50k course is 3:00 PM. Early starters (6:00 AM start) have until 3:00 PM to finish, giving them a total of 9 hours.

Start Times for Saturday, June 6th, 2026
50k Early Start: 6:00 AM (Please be self-sufficient until Aid Station #2)
50k Regular Start: 7:00 AM
20k Start: 7:15 AM

You may switch to the 20k distance at any time up until race day. Changes can be made at bib pick-up or at the timing tent at the start/finish area.

The cutoff time for completing the 50k course is 3:00 PM. Early starters (6:00 AM start) have until 3:00 PM to finish, giving them a total of 9 hours.

50k Early Start: 6:00 AM (Please be self-sufficient until Aid Station #2)
50k Regular Start: 7:00 AM
20k Start: 7:15 AM

description:

name: Sharsheret West Coast Dash
description:
On Sunday, October 11, 2026, Sharsheret will gather hundreds of thrivers, caregivers, friends and supporters on the beach for our 5th Annual West Coast Dash in support of our breast and ovarian cancer work. Our run/walk will include a 5K Race, 10K Race, Family Fun Race, Virtual Race and Event Festival. Contributions excluding the value of race entry tickets are tax-deductible.

Schedule for Race Day, Sunday, October 11 (schedule subject to change)

6:00am – Parking Lots Open – First 200 cars will receive a free parking pass. Parking is $13. Please have cash available to expedite process.

7:00am – Registration and Festival Opens (Recommended 5K/10K arrival time)   

7:20am – Minyan 

8:00am – Welcome and Opening ceremony. 

8:20am - Warm Up and Walk to Start Line for 5K/10K

8:30am - 10K Start (Recommended Family Fun Race arrival time)

- 10K Race Course Map https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6202657963/ 

- 5K Race Course Map https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6202686184 

8:40am - 5K Start

9:25am – Family Fun Race Warm Up and Walk to Start Line for Family Fun Race

9:35am - Family Fun Race Start

- 1K Family Fun Race Course Map https://www.strava.com/routes/3401592517811740622  

10:00am – Awards Ceremony

BEACH CLEAN UP
Help us leave Dockweiler Beach cleaner than we found it! Join Shemesh Farms for a group beach clean up directly following the Dash.

Directions
12000 Vista Del Mar
Dockweiler Beach
Playa Del Rey, CA 90293

Waze and Apple Maps may misdirect you. Please follow the instructions below.
Freeway Route from 405N and 405S: Take the 105 Imperial Hwy past LAX towards the beach. Beach entry is at the end of Imperial Hwy where it passes Vista Del Mar.
City Streets from North: Take Pershing Drive south (NOTE ** Vista Del Mar will be closed North of Imperial Highway on race morning) until it hits Imperial Hwy. Make a right into the beach entry.
City Streets from South: Take Vista Del Mar north until it hits Imperial Hwy. Make a left into the beach entry.

Parking
Free parking: The first 200 cars will receive a free parking pass. Parking is $13 per car. Please have cash available to expedite process.
When you arrive: Please let the parking attendant know that you are with the event and be prepared with cash. The line to pay and park will get backed up so please arrive early.
Lots for parking: After you pay turn right and follow the road. There are three parking lots. We recommend parking in the 2nd lot. The 2nd lot is a 5 minute walk to the race start line and festival.
There is very limited parking in the 3rd lot and it is reserved for volunteers and those who require wheelchairs or other special needs. All race distances end in the 3rd and last lot. There is no exit from the 3rd lot while the event is going on. Anyone parked in the third lot will have to wait to leave until all races are complete. No vehicles will be able to leave the third lot before 10am.
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Celebrate our Race Grand Marshals! 

Stay tuned for more information!

Race Entry

Run or walk on this fully paved course at Dockweiler Beach, just steps from the ocean with a cool morning breeze and incredible coastal views. Join us at the race festival with food, refreshments, entertainment and more, while helping to raise funds for those facing breast cancer, ovarian cancer, or at elevated genetic risk. 

5K / 10K  - Race entry tickets include a race t-shirt and finisher’s medal. Both races will be chip timed. Recommended for elementary school-age and above. 

Family Fun Race (1K) - Race Entry tickets are for ages 1 and up and include a race t-shirt and medal. This race is open to people of all abilities and generations of families running or walking together. This race will not be chip timed. Get ready for the photo opportunity!!

Virtual Race - Join us from anywhere around the country. Race tickets purchased by September 24th will receive a race t-shirt by mail.

Become a Team Captain for your family, friends, school, synagogue or company. Win awesome prizes and make your miles meaningful. 

All ages, abilities and strollers welcome.

Visit Sharsheret.org/westcoast for more information.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Early Bird Packet Pickup Details

Thursday, October 8 from 4 - 7pm

Stay tuned for details about our LA Metro and Valley pickups!

name: Shaver Lake Mile High Triathlon
description:
GARNET FIRE UPDATE

 

The Shaver Lake Trathlon has moved to Lake Evans in the Buena Vista Recreational Area.

Due to the Garnet Fire, there is significant fire-fighting activity in and around Shaver Lake. The fire continues to spread, and air quality has been shifting rapidly between good and hazardous as wind conditions change.  We have received official notice from the Sheriff’s Office that the Triathlon cannot take place at Shaver Lake on September 14th.

 

With short notice, Kern County Parks & Recreation has graciously allowed us to relocate the event to Lake Evans on the same date.

 

Participants can complete a form to select from 3 choices..

  • Participate in the Shaver Lake Triathlon at Lake Evans on Sunday 9/14/25

  • Defer to next year

  • Transfer to another Sierra Cascades Race

 

Please do not contact the race by email to make your selection, all transfers must be done through the google form to ensure proper follow through.  We have a lot of work to do to move the race and may not be able to respond quickly this week to individual E-Mails.

 

What will you find at the Shaver Lake Triathlon at Lake Evans?

+ Fast and Flat Course
+ Finisher's Medal 
+ Event T-Shirt
+ Prizes and Giveaways
+ Finisher's Meal
+ Free Race Photos 
+ Tri-Tip sandwich lunch and bottled beverages
+ Rosa Brothers chocolate milk
+ Music
+ Largest Team Competition

GARNET FIRE UPDATE

 

The Shaver Lake Trathlon has moved to Lake Evans in the Buena Vista Recreational Area.

Due to the Garnet Fire, there is significant fire-fighting activity in and around Shaver Lake. The fire continues to spread, and air quality has been shifting rapidly between good and hazardous as wind conditions change.  We have received official notice from the Sheriff’s Office that the Triathlon cannot take place at Shaver Lake on September 14th.

 

With short notice, Kern County Parks & Recreation has graciously allowed us to relocate the event to Lake Evans on the same date.

 

Participants can complete a form to select from 3 choices..

  • Participate in the Shaver Lake Triathlon at Lake Evans on Sunday 9/14/25

  • Defer to next year

  • Transfer to another Sierra Cascades Race

 

Please do not contact the race by email to make your selection, all transfers must be done through the google form to ensure proper follow through.  We have a lot of work to do to move the race and may not be able to respond quickly this week to individual E-Mails.

 

What will you find at the Shaver Lake Triathlon at Lake Evans?

+ Fast and Flat Course
+ Finisher's Medal 
+ Event T-Shirt
+ Prizes and Giveaways
+ Finisher's Meal
+ Free Race Photos 
+ Tri-Tip sandwich lunch and bottled beverages
+ Rosa Brothers chocolate milk
+ Music
+ Largest Team Competition

name: SHAY 5K Run/Walk
description:
Spreading Help Around You is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization that was founded in 2014 in honor of Shaylyn Anela Pinoliar, who tragically passed away on November 14, 2012. Our mission is to help and support families who have lost a loved one, educate them on the importance of being prepared during such a time of loss, and provide active service to the community.  As well as promoting Pedestrian Safety Awareness. This year, we proudly launched the SHAY Scholarship Program, marking an exciting new chapter in our commitment to supporting education and empowering future leaders. 

Each year, since Shaylyn’s passing, family, friends, and community members gather to honor her memory with an Annual 5k Run/Walk on Thanksgiving morning. Last year, we moved the event to Saturday after Thanksgiving. It was a great success, and we look forward to continuing the tradition this year to honor her memory.

Run or Walk a 5K and receive an Event Shirt and a Custom Finisher's Medal.

Join or Create a Team!

Children 10 and under receive a special rate automatically during registration.

Awards and More

Age group awards for our timed 5k.
First 100 Participants receive a Custom Finisher's Medal!

Packet Pickup & Schedule

Packet Pickup - Friday, November 28, 2025

Delano Chamber of Commerce

931 High St. Delano, Ca 93215

Time: 2:00 PM to 6:00 PM 

Event Schedule: Saturday, November 29, 2025

     8:00am     Late Packet Pickup/Registration

     9:00am     5k Start Time

     10:30am   5k Awards

     11:00am    Raffle Winners

Amenities

All Participants Receive:

  • Event T-Shirt
  • Custom Finisher's Medallion
  • Race Bib *Bib numbers will be dynamically assigned.
  • Age Group Awards

Place

La Vina Middle School

1331 Browning Rd.

Delano, Ca 93215

name: Shinzen Run/Walk
description:
The Shinzen Run started over 35 years ago under the direction of Ken Takeuchi and has supported the Shinzen Garden. 

Proceeds will benefit the Shinzen Garden in memory of Ken Takeuchi.

Participants will receive:

  • T-Shirt
  • Pancake Breakfast
  • Free entry the Shinzen Garden

name: Signal Hill Rotary Mutt Run 1K & 5K
description:
FINDING HOMES - ONE DOG AT A TIME

This is why we run!

2024 Event Photos

 

Run or walk at your pace with or without your dog.  The event starts at the Claremont Launch Ramp at 5350 E. Ocean Blvd and the course follows along the scenic Long Beach shoreline. Park at the 54th & Claremont lot.

Race packet pick up is at the starting line on race day.  Please arrive by 7:30 am to allow sufficient time before the race.

 

EVENTS

  • 5K Runner-only (humans only) race starts at 8:30 am
  • 5K Mutt run (runner/walker plus dog) starts at 8:30 am
  • 1K Mutt run (runner/walker plus dog) starts at 8:45 am

DOGGIE DO'S and DON'T'S

  • All breeds of dogs welcome, not just mutts
  • Dogs must be leashed and stay on the pedestrian path at all times
  • Dogs must be non-aggressive with people and dogs

FUN INCLUSIONS AND POST-RACE EVENTS

  • Adoption event by the Long Beach Animal Care Services at the finish line and post-race festival
  • High quality race t-shirt for 1K and 5K participants
  • Finisher medal for all participants
  • Awards for top three 5K finishers

WHY WE RUN

  • 70% of proceeds will support the Long Beach Animal Care Services

name: Silicon Valley Kids Triathlon
description:
NEW LOCATION • NEW DATE 

Read below to make sure you understand the changes

The Silicon Valley Kids Triathlon (“SVKT”) is one of the country’s largest triathlons specifically for kids aged SIX through SEVENTEEN.

This year, we are moving to a new venue, the beautiful and recently opened Kathleen MacDonald High School. The swim will be in the pool and the run on the track as usual. The bike course will continue to be on closed roads. There should be plenty of parking, the bike course has easy spectator viewing, and the whole event will be more compact.

Because we are in a new venue with a smaller pool, we are cutting out some of the events that have been traditionally held in order to make the event smaller as we gain more experience with this venue.

Triathlon

There are two triathlon events to choose from. 

Competitive Triathlon is for kids aged 6 to 15 who are ready to race on their own. It is timed and there will be awards. No parents will be allowed in transition at any time. (We will have transition clinics to teach the kids everything they need to know.) Your child needs to be able to swim across the pool without stopping and without swim aids; no training wheels or balance bikes either.

The Super-Sprint is for kids 11 to 17. Kids 11 to 15 can choose the shorter distances of the traditional event or the longer distances of the Super-Sprint. 

Not sure which event to sign up for or if your child is ready for the competitive event? Read this guide.

Non-Competitive and Duathlon Events

There will be no Non-Competitive Events at this race. But Menlo Park and East Bay Kids Triathlons will still have them.

There will be no Duathlon either. There will be a Duathlon at the East Bay Kids Triathlon.

After some experience at this venue, we hope to bring these events back.

NorCal Youth State Series

This event is part of USA Triathlon's Youth State Series. Because there is so much overlap in participants, we will not have the Bay Area Kids Triathlon Series this year. We encourage everyone to participate in the entire state series, including the Sunnyvale Kids Splash and Dash (date TBD) and the Oakland Tri Club's Splash and Dash on October 25th. Series awards will be given out at the OTC Splash and Dash.

Youth Teams and Clinics

There are two youth teams in the area: TCMTriSquad Juniors in Santa Cruz and Santa Clara Counties and First Youth Triathlon Team (FYTT) in Menlo Park. Both put on clinics and workouts.

In addition, there will be several youth clinics -- especially practice tris and transition practice -- put on by Rolling Stumps Endurance. More details to be announced soon.

NEW DATE • MAY 10, 2026

Give your mom a break - race in the morning, celebrate in the afternoon!

Anyone who identifies as a mother will get a small surprise!

name: Silicon Valley PRIDE 3rd Annual 5K & 10K
description:
🏳️‍🌈 Run, Walk, or Sashay for PRIDE! 🏳️‍🌈

The Silicon Valley PRIDE 2nd Annual 5K is BACK! 2026 - We've added a 10K :)


📅 Date: Saturday, June 20, 2026
⏰ Time: 9:00 AM PDT
📍 Location: Hellyer County Park, 985 Hellyer Ave, San Jose, CA
🚗 Parking: $7 per vehicle (rideshare/public transport encouraged)

Let’s Make This Year’s PRIDE 5K Bigger & Better!

Lace up, throw on your best rainbow gear, and hit the course with runners, walkers, joggers, and fabulous strutters!

Whether you run, walk, jog, or sashay, this event is about community, inclusion, and FUN!

Choose Your Event

🏁 In-Person 5K & 10K (Ages 13+) – Join us at Hellyer Park!
🖥️ Virtual 5K & 10K – Run anytime, anywhere! (Swag delivered by USPS)


Why Sign Up?

All participants who register by May 29, 2026, will receive:
✔️ Limited-Edition PRIDE 5K T-Shirt
✔️ Chip-Timed Results (In-Person 5K Only)
✔️ A High-Energy, Fun-Filled Race Day Experience!

Spots are limited! Registrations after May 29th are not guaranteed a t-shirt.


Make a Difference!

Your participation helps support Silicon Valley PRIDE and creates a more inclusive and vibrant LGBTQ+ community.

Want to go further? Start a fundraising team or make a donation today!

Packet Pickup & Race Materials

📍 Billy DeFrank LGBTQ+ Community Center

📅 Wednesday, June 10th | 6:30 PM to 8:00 PM
📅 Friday, June 12th | 6:30 PM to 8:00 PM

💌 Virtual Runners: Swag will be mailed one week before the event!


Dress Up & Show Out!

Rock your boldest, brightest, most fabulous PRIDE outfit—or whatever makes you feel comfortable and confident!

Get Involved! Volunteer & Support

Want to be part of the magic? Sign up as a volunteer and help us create an amazing PRIDE 5K experience!

name: Silver Moon Race: Kings River
description:
The Silver Moon Race is about challenging yourself, taking your endurance ability, and miles to new heights. Perfect for those who want to elevate from half marathons to marathons to ultramarathons.

You'll run in beautiful scenic locations in a 12K or for 6, 12, 24-hours, or 100-mile race on an awesome lap course. Go solo or in a 4-person team relay with your favorite running friends.

The race is always timed on a weekend closest to the full moon. Starting right before sunset and running through the night under the vibrant glow of the full moon and stars into the sunrise the next day.

Where in the world is Reedley? It is one of our favorite hidden gems nestled in the San Joaquin Valley of central California where much of the fruit we enjoy is grown.

Experience running through a beautiful scenic farm with orchards, vineyards, under the canopy of oak trees, and along the majestic Kings River in Reedley.

Get ready to have the Silver Moon Race become one of your favorite running experiences. Register today to reserve your spot!

Learn more at SilverMoonRace.com/kings-river/

name: SJVDHA Pacing for Prevention
description:
Join the San Joaquin Valley Dental Hygienists’ Association (SJVDHA) for our annual Pacing for Prevention 5k! Together, we’ll take steps toward raising awareness and supporting groundbreaking research dedicated to the prevention, early detection, and treatment of head, neck, and oral cancers.

This year we will be raising funds to support the American Cancer Society. 

Bring your walking shoes, your friends, and your passion for making a difference!

Event Details:

Check In: 8:00am-9:00am

Race: 9:00 am

*Registration is $35 until the day of the race. Prices increase on race day to $40.

Trail: This moderately challenging 5k (3.1 miles) paved trail is stroller and dog-friendly. The path includes a few steep hills for an extra challenge and some nice views. It’s a comfortable, scenic route that’s easy to enjoy for all ages.

Event Highlights:

  • Family-friendly walk for all ages
  • Health and wellness booths
  • Opportunity to connect with local dental and health professionals
  • Oral Cancer Screenings for participants

name: Sloth Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🦥🏃‍♂️ The Sloth Run – Slow Is the New Fast! 🏃‍♀️🦥

Sloths will get there!

Tired of high-speed races and intense competition? Us too.
Welcome to the Sloth Run, where the pace is slow, the vibes are chill, and everyone's a winner (eventually).

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: SOCAL River Marathon - 26.2 - 13.1 - 10K - 5K
description:
The SOCAL River Marathon has four distances. Full Marathon, Half Marathon, 10K and 5K. 

This is a fun course in Southern California. This course runs on the Santa Ana River Trail from Yorba Linda to Huntington Beach State Park. This route truly spans Southern California from the dryer desert land to areas near Disneyland to the Beach. The course is primarily flat and straight but has a gradual downhill slant following the river to the ocean. This route is two years ago was cleaned up from homeless tents and is not fenced in nightly.

name: SoCal's Cinco De Miles 5K and 5 MILE
description:
Saturday. May 2, 2026 So Cal's Cinco de Miles 5k & 5 Miles

AT BOLSA CHICA STATE BEACH this year. 

It's a  FULL FIESTA party run! Live Mariachi.  Folclórico dancing. Festive food. 

Race, run, walk, or jog . Huge, unique custom cast medals with moving parts and a baby soft tech shirt fully designed front and back. NEW DESIGN each year. 

Come celebrate Mexican Culture with us. And be as victorious in your pursuit of health as those soldados were in their victory at the Battle of Puebla.  Sign up for 5K or 5 miles or run the 1-mile family fun run.   Have fun meeting people while celebrating culture. Running is universal.

RFIP CHIP TIMING and age division awards by Itz About Time.

COOL custom cast medals and Cinco De MILES authentic event t-shirts.  

EVERY PARTICIPANT RECEIVES: 

  • Custom Cinco de Miles cast medals
  • Cinco de Miles-themed event race shirts
  • Age division awards
  • RFID Chip timing by Itz About Time (itzabouttime.com)
  • Enjoy the music, the refreshments, and each other!
  • Caren Ware Events are designed for Every BODY and EVERYBODY! BEST THEMED ever races. 

RACE LOCATION:  This year at BOLSA CHICA STATE BEACH (lot 25.)

PARKING:  Come in the main gate at 17851 Pacific Coast Hwy, Huntington Beach, Ca. 92649 and turn right, going to the very last lot which is closest to Warner and PCH.  Have $15 in cash ready at the gate per car, or a park pass.  Credit cards slow down the entry process for other cars.   You can also find limited free and hourly parking behind the Jack in the Box on PCH and Warner and along that inner road in Sunset Beach, and jog into the state park on running sidewalk. 

EARLY RACE PACKET PICK-UP (for your convenience) or you may pick up the bib and shirt on race day at the race site.  You may pick up for others.  

Friday, May 1st .  Time and Location TBD

RACE DAY SCHEDULES:

6:30 am  Registration OPENS
               Shirts are given with bibs at registration.  Medals when you finish

7:45 am to 8:15 am Folclórico Performance, Dancing Horses, Mariachi Music

8:00 am START of Cinco de Mile fun run. (1 Mile) 

8:15 am START of Kid's Carrera. (400 yards) 

8:30 am Mass START of 5K/5 Mile

9:15 am Start of 5k AWARDS CEREMONY

9:30 am Start of the 5-mile AWARD CEREMONY

Bring EXTRA CASH FOR STREET TACOS, AGUA FRESCA, FRESH FRUIT, GALLETINAS AND SPECIALTY COFFEES.

FINISHER MEDALS to every Finisher

AGE DIVISION AWARDS:

5-year Age Spans:  3 deep with 5-year age spans:  5k and 5 Mile  1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80&over 

Top  3 Overall Trophies to Males & Females     Plus award to Oldest finisher. Youngest finisher. 

Pets: Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Stroller: Families can bring strollers, but agree to use at their own risk.  We do ask that you line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course. Note, that only registered participants with a BIB will receive a finisher medal.

Please make sure your BIB is in the front and visible to our volunteers.  And watch for cyclists enjoying the same beach bike path you are running on.

The race will take place rain or shine.  RESTROOMS are in the public buildings at the end of each of the parking lots.

name: SoCal's Sunset Trick or Trot 5k/10K - Halloween Race
description:
🎃 SoCal’s Sunset Trick or Trot 5K/10K

📅 Sunday, October 25th, 2026 | 🕔 5:00 PM (NOTE TIME. INTO the SUNSET
📍 Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25
🌅 Featuring a TRUNK-or-TREAT EXPO that begins at 3pm

 
🕯️ A Spooky New Twist on a Fall Favorite!
Formerly known as the FIT FALL Halloween Harvest 5K/10K, our traditional morning run is now even more magical as an evening event! 🌙

Get ready to run (or trot!) into the sunset with beach views, Halloween fun, and festive activities for the whole family. Introducing the SoCal’s Sunset Trick or Trot 5K/10K—a coastal celebration where fitness meets fall!

 
🎉 What to Expect:
👟 5K & 10K Sunset Run
🎃 Trunk-or-Treat Expo
📸 Selfie Stations, Games & Giveaways
🏅 Custom Reversible Finisher Medal
👕 Fall-Themed Event Shirt
🧛 Costume Contests & Awards
🧃 Street Tacos, Aguas Frescas, Specialty Coffee, Cookies & More!
 
🕒 Race Day Schedule:
2:00 PM – Trunk-or-Treat Car Setup
3:00 PM – Registration & Packet Pickup Opens
4:30 PM – Kids Races Begin
5:00 PM – Mass Start for 5K & 10K
5:45 PM – 5K Awards Ceremony
6:00 PM – 10K Awards Ceremony

🎟️ All bibs, shirts, and trick-or-treat bags will be available starting at 3:00 PM at the Trunk-or-Treat Expo. No early day pickup.

 
🚗 Trunk-or-Treat Expo
Want to be part of the Halloween magic? Decorate your trunk and hand out goodies!

Trunkers will receive 1 free race entry for a Caren Ware Event Race!

Questions? Email carenfasttrack@aol.com cc: info@kourseevents.com

 
🏁 Registration Includes:
RFID Chip Timing by Itz About Time
Fall-Themed Custom Shirt
Unique Reversible Finisher Medal
Trick-or-Treat Bag
Entry into Costume & Team Contests
Eligibility for Age Group & Overall Awards
 
🏆 Awards & Divisions:
Top 3 in each 5-year age division (ages 1–80+)
Top 3 Overall Male & Female Finishers
Best Halloween Costume
Best Uniform-Themed Costume

Awards for Oldest & Youngest Finishers
 
🐾 Pet & Stroller Friendly
Leashed pets welcome (max 5 ft leash)
Strollers allowed — please start near the back
🔖 Only registered participants with a bib receive medals.
 
🌊 The Course:
Flat, fast, paved, and scenic
Ocean views all the way!
Start/Finish in Lot 25 – Bolsa Chica State Beach


🚘 Parking Options:

Park in Sunset Beach and walk in
OR enter via Bolsa Chica State Beach Main Gate ($15 Entrance Fee)
 
🧡 Part of the Winter Series!
Complete 3 of the following Caren Ware Events to earn a 4th medal—FREE!

Sunset Trick or Trot
Thanksgiving Day Races
Santa Claus with a Cause
Run in the New Year
Because we LOVE FITTING it all together! 🎖️

 
🌧️ Rain or Shine – We Run!
Ready to trot into fall?
Register today and bring your spooky spirit, running shoes, and Halloween flair!

name: SoCal's Tiki Beach 5K & 10K Run/Walk
description:
🌺 Welcome to SO CAL's BIGGEST & BEST POLYNESIAN PARTY RACE! 🌺

Since 2014,  Tiki Beach 5K/10K has been a vibrant tradition on the beach, a chance to run, celebrate, and enjoy island-inspired music, food, and community. It's your end of the summer BEACH PARTY RUN!

🏖️ Experience the energy of the beach with live Polynesian drummers and dancers, bringing authentic rhythm and movement to your run. This isn’t just a race, t’s a festive send-off to summer! Coconuts, palm trees, grass skirts, and the TAPUA PRODUCTION drummers and dancers make this the BEST BEACH BASH, healthy RUNNER's Party!

🎽 Every participant receives a custom Polynesian-style race shirt and one of our signature Tiki finisher medals, a collectible highlight for your race journey. Have enough shirts?  Choose a custom beach towel while supplies last, or add to your collection by getting BOTH for only an additional $20.

🍍 Post-Race Fun: Enjoy coconut and Island inspired pancakes offered by IVC Circle K and Kiwanis of Irvine, specialty coffee, tasty street tacos , Bar b que sandwiches, fresh baked cookies, Hawaiian shaved ice, and Nekter Juice (available for purchase. You make pay with cash, credit card, or pre buy food vouchers) while you explore the expo area and capture those perfect beachside selfies. It's a FOOD FEAST while watching authentic Polynesian drummers and dancers. Support the causes.  KID'S READ will be giving out free books for those that purchase Kiwanis pancakes.  BIG J's So Cal Bar B Que will be offering mini sliders, or full bar b que lunches to eat, take home, or remain at the beach for a picnic!

 
Course:

Flat, scenic, out-and-back along the paved beach path with ocean views. Run fast or take it easy, the waves will be your soundtrack.
Timing: RFID Chip Timing by Itz About Time

Awards:

Top 3 male & female overall (5K & 10K)
Age group awards in 5-year divisions (up to 80+)
Special recognition for those completing 3+ Caren Ware Events this year
 
Schedule
6:30 AM – Vendor & Volunteer Check-in
7:00–8:30 AM – Registration & Packet Pick-Up (race-day available)

7:30 -8:30 Am LIVE POLYNESIAN dancers and drummers/ Tupua Productions/ An active EXPO

8:15 AM – Kid’s Dash & 1-Mile Fun Run
8:30 AM – 10K & 5K Start
9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony
9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony
6:30–10:00 AM – Polynesian-Inspired Expo Open
 
Early Packet Pick-Up
Saturday, Sept. 26 10am to 1PM  (Note: Earlier so we have afternoon time to set up the race) 
Sports Basement, 10800 Kalama River Ave, Fountain Valley, CA 92708
(You may also pick up race morning at the start line.)
 
Parking
Bolsa Chica State Beach, Lot 25 — $15 State Park fee (bring exact cash for faster processing)
Public parking available in Sunset Beach (walking required into park)
 

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on
 
🌊 Whether you’re racing for a PR or jogging with friends, Tiki Beach is your lively, healthy way to wrap up the summer. Come for the run, stay for the rhythm, community, and celebration.

💙 A portion of proceeds supports Caren Ware Events’ global outreach projects, including families in the Himalayas and local community programs.

name: Splash Dash 5k/ A Wet or Dry Run 5k plus Duckie Dash/Wild Rivers in Irvine
description:
The WILD RIVERS SPLASH DASH 5K 
SUNDAY, AUGUST 24, 2025

 

A 'cool' Run.  Chose SPLASH DASH 5k (if you want to get to plunge through the wild river before the finish line.) Or the DRY RUN 5k (if preference is to not get wet)

It's your 'coolest' summer run/walk. With the coolest race BLING!  Choice of a custom event BEACH TOWEL or a custom event t shirt, and a huge custom FINISHER MEDAL for all participants. 

Plus the chance to win SUPER DUPER Age divisions medal awards. 

It is a SUPER DUPER FUN event.  Make it competitive, or choose to cruise it and have great fun! The last 600 yards of the SPLASH DASH you get to 'DASH' through the lazy river in 2 1/2 feet of water, going with the current!

***************************************************************************************

You also are eligible for a discounted entry into WILD RIVERS for Sunday, August 24 only.  Participants get in for $39.99.  A ticket must be bought online in advance . 

https://wildrivers.com/companies/splash_dash/

 SE code: SPLASHDASH for the price to drop from 79.99 to $39.99 when you check out online. https://wildrivers.com/companies/splash_dash/

 Show your bib at the gate. 

***********************************************************************************************************

WE are making this RACE A FOOD DRIVE!!!! 

EVERY PARTICIPANT MUST BRING AT LEAST 2 CAN GOODS OR $5 CASH donation FOR THE FOOD DRIVE .  The South County Outreach is an amazing NONPROFIT that serves over 400 people and families a month, providing nourishing ingredients and food items to make full and complete meals.  When people visit their Food Market, they are in control of the cart and what goes in it, just like in a local grocery store. Most needed items are: canned fruit, canned fish/meat, and jelly.

 

PICK your course!  Do you want to end the race running through the wild river (2 1/2 feet deep) and getting SPLASHED by its fountains?!  Sign up for SPLASH DASH.  If you are a dry lander and just want to run around the park (avoiding the WET part) sign up for the DRY RUN.  Both get separate sets of age division awards. name: Spring Fling Run – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
Fresh air, good vibes, and springtime miles. Spring Fling Run at Hansen Dam is a fun, community-focused race designed to kick off the season and remind you why you love running.

Details

Start Location: Hansen Dam Recreation Area,11770 Foothill Blvd., Lake View Terrace, CA. Ranger Station Area, Google Maps
Parking: There are free parking lots nearby the start

Event Schedule

6:30am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Course

5k & 10k – this 5k route is used for the 5k (done once), 10k (done twice)
Half Marathon – this 4.4-mile route is used for the half marathon (done 3 times)

More About the Course: This is a looped course. Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations along the way.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Email us at events@hightideruns.com

name: Spring Sprint @ Uvas
description:
Join us for this popular race at Uvas Reservoir. It's a Sprint but super-sized. Swim .75 miles in Uvas Reservoir. Bike 16.2 miles on quiet country roads. Only two climbs! Finish up with a 5 mile run. Then eat tasty food and listen to good music while waiting for the award ceremony.

Top 3 in 5-year age groups for Triathlon. Top 3 Overall for all other events. Special Youth & Senior pricing. Clydesdale & Athena waves. No-binary/Prefer Not Say options. Relays too! AquaBike, Duathlon, Aquathlon, and OWS events also available.

name: SRLA Friendship Run
description:
Get ready for the marathon with a new PR! Join Students Run LA students and leaders at Hansen Dam for the third event of the 2024 - 2025 Medal Series. Every runner will receive the next medal in the Series and a special t-shirt designed by an SRLA Student.

This is the registration page for public participants, current SRLA students and leaders can register by contacting their group's primary leader.

No refunds.
Bib Pick Up will take place the morning of the event (2/16) between 6AM and 7AM in the expo area. Please arrive early to allow yourself plenty of time to walk over and pick up your materials. No bag check.
30K Course Limit - 5 hours. We cannot ensure road closures or post-event materials for runners/walkers completing the event in over 5 hours. No late starts.

name: SRLA Victory 5K
description:
May 3rd, 2026 - Join us for the fourth and final event of 2025 - 2026 SRLA Medal Series and complete the puzzle! Celebrate the end of the school year with SRLA students and leaders as we all run a victory lap with a fun 5K and a post event celebration.

Celebrate the SRLA Season - The SRLA Victory 5K will bring thousands of SRLA runners back together, again. You can be a part of SRLA history - your entry fee will support student runners on their life changing journey to the marathon.

This is the registration page for public participants, current SRLA students and leaders can register by contacting their group's primary leader

name: St Patrick's Day  Run
description:
Join us for the 10th annual Fresno St Patrick's Day Run!  Whether you run or walk the Shamrock 4 Miler or our GREEN Leprechaun 2 Miler you'll have a great time! And both will have age group awards..... GREEN Medallions, GREEN Event Shirt, GREEN goodies and GREEN Beer (21+)!!

The 4 mile is a 10 point race in the Cal Classic Runner of the Year Series. Click HERE to find out more!

We are so proud and honored to have Art of Life Cancer Foundation as our Charity Partner!

name: St. Paddy's Day Lucky Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🍀 St. Paddy's Day Run: Luck, Laughs, and Laces! 🍀

Celebrate St. Patrick’s Day with a fun and festive run that’s as much about the spirit of the holiday as it is about the finish line! Whether you're running, walking, or just along for the ride, this 5K/10K/13.1 is the perfect way to enjoy the day with friends, family, and fellow revelers.
Dress up in your favorite green gear—shamrocks, leprechaun hats, and everything in between—and join us for a race full of fun and good cheer!

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: St. Patrick's Day 5K Run / Community Walk
description:
The Village Runner St. Patrick’s Day 5K Run & Leprechaun Dash for the Gold is returning to Redondo Beach on Saturday, March 14, 2026!

This year’s event is hosted in partnership with South Bay Children’s Health Center, with proceeds supporting their vital programs for local children and families.

All participants will receive a St. Patrick's Day Run t-shirt and finisher's medal.  The event also features computerized chip timing, age division awards, and cash prizes to the top three overall male and female runners in the 5K.

name: Stanford Draft Legal Triathlon
description:
Register here for the DRAFT LEGAL race! Classic race registration can be found here. To request a code to sign up for draft legal, please email treeathlon@gmail.com. If you're wondering if you should race draft legal or classic, please check the FAQs on the race website.

Come and join in the fun of one of the best collegiate triathlons in Northern California! The race is a 750m open-water swim, a 20km bike, and a 5k run. 

There are two separate races taking place on February 14th, 2026. The Stanford Draft Legal Triathlon for Collegiate and Elite athletes will start at 10:00am. The Classic Stanford Treeathlon, a non-draft legal race, will start at 1:00 pm. In each race, we have two categories of waves, men's and women's. While these wave start categories are binary, we recognize that not all people fit within that and we will accommodate all participants regardless of gender identity.

Registration for the Draft Legal event is a separate registration link. Please check the race website for updates.

You must be 18 years old on race day to participate in this race.

Please be sure to check the race website for packet pickup information and schedule changes. Answers to frequently asked questions (water temps, equipment, etc.) can be found here: http://www.stanfordtreeathlon.com/faqs.
