name: Steps for Strength: Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS)
description:
Please Note **After careful consideration we have decided to regrettably cancel this years Steps for Strength event scheduled for 5/2/2026. ***

 

Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS) is hosting its second annual Steps for Strength 5K at Campbell Park in Campbell, CA. The event kicks off at 8:30 a.m. with a health resource fair, followed by the 5K walk/run at 9:00 a.m. The 3.1-mile loop course is flat and scenic, winding through Campbell Park. Water stations will be available at the start/finish line and halfway point, with public restrooms at the finish. This 5K event will be a professionally timed race. 

 

This family-friendly event features a playground, music, a food truck, face painting, and more fun activities for kids. After the race, enjoy participant medals, the health resource fair, and snacks. All proceeds benefit BAYS and its free programs for young breast cancer survivors.

 

ABOUT BAYS:
Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS) is an all-volunteer, 501(c)(3) nonprofit supporting young breast cancer survivors under 45 in the San Francisco Bay Area by providing emotional support and resources for life during and after cancer. Funds raised will help fund free programming offered to members such as: support groups, educational workshops, community meetups, and emergency financial assistance.

 

MORE INFORMATION

  • Create a TEAM with friends, family, or colleagues, or register as an individual to participate in-person or virtually!
  • Set a fundraising goal and help BAYS by encouraging your community to sponsor your run—or your team’s run.
  • Together, we can raise awareness and support for young adults with breast cancer in the Bay Area. Help spread the word about BAYS and the vital services we offer to those in need.
  • Can’t Attend the Steps for Strength on May 2, 2026 ? You can still make a difference by making a donation to BAYS! Click the yellow "Donate" tab at the top to contribute. Any donation, big or small, will be greatly appreciated and go a long way in helping us continue to offer free services to our young breast cancer members.

VOLUNTEER SIGN UP
Interested in Volunteering?

We have a variety of roles and skillsets needed for this exciting event! To sign up, use the link in the header.

 

SPONSORSHIP OPPORTUNITIES

Interested in Sponsoring? 

Become a sponsor and make a lasting impact at this incredible event! We offer a variety of sponsorship opportunities for your business or organization. Your support will directly benefit Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS) and help provide essential resources for young adults with breast cancer in our community.

  • To sponsor, head to the Sponsors tab in the header, complete our     or email us at runwithbays@bayareayoungsurvivors.org
  • To learn more about sponsorship opportunities, please reach out to us. We’d love to discuss how we can collaborate for a great cause!

name: Stonum Vineyards Wine Run 5k
description:
Join us on Saturday, March 28, 2026 starting at 10:00am for an exciting new event that features Stonum Vineyards. This winery specializes in handcrafted, artisan, estate and single vineyard wines that faithfully represent the terroir of origin. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience!  This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: Sugar Daddy Race
description:
WELCOME TO THE SUGAR DADDY RACE!

Celebrate Father's Day by kicking off the weekend with an awesome race taking you on a scenic tour through the beautiful Santa Clarita Valley in a Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, or Kids race.

Get your PR on our fast, almost flat course on paved paseo trails. Created to bring runners together for a great race experience as you finish across the historic Iron Horse bridge into the finish line to earn our epic Sugar Daddy Race bling, plus receive yummy Ben & Jerry's ice cream to help cool you down from your awesome run! 

Learn more below or register today to secure your spot at the start line!

FAST COURSE
Runners get to enjoy the best of Santa Clarita's awesome paths and paseos taking runners on a spectacular tour around the Santa Clarita Valley on a very fast course. 
 
HISTORIC BRIDGE
All runners get to make the final push into finish line to run across the historic 120-year old Iron Horse bridge, making for a landmark race finish.
 
FAMILY FUN
The Sugar Daddy Race is for everyone, runners, walkers, hikers, there is even a Kids Fun Run for the little ones to get active and healthy to experience a race.
 
SWEET FINISH
In addition to earning an awesome medal, Sugar Daddy finishers will get a special ice cream treat to help cool them off after finishing the race.

Learn more at >> SugarDaddyRace.com

description:
🌞 SUMMER SOLSTICE  RUN: 5K. 10K. Half Marathon – LONG BEACH 🌊✨


“Run the Longest Day, Shine the Brightest Way!”

Celebrate the longest day of the year with an electrifying glow run along the scenic Long Beach coastline! As the sun rises, the party begins—race under the golden hues of sunrise. Whether you’re running the 5K.10K or half marathon, this is your chance to embrace the solstice spirit with a vibrant community of runners.

💛 

 
📍 Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
📅 Race Day Check-In
🕕 6:00 AM - | Location: Race Ready Athletics Tent near the start line

🏁 Race Start
🕡 7:00 AM Half Marathon | 5K & 10K - 7:30 AM

 
🚗 Parking Information
✅ Street Parking: Free 
✅ Beach Lot: $2.00 per hour

 
🏆 Awards & Recognition


Cross the finish line and glow with pride! All finishers receive a medal
🥇 The Top 3 male & female finishers in each distance will receive special medals to commemorate their glowing achievement.

 
🔥 Why Join the Summer Solstice Run?
🌅 Scenic Course: Run along the stunning Long Beach coastline, soaking in ocean views, palm trees, and sunset vibes.

🎉Professional Chip Timing, Finisher medals for all, overall and age group awards.

🔥 Get ready to vibe, and celebrate the arrival of summer! 🔥

 

🌴 LET THE SUMMER BEGIN! 🌞✨

name: Sunrise Marathon 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🌅 Rise. Run. Shine. – The Sunrise Marathon 2026 🌄

Start your day with purpose, peace, and a little pavement-pounding joy.
Join us for the Sunrise Marathon — a breathtaking early-morning race designed to energize your soul and awaken your senses.

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

🌅 Rise. Run. Shine. – The Sunrise Marathon 2026 🌄

Start your day with purpose, peace, and a little pavement-pounding joy.
Join us for the Sunrise Marathon — a breathtaking early-morning race designed to energize your soul and awaken your senses.

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Super Hero Dash – 5K, 10K, 10M, and Half Marathon
description:
Calling all caped crusaders, masked vigilantes, and crime-fighting champions! Gear up for the ultimate test of superpowers at the Super Hero Dash!

Details
Start Location: Long Beach Location TBD
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the tables closest to Claremont Ave
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)
Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses
5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

name: Super Warrior 5K
description:
This is our Super Warrior 5K. We encourage family and friends to participate and dress up as their favorite “Warrior” or Super Hero.

The Super Warrior 5K, is hosted by Stripes of a Warrior, a local 501(c)(3) nonprofit that originated in Anaheim, California. It will be held on January 24th, 2026 at Yorba Regional Park in Anaheim Hills. Our mission is to help cancer Warriors FIGHT cancer financially. We provide financial assistance to those that have been diagnosed with cancer and are unable to afford their medical bills, housing, medication, or food expenses, etc.

name: Superhero 5K Fun Run
description:
Date: Sunday, March 8, 2026
Location: Union City Civic Center / City Hall
Address: 34009 Alvarado-Niles Road, Union City, CA
Check-In: 8:00 AM | Race Begins: 9:00 AM
Rain or Shine!

Become the Hero You Were Meant to Be
Suit up, power up, and hit the streets of Union City for our annual Superhero Fun Run! Whether you’re flying solo or running with your sidekicks, this event is packed with community spirit, friendly competition, and heroic fun for all ages.

Join hundreds of fellow heroes for a morning featuring:

💥 Official race timing for accurate results
🏅 Award medals for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place in each category
🎟️ Exciting raffle prizes and giveaways
🦸 Costume contest for the best hero (or villain) look
A Race That Gives Back
Since 2016, the Superhero Fun Run has celebrated the anniversary of the Mark Green Sports Center while supporting an important cause. A portion of every registration—$5 per participant—will be donated to the Parkinson’s Foundation through our Union City Moving Day team. Your steps make a real difference!

Race Categories
Boys/Girls 12 & Under
Boys/Girls 13–17
Men/Women 18–29
Men/Women 30–39
Men/Women 40–49
Men/Women 50–59
Men/Women 60–69
Men/Women 70+

name: SuperHeroes Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🦸‍♀️🦹‍♀️ Superheroes don't always wear capes but when they do, they run and walk! 🦸‍♂️🦹‍♂️

Everyone is a superhero in their own way. From all the moms out there, to our front line workers, to even just those who are simply a friend to someone else. So for every superhero out there (that includes YOU), You make a Difference and we celebrate that with a fun run!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Support Blue Fresno
description:
Join us at this year's Support Blue Run to show your support for our men and women in law enforcement who protect our Valley!  By participating, you are helping to support the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy, a non-profit dedicated to partnering with Fresno Police and Fire Departments and committed to being first to serve - providing spiritual and emotional support to first responders and the community.
The Fresno Support Blue Run campaign aims to:
  • Foster trust and confidence between our officers and the community they serve
  • Provide opportunity for our community to visibly show their support for law enforcement
  • Educate youth to enhance relationships and understanding with officers
  • Raise funds to provide staff and resources for the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy programs who support our volunteer Police Chaplains and the Fresno Police and Fire Departments

Children 9 & under registering for the 5K/2M will receive a discount applied at checkout.

name: Sweetheart 5K Run/Walk
description:
The Rotary Club of Brentwood Presents -  Sweetheart 💖 5K Run/Walk 2026

Our event will take place on Valentine's Day, February 14th, 2026!

 

PACKET PICK-UP INFO -

To Be Determined

 

We looking forward to seeing you all!! We Run/Walk Rain or Shine! 

SPECIAL PRICING - THURSDAY NOVEMBER 27TH - SUNDAY NOVEMBER 30TH

INITIAL PRICING IS FOR "NO BLING" (no shirt or medal) ONLY

AGENDA- (subject to change) 


8 am - 8:45 am - Arrive at Veterans Park
8:30 am - 8:45 am - Warm-up!
9:00 AM SHARP! - 🏃🏾  Race Start Time, "It's On" !
8 am - 10:30 am Pancake 🥞 Breakfast  served !
10 am - Champagne Toast 🥂
10:15 am - Awards🥇🥈🥉 Ceremony 
11:00 am That's a Wrap! See You All back 2027

FYI s

If the system does not prompt you for a shirt size it is because of special pricing period. 

The course will follow the Marsh Creek Trail. Racers will exit Veterans Park and turn LEFT  onto the trail. The turnabout is almost but not quite to Concord Ave. 
( PLEASE NOTE: Our route is subject to change and is based on weather conditions on that day!) 

Check in is only necessary if you did not check in at packet pick Up. You can check in on race day to get your race bib at the registration/check-in table - please arrive earlier. 

SADLY Doggies ARE NOT allowed to participate due to safety reasons. As much as we LOVE and ADORE our furry friends - we want to ensure the safety of all participants and volunteers. 

Strollers (no scooters or bikes) are indeed allowed! This is a family event. However we asked that strollers and families start out in the back, again to ensure safety of all, especially our children ❤️

Rain or Shine We Run!!!

Thank You All ❤️ for Your Contribution to Our Event!

A portion of the proceeds will go towards the Brentwood Rotary Endowment Fund.

name: Sycamore Island 5k & 10k Run/Walk
description:
Welcome to the 2026 Sycamore Island 5k & 10k Run/Walk. Proceeds from the event will benefit the San Joaquin River Parkway & Conversation Trust and Sycamore Island. 

Explore the Scenic Beauty: Join us for an exhilarating day along the Lower San Joaquin River, surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of Sycamore Island. Our single-track trail courses, tailored for both beginners and seasoned runners, promise a fast and enjoyable experience.

👟 Course Options:

5k Run/Walk: A perfect choice for beginners or those seeking a quick, scenic challenge.
10k Run/Walk: Embrace the extra distance and immerse yourself in the natural beauty of Sycamore Island.
🌍 Support a Worthy Cause: Your participation goes beyond the trails. All proceeds from this event will benefit the San Joaquin River Parkway & Conservation Trust and Sycamore Island. By joining us, you contribute to the preservation of these natural treasures.

🎉 Event Highlights:

🏅 Custom Finisher Medals for all participants.
🎽 Event T-shirt to commemorate your Sycamore Island adventure.
🌟 Awards for top performers in each category.
🌿 Preserve, Protect, Participate: Let's run for a cause and celebrate the spirit of Sycamore Island. Register now, lace up your shoes, and be part of an event that makes a difference.

Sycamore Island 5k/10k Participant Info

Early Bib Pickup: Saturday, January 10th from 3:30-5:30pm at Fleet Feet Sports Fresno located at 9447 N Fort Washington Suite 106 Fresno, Ca 93730

Race Day Packet Pickup: Sunday, Jan 11th from 7:15-8:15am at Sycamore Island. There will not be any race day registration. 

Start Time: Both races will start at 8:30am

Restrooms: Restrooms are spread along the course at Sycamore Island. Prior to the race restrooms are near the parking area and there will be a few near the start/finish. Please make your potty plans accordingly. 


Sycamore Island Address: 39664 Ave 7 1/2, Madera, CA 93636. There will be a sign on Ave 7 1/2 pointing towards the entrance of Sycamore Island. 
 For directions via Google maps click here.

 
Parking:   Once you enter through the main gate of Sycamore Island you will follow the road down and then turn left. We will have volunteers directing traffic near the entrance. There is no fee. 

Race Start Location: We will have music playing before the race starts and the Start/finish arch head towards the music to find the start. The Start line is located on the North East side of Sycamore Island. Click here for a Map.
 

Shirts: If the shirt size you registered for does not fit please wait until after the race to switch it out for another size, if it's available. Shirt sizing is unisex

 
Course Markers:  The course will be marked with signs & directional arrows and orange ribbon. So long as you look for the signs and follow the directional arrows the course should be easy to follow.

 

Course Maps: Please take a minute to review the new courses below.

Dogs & Strollers are not allowed on the course
 

Aid Stations: There will be one aid station for the 5k & 10k along the course at roughly 1.5 miles in. The 10k will come back to this aid station on the return at 4.5miles in. 

 
Awards: We will start with 5k Overall Awards First around 8:55am then age group awards afterwards. 10k Overall awards will start around 9:15am followed by age group awards. If you win an award and are unable to stay they will be available to pick up at Fleet Feet Sports Fresno on Wednesday following the race.

About Sycamore Island:

The San Joaquin River Parkway & Conservation Trust started operating Sycamore Island in 2013 under a 5-year agreement with the San Joaquin River Conservancy.   Sycamore Island is still a great place to visit!  Sycamore island has three access points to the river for canoeing and kayaking, and has several miles of dirt roads that provide an excellent surface for trail running or walking.  There are three covered picnic shelters on the 350-acre property, and a bait shop that sells snacks and beverages. 

 

 

More about the San Joaquin River Parkway & Conservation Trust

name: TAKEDOWN THE NEW YEAR - 5K RUN/WALK
description:
The Boys & Girls Wrestling teams at Buhach Colony HS invites you, your family, and friends to the first annual Takedown the New Year 5K. This fun-filled abd competitive event will take place on Saturday, January 3, 2026 at Buhach Colony HS in the city of Atwater. Our goal is to raise enough funds to help our young student/athletes purchase new uniforms, warm ups, wrestling equipment, and cover all tournament-related expenses. 

Here is the race day schedule:

       10:00am-11:00am = Packet pick up and race-day registration

       11:30am-11:45am = Kids Race will be 1 lap around the brand new, all-weather Track at BCHS!

       12 noon = 5K Run/Walk will be chip-timed by local timers:  Alpha-Ro Timing (LIVE Results available at RunSignup.com).

Raffle:  Stick around for the post-race raffle!  Your bib is your ticket to win one of the many gift baskets and raffle prizes (must be present to win).   

Finisher's Medals to ALL participants in the Kids Race.  Age-Group Medals for 1st, 2nd, & 3rd places in the following 5K Run/Walk:  10 and under, 11-13, 14-18, 19-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, and 60+.  Pre-purchase an event shirt or hoodie and pick it up on race day! 

Cannot attend but would like to support our teams?  It's fast and easy!  Simply click on the DONATE tab at the top of this page.  Become a Team Sponsor of any level:  Bronze ($250), Silver ($500), or Gold ($1,000+) and we will display your banner at every home wrestling match and our wrestling room in 2026.  Or make an individual donation of any smaller amount and be added to the Team Supporter banner.  We THANK YOU in advance for your generosity!

We hope you will join us at the Takedown the New Year 5K sponsored by our Thunder Boys and Girls Wrestling teams at Buhach Colony HS.  And we will see you on January 3rd!

name: Taxiway 5k
description:
The Taxiway 5K returns for its second year on Saturday, February 28, bringing runners back to one of the most unique race venues in Southern California, Cable Airport in Upland, CA.

This afternoon 5K (4:30pm start) starts and finishes in front of Mt. Baldy Brewery, taking runners on a loop around the airport with beautiful mountain views and a chance to see some of the incredible aircraft on display. After crossing the finish line, stick around at the brewery for a post-race celebration featuring live music, food trucks, and the best beer in SoCal. This year's event will also feature a 800m "Kid's Takeoff Dash" presented by the Mt. Baldy Athletics Foundation which will start at 4pm. 

Registration includes a Taxiway 5k hat and a post-race drink at the Brewery! Don’t miss your chance to be a part of this unique race with great vibes, delicious brews, and can't miss mountain views await. Spots are limited, so register today and be part of year two of the Taxiway 5K!

name: Teaming Up Against Cancer
description:
Online registration closes on Thursday, March 13, 2025 at 11:59pm.  If you would like to come out to the event as a cancer survivor or general visitor, please feel free to do so...there is no charge.  The opening ceremony and survivor ceremony is at 9am on Saturday, March 15th.  Competitions are to follow.  Cornhole competition opportunities are available onsite for $20 per person.

Please scroll down to view Game Rules, Event Schedule and Event Map.

This exciting competition brings local businesses, service organization and families of all sizes together for a variety of fun and entertaining activities.  It's a great opportunity to promote teamwork and a sense of pride. All proceeds benefit the Kern County Cancer Foundation.

Teams will compete in a variety of fun and low-skill activities all while vying for the most accumulated points and ultimately, ownership of the "Ultimate Cancer Fighters" Team Cup.  Likely competitions include:  Connect 4, Giant Pong, Hoppin' World Cup, Obstacle Course Relay, Bigfoot, and Around the World.  

 

The 2025 Event Schedule, Game Rules, Team Roster and Event Map are at the bottom of the Competition Info section of this website.

This one-day competition will take place at Liberty Park 11225 Brimhall Rd. 93312 in Bakersfield on Saturday, March 15th 9am-2pm with awards and raffle to follow.

Each team consists of 10 members.  A group can enter more than one team if space allows.  If your company/club/family has paid for your team, please see your team leader for your registration code to waive your individual fee.

For more information or help with registration please call 661-825-8249 and speak with Alissa.

name: Thankful Paws Turkey Trot
description:
Join us for the first annual Turkey Trot – Thankful Paws 5K/10K Run on Thanksgiving morning at Rohr Park, in the beautiful city of Bonita, located in Chula Vista, CA.

This special day is dedicated to giving thanks to our pets—past and present—for the joy, love, and companionship they've brought into our lives and homes.

Enjoy a scenic course alongside a golf course and vibrant community park—perfect for both serious runners and casual participants. Whether you're chasing a PR on a fast course or simply looking for a joyful way to start your holiday, this event has something for everyone. We’re offering a 5K, 10K, Kids’ Mile, and our always-popular Doggy Mile!

Bring the whole family—including your four-legged friends—and kick off your Thanksgiving with a fun, active, and festive tradition.

All proceeds benefit Kane's Animal Rescue, a local nonprofit dedicated to giving abandoned and at-risk pets a second chance at life. So, while you're breaking a sweat, you're also making a difference.

Come trot with us, give thanks, and support a great cause—because every step helps save a paw.

Proceeds will benefit Kanes K9s & Animal Rescue! 

Kanes K9s is a local nonprofit animal rescue organization. Proceeds from ticket sales will be donated to the rescue.

 

FAQ

Bib Pickup: Registrations submitted on or after Nov. 20th will pick up their bib on race day. If you registered prior to Nov. 20th, bib pickup is available Sunday, Nov. 23rd at Road Runner Sports in Chula Vista from 2pm-6pm (2015 Birch Rd Suite #512, Chula Vista).

Dog Mile: For the dog mile, the dog must cross the finish line ahead of their owner/partner to log a valid race result.

description:

name: THE 8TH ANNUAL GRAND PRIX FOUNDATION OF LONG BEACH 5K RUN/WALK
description:
This spring, racing fans and runners of all skill levels and ages will have the opportunity to “run the course” at the 8th Annual Grand Prix Foundation of Long Beach 5K on April 12, 2026, which will benefit local charities through the Grand Prix Foundation of Long Beach.

Participants will run a two-lap tour of the world-famous Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach racecourse including Pine Avenue and Seaside Way, with the finish at the official Grand Prix start/finish line on Shoreline Drive. Kids 12 and under can get in on the action with the Kids’ Turbo 1K, which will take place after the main races on a portion of the regular racecourse. The other two races will be the Elite/Pro 5K (those who can finish the race in under 25 minutes) which will start at 7:00 a.m. and the run for the general public, beginning at 7:30 a.m.

Each runner will receive a finisher medal, an official Grand Prix Foundation 5K t-shirt, post-race refreshments and two complimentary Friday general admission tickets to the Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach, a $68 value. There will also be photo ops and activities in the 5K festival area at the conclusion of the run.

name: The Bertman Run
description:
Join us for a Fun Run (5k, 10k, Half Marathon or virtual run/walk) to raise crucial funds for Leukemia and Lymphoma Society (LLS)- Now called Blood Cancer United in Honor of Bert Vicchio (Bertman)- race director's (Lianne Vicchio) dad. The fight to terminate blood cancer is ongoing and funds raised from the race will be donated to Blood Cancer United. 

Where: Historic Folsom Station North Park and Ride (diagonal from Practical Cycle on Leidnesdorff and Folsom Blvd, at the end of the light rail station and the parking garage) and race will be on the American River Bike Trail. 

When: Saturday January 17th, 2026 8:00am

Course Description: This is an out and back course on the American River Trail starting at the park and ride lot. THIS COURSE IS open and available to other river parkway users. PLEASE always stay to the left as walkers/runners on the bike trail. There will be an aid station at the 10k turn around and another at the Half marathon turnaround. No aid station for the 5k course. There is NO official BATHROOM at race start, please plan accordingly. There are bathrooms on course/on the bike trail as well as surrounding businesses. 

Packet/Bib Pick-up is DAY OF ONLY. Starting at 6:55am, 1/17/26 at the Park and Ride lot. There are no official timing chips. Times will be logged manually. We hope in future years as this fundraiser grows, we will be able to add official timing to this race. 

Goodie bags, bibs, and morning treats (donuts, coffee, bananas, muffins, tangerines, water and gatorades) will be ready for you at check-in. Medals will be awarded to all participants. Awards (Fleet Feet Folsom/Roseville is sponsoring with gift cards) will be handed out to the 1st place male and female in the 5k, 10k and Half Marathon. NO medals, awards or shirts will be mailed out if not collected on race day. 

Yerba Mate will be on sight giving out free drinks all morning too! 

Racing with us Virtually? Register as normal and send us your pictures and tag us on Instagram @TheBertmanRun

name: The Cedar Grove Scamper - Presented by Chico Running Club
description:
Join us for Chico Running Club's Spring 4 Miler, the Cedar Grove Scamper. For our second year the race will again feature an Open Division (all ages) and a Master's Division (age 40+). Race proceeds benefit Chico Running Club, celebrating our 50th year in 2025. Our programs include our scholarship fund and our non-profit mission to support running events and local runners in Chico and the North State.

Date: Saturday May 16, 2026 @ 8am
Location: Cedar Grove Picnic Area in Bidwell Park, Chico - Google Map
Parking: At the Cedar Grove dirt lot, or overflow on East 8th Street

Course: A beautiful 4 mile loop through lower Bidwell park, the course starts and ends at Cedar Grove picnic area. Surfaces are pavement and dirt trail.
The course begins at South Park Drive and quickly crosses the Forest Avenue bridge to the North side of Big Chico Creek. From there it runs up Peterson Memorial drive then doubles back on the Vallombrosa dirt trail. It proceeds until turning back on South Park Drive after the Highway 99 over-crossing to return to Cedar Grove. Course Map

Divisions: There are two race divisions- enter either the Open Division (all ages) or the Master's Division (ages 40+). Prizes will be given to the top finishers in each division.

Bibs and Timing: Bibs will be given to all race entrants. Packet pick-up will be at Fleet Feet Friday May 15th from 1:30-4:30. Bib pick-up can also be done the day of the race at Cedar Grove, starting at 7:30. Timing will be performed by Chico Running Club.

Aid Stations: One water station will be on the course at the half way point of the race. Please carry any water or food needed during the race. Water and snacks are available at the start and finish, park bathrooms are available at Cedar Grove.

Give Aways: All those who registered before Sunday April 26th and selected the shirt option ($15 additional) will receive a shirt at check-in.

Discounted Registration: To celebrate our 50th anniversary Chico Running Club Members receive 50% off race registration. You can join the club at our website. Please don't select member registration unless you are signed up as a member.

Refreshments: Drinks and snacks will be provided after the race. Please stay after completing the race to cheer on other participants as they cross the finish.

Volunteers: Not ready to participate? Volunteers are needed and welcome for this race. Please click on the volunteer tab in the RunSignUp menu to sign up.

Sponsors: Would you like to sponsor this event? We have T-Shirt, Refreshment, and Event Sponsor tiers.

Race Insurance: Is provided by a RunSignUp partner. Chico Running Club does not provide or administer race insurance should participants elect to purchase it.

The course begins at South Park Drive and quickly crosses the Forest Avenue bridge to the North side of Big Chico Creek. From there it runs up Peterson Memorial drive then doubles back on the Vallombrosa dirt trail. It proceeds until turning back on South Park Drive after the Highway 99 over-crossing to return to Cedar Grove. Course Map

Divisions: There are two race divisions- enter either the Open Division (all ages) or the Master's Division (ages 40+). Prizes will be given to the top finishers in each division.

Aid Stations: One water station will be on the course at the half way point of the race. Please carry any water or food needed during the race. Water and snacks are available at the start and finish, park bathrooms are available at Cedar Grove.

Give Aways: All those who registered before Sunday April 26th and selected the shirt option ($15 additional) will receive a shirt at check-in.

Discounted Registration: To celebrate our 50th anniversary Chico Running Club Members receive 50% off race registration. You can join the club at our website. Please don't select member registration unless you are signed up as a member.

Refreshments: Drinks and snacks will be provided after the race. Please stay after completing the race to cheer on other participants as they cross the finish.

Volunteers: Not ready to participate? Volunteers are needed and welcome for this race. Please click on the volunteer tab in the RunSignUp menu to sign up.

Sponsors: Would you like to sponsor this event? We have T-Shirt, Refreshment, and Event Sponsor tiers.

Race Insurance: Is provided by a RunSignUp partner. Chico Running Club does not provide or administer race insurance should participants elect to purchase it.

name: The Cobra 5Kai, 10Kai & Half Miyagithon
description:
May 16, 2026 · 7:00 a.m. PST · 6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA

Join us for The Cobra 5Kai, 10Kai & Half Miyagithon. An 80s-inspired martial arts throwback run along the iconic LA River Path!

Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Strike first. Strike hard. No mercy.
Whether you’re running for Miyagi-Do honor or Cobra Kai glory, this is your shot to earn a finisher’s medal with dojo-level pride.

Choose your challenge:

  • The 5Kai – Out-and-back power sprint to awaken your inner warrior.
  • The 10Kai – Twice the distance, double the badassery.
  • The Half Miyagithon – Go the distance. Channel the balance. Defeat your limits.
  • The Multiverse Dojo Dash (Virtual) – For anyone who can’t make it to our timeline but still wants to join the fight. Run from your own dimension and earn the same medal as the in person warriors.

Expect high-energy music, 80s and 90s throwbacks, themed signage, and a cheering crowd that knows the way of the fist. Costumes welcome. Finish line crane kicks encouraged.

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race...fun, fast, and full of heart.

Sign up now. Mercy is for the weak.

 

Parody Note:
This event is a fan made parody inspired by classic pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official rights holders. It’s all for fun, community, and good energy.

name: The Coffee Cruise  – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Join us for a jolt!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag


Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

name: The Encino Man Ice Age Dash
description:
January 10, 2026 · 7:00 a.m. PST · 6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA

Dig out your loincloth and unfreeze your running shoes—it's time for The Encino Man Ice Age Dash! Inspired by the 1992 cult classic that gave us “wheezin’ the juice” and prehistoric high school vibes, this race is a hilarious, frozen-in-time celebration of thawed-out bros and SoCal slacker culture.

Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Whether you’re a caveman learning to rollerblade or just want to shake off that post-holiday hibernation, you’re invited to jog through Canoga Park like it’s 10,000 BC.

  • The Caveman Jog 5K 🪨 Short, sweet, and the perfect warm-up for a Neander-thrill.
  • The Ice Age Shuffle 10K ❄️ For bros who wanna go the distance without losing their chill.
  • The Slurpee-Fueled Half Marathon🥤 Powered by sugar, sarcasm, and the spirit of Pauly Shore.
  • The Multiverse Frozen Fossil Fun Run (Virtual) 🧊 Join from your own glacier and still claim your medal. Bonus points for running in a fur vest.

Expect prehistoric tunes, icy puns, and snowball-level encouragement on the course. Animal pelts optional. Santa Monica High transfers welcome.

 

 

 

Parody Disclaimer
This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 90s pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official trademark holders.

name: The HEART RUN Half Marathon & 5K /10K / Half Marathon
description:
BOLSA CHICA STATE BEACH. LOT 25  

Race Day Schedule:
 6:30 AM RACE DAY REGISTRATION begins
 7:00 am to 11 am FEBRUARY FESTIVAL EXPO.  Full of FUN.  Make your own Valentines. Be a Valentine. 
 8:00 AM START of the HEART RUN HALF MARATHON START (only)
 8:15 AM Kid's Dash
 8:30 AM Start of the HEART RUN 5k/10K Mass start
 9:00 AM Begins the Overall Race award winners, followed by division winners 5k  9:30 10K awards begins
9:45am Begins the Half Marathon Awards Ceremony

CELEBRATE Valentine's in a healthy HEART filled way! Choose 5K /10K/ or Half Marathon . Bring family, friends, or a sweetheart. Or, possibly meet one! It's a full fledged February celebration.  YOUR largest, and BEST February heart themed RACE !

You will get a bib and a 5K shirt or half marathon hoodie, and a custom medal that matches.  Everyone gets a finisher medal. Amazing and ample age division awards. also.  Top three overall awards.  The expo has a "full of heart " section. There is even a make-your-own Valentine card station.  

Also available as an add-on: A $6 food voucher ticket. This can get street tacos, tamales, a drink, and a tamale or a coffee drink from the coffee stand.   Or, home baked Valentine's cookies. Or you can bring cash for race morning.

TESLA TRUCKS & VEHICLES will be there to TEST DRIVE. You will need a copy or proof of a driver's license.

 Remember to also have $15 cash on hand if you are coming in the State Park gate to park. We encourage carpools.  There is free parking throughout Sunset Beach if you are willing to jog east and into that last LOT 25 on the corner of Warner and PCH. No car entrance is available at that far corner.  All vehicles coming into the Bolsa Chica State Park must come in the main gate in the mid-section.   

Awards:

 5K RUN/WALK: Age Group Awards for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd  TOP Overall Male/Female Trophy 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, -over.80-84, 85-89, 90 plus

HALF MARATHON: Age Group Awards for Half Marathon 1st, 2nd, and 3rd  Top Overall Male/Female Trophy,1-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80-84, 85-89, 90 plus

Pick up BIBs and SHIRTS on Race Day at LOT 25.  Beginning at 6:30am. The gates to the STATE PARK opens at 6 am.

HALF MARATHON gets long sleeve ZIP up or PULL over HOODIES for the HALF MARATHON that say FINISHER on them.   Medals help commemorate FEBRUARY themes.     MAKE GOALS for yourself in February.

PLAN ON having a GOOD TIME!  It's the party you make of it.  Bring your zeal, energy , and our hope is this makes your February that much more special...because you are ! Check out how the proceeds help Caren Ware spread health and hope to the needs she has RAN into running a remote marathon on every continent. 

PARKING 

  Plan on paying $15 per car that enters the State Park gate, or...park in the many slots in Sunset Beach south of PCH behind the Jack n the Box on Warner and PCH and jog into LOT 25 of the state park. 

RESTROOMS are provided by the STATE PARK and are located on the FAR ends of lot 25.  Plan on taking a few minutes to venture to them.

name: The Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival
description: The Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival includes four different runs during the first weekend in May annually. The weekend of running begins at the OC Fair and Event Center on Saturday morning with the award winning Hoag Kids Run the OC when nearly 9,000 kids from over 150 Orange County schools participate. The afternoon kicks off with the CELEBRATE OC Festival with local sports teams, craft brews and some of Orange County's iconic brands and live music all day. Later in the day on Saturday, the OC 5K takes place with a fun, flat tour of the OC Fairgrounds and nearby Orange Coast College followed by the Celebrate OC Finish Festival. Sunday morning begins early in Newport Beach. The exceptional OC Marathon & Half Marathon course is a blend of chic coastal scenery, tranquil nature and sophisticated arts and shopping which equal the best of OC. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and cruise down historic PCH through the seaside village of Corona del Mar. Run above pristine wetlands of Upper Newport, the Arts District and shopping mecca of South Coast Plaza in the "Heart of the OC" to the supportive cheers of residents in the many diverse neighborhoods and finish with a huge party at the Sunday Celebrate Finish Festival at the OC Fair and Event Center.

description:

Where: China Camp State Park in Santa Venetia, CA.
When: Sun, 9/13- 9:15AM-1:00PM 
Course Maps: 5K Course Map, 10K Course Map, Half Marathon Course Map.

*NOTE-The half marathon is a STOUT challenge. We would NOT recommend the half marathon if you've never covered this distance before and/or you are not doing any kind of trail running currently.

The Swag:

All participants receive...

  • An AWESOME race woodallion AND lifestyle tee

-Sat, 9/12 from 12-4PM at A Runner's Mind SF (3575 Sacramento St).

name: The Jackpot Mile
description:
Join Chico Running Club for a different kind of mile race, The Jackpot Mile! 💰

The Race Rules: are simple and a runner of any age, pace, or ability can win:

  • Name your target pace for one mile (e.g. 8:00 minutes)
  • You will be scored on how close you can get to your target pace, but...
  • The race is run blind, you cannot use your phone or watch to assist your pacing. We will have a tech check at registration to hold your devices during the race.
  • Runners who are closest to their target will win a share of the jackpot for the race based on placing. Proceeds will be divided 50/50 between the race jackpot and Chico Running Club. Race funds go to support CRC's non-profit mission to support runners, the Chico running community, and host races in town.
  • After all runners have completed the mile the races times will be scored against the pre-race target times and winners will be announced. You must be present to win. 

When: Saturday January 10th, 2026 @ 9am
Where: Bidwell Park- One Mile Sycamore Pool on the Vallombrosa Avenue Side (Google Map)
What: A timed one mile race on the new black top of the North Park drive. Bibs will be assigned, but the CRC race clock will not be timing this blind race!
Food: Refreshments to follow the race.
Course: Will be a one half mile out and back from the gate at One Mile on Petersen Memorial Drive (Strava Course Map)

Questions? Email us at chicorcmembership@gmail.com

name: The Kayla Bernardi BEE Positive Fun Run Walk
description:
The Kayla Bernardi Bee Positive Foundation was started after Kayla lost her battle to leukemia in 2015. As a family we choose to stay focused on the positive and make a difference in our community. Kayla's nickname was Busy Bee and so it was a natural name to attach to her foundation. We raise money to spread throughout the community in her foundations name. We hope that attaching a "Bee Positive" message inspired people beyond the monetary donation. Losing Kayla continues to pain us in a way that is indescribable, raising funds in her name inspires us to continue her legacy and "Bee Positive" even on the hardest of days. Kayla’s birthday was January 31st, so every year we do a 5K Fun Run Walk to honor her legacy and raise money to spread throughout many communities.

Come out and have a GREAT time participating in a fun run/walk that will embrace the spirit of Kayla. After the run, we will keep the BEE Positive vibe going with the POST RUN BEE POSITIVE PARTY AT DUST BOWL BREWERY.
Please join us in Dust Bowl’s Turlock Beer Garden on January 25th, 2025 from 11am-2pm for music, corn hole, and a BEE Positive Vibe. The first 250 participants 21 and older with a bib from the 2025 Fun Run/Walk will get one complimentary beer or seltzer. Participants under 21 can enjoy a free soda or hop water. name: The Kayla Bernardi BEE Positive Fun Run Walk
description:
The Kayla Bernardi Bee Positive Foundation was started after Kayla lost her battle to leukemia in 2015. As a family we choose to stay focused on the positive and make a difference in our community. Kayla's nickname was Busy Bee and so it was a natural name to attach to her foundation. We raise money to spread throughout the community in her foundations name. We hope that attaching a "Bee Positive" message inspired people beyond the monetary donation. Losing Kayla continues to pain us in a way that is indescribable, raising funds in her name inspires us to continue her legacy and "Bee Positive" even on the hardest of days. Kayla’s birthday was January 31st, so every year we do a 5K Fun Run Walk to honor her legacy and raise money to spread throughout many communities.

Come out and have a GREAT time participating in a fun run/walk that will embrace the spirit of Kayla. After the run, we will keep the BEE Positive vibe going with the POST RUN BEE POSITIVE PARTY AT DUST BOWL BREWERY.
Please join us in Dust Bowl’s Turlock Beer Garden on January 25th, 2025 from 11am-2pm for music, corn hole, and a BEE Positive Vibe. The food trailer, and outdoor bar will also be open for the occasion. Partake in a special edition Bizzy BEE beer brewed especially for this event!

name: The Long Beach Leprechaun Run - Kids Dash, 1 Miler, 5k, 10K, & Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
Get ready to feel the luck of the Irish at Shamrocks by the Shore in beautiful Long Beach on Saturday, March 15th!

This is a Chip Timed Race

This festive St. Patrick’s Day run invites runners of all levels to a fun-filled 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon along the scenic waterfront.

Put on your best green gear and join the fun with Irish-themed cheer zones, a costume contest, and the chance to find golden coins hidden along the course for special prizes!

Celebrate your achievement at the finish line with a one-of-a-kind medal, festive refreshments, and photo ops with pots of gold and rainbows.

Bring the whole family—kids can join the Little Leprechaun Dash or explore the Shamrock Treasure Hunt for even more fun!

Don’t miss this lively celebration of fitness and Irish spirit—register today!

Bib Pick-Up & Start Times:
Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM – 7:35 AM (Race Ready Athletics Tent)


Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 7:30 AM

1 Miler - 7:45 AM

Kids Dash - 8:30 AM
Important: There are no late starts. Please arrive early to ensure you're ready for your race!
 

Start Location:
5100  E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

Granada Beach - Rosies Dog Beach 

Parking Information:


Free street parking is available.
Metered parking is $2.00 per hour (credit card and coin payments accepted).

Additional Race Day Info:


Restrooms are located near the start line.
Water and aid stations every 2 miles.
Stroller and walker-friendly event.
Course is fully marked.

 

Weather & Safety:
This is a RAIN or SHINE Event

In case of severe weather, (Like tsunamis, titlewave, or zombie apocalypse),  updates will be provided via email and our social media channels.

Join the Community:
Tag us on social media with #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured! Tune in on Fridays for a chance to win a free race by answering our #FreeEntryFriday questions.

description:

Saturday, February 14, 2026 | Long Beach, CA
5K • 10K • Half Marathon

 

Celebrate love, fitness, and friendship this Valentine’s Day at The Long Beach Sweetheart's Run! Whether you’re running solo, with your sweetheart, or alongside friends, join us for a heart-filled morning of miles and smiles along the gorgeous Long Beach shoreline. Expect high vibes, ocean views, and that signature CaliFlow energy. 💘

 
💌 Race Highlights
❤️ Professionally Chip-Timed for accurate results
📸 Free race-day photos & downloadable finish-line pics
🎖️ Finisher medals for all participants
🏆 Overall and Age Group Awards
🎭 Valentine’s Costume Contest — prizes for best couple, solo, and group looks!
🌊 Flat, fast, and scenic beach course
🥤 Water stations & restrooms along the course
🍩 Finish-line snacks, music, and photo ops to celebrate your run
 
🌺 Why CaliFlow Runs?

At CaliFlow Runs, we believe running should be inclusive, affordable, and fun. We host 50+ events per year to create opportunities for everyone — of every pace and background — to come out, move, and have fun.

Our races bring people together to celebrate health, happiness, and community — without the high price tag. Whether you’re chasing a PR or simply running for the love of it, you’ll always belong here. ❤️

 
👟 Who Can Participate?
Everyone! Runners, walkers, strollers — all paces and abilities are welcome. Come as you are, and leave with your heart full. 💞

 

 ⏰ Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
📍 Location: 5100 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803 (Granada Beach)

Bib Pick-Up: 6:15 AM – 8:30 AM at the Race Ready Athletics Tent
Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:30 AM
 
🚗 Parking Info
Street parking is available (check signs for street sweeping). Paid beach lot parking is $2.00 per hour via the Passport app or machine at the lot entrance. Arrive early for the best spots near the start line.

 
🏅 Awards & Medals
All finishers receive a custom Valentine’s Classic medal ❤️
Overall & Age Group Awards
Costume Contest Awards for best couple, solo, and group — bring your Valentine spirit!

💫 A Quick Note
There are several races that take place in and around our Long Beach course locations — but there’s only one CaliFlow Runs. 🌊 We are not affiliated with any of them.

If you’re looking for an exceptional race experience with professional chip timing, free photos, well-organized staff, and that signature CaliFlow vibe, make sure you see the CaliFlow Runs name or logo before you register.

If it’s not CaliFlow, it’s just an "average"race.. ❤️

name: The Love Run – 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon
description:
Bring your sweetie and run with us on Valentine's Day!

Race Details

Location: Woodley Park, 6076 Woodley Ave, Encino, CA 91316
Parking: Free parking in the lot; more is available on Woodley Ave

Event Schedule

6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10k start
7:30am – 5k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10k)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Looped Courses

5k route: Runners do one loop – route here
10k route: Runners do one loop – route here
Half Marathon: Route is the 10k route PLUS an added out and back to make it the full distance. Runners do two laps – route here

More about the Course
The race routes go across the grass, under the road through a tunnel, and enter the park. The 5k loops the lake and returns. The 10k and half head to the other side of the park, going under the bridge, and then journey back along a different path.

Our courses are on open paths so please be considerate of other park users!

On-Course Support
Multiple water stations are located along the routes. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, and other snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk and runner turn signs

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Orange County, the San Fernando Valley, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

name: The Lucky Run
description:
The Lucky Run is a March race celebrating the start of spring. Race distances include a 2K, 5K, 7K, 10K and Kids Fun Runs. Events start and finish at Davis High School in North Davis (adjacent to Community Park). The 2025 event will be held in the gym parking lot off Oak Avenue. Loop courses travel along city streets, along bike paths and through residential neighborhoods.

Entry for the 2K, 5K, 7K, and 10K includes a short sleeve dri-blend t-shirt, finisher medal, timing and eligibility for age group awards, and post-race refreshments.
Entry to the Kids Runs includes a t-shirt, finisher's medal and post-race refreshments (race is not timed).

name: The Marshmallow Dash – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Join us for a sweet treat of a race!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free. See map at the bottom of this email.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course:
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support:
A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag


Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

name: The Master's University Winter 5K
description:
Since 2011, The Master’s University Winter 5K has been a favorite among local runners thanks to the welcoming atmosphere, scenic course, and community partnerships. This year we are continuing 2025's new features; the Kids 1K, and a more competitive 5K race – the 5K Challenge. The 5K Challenge will be limited to participants whose goal is to complete the race in around 35 minutes. Our traditional 5K Run/Walk will take place immediately following the 5K Challenge.

 

This year's course will replicate the 2025 course. The race will start on TMU’s north campus, wind through Placerita Canyon and Quigley Canyon Open Space, and will finish at the starting point on north campus. The Master's University Winter 5K boasts a scenic and entirely flat course with varying terrain, perfect for participants of all ages and abilities. Come experience what local runners have called their “favorite way to start off the new year!”

name: The Navy's 39th Bay Bridge Run/Walk
description:
START LOCATION: One Park Blvd, San Diego – between the Hilton Bayfront and Convention Center

FINISH LOCATION: Tidelands Park, Coronado

START TIME: 8:00am starting with timed runners then walkers in multiple corral starts. All participants will start before 8:45am.

COURSES: Scenic 4 mile point to point course takes you through downtown, over the Coronado Bridge, down to Tidelands Park. Our 10K course runs the same route then continus through a flat and fast section through Coronado Island. 

YOUR ENTRY INCLUDES: High quality commemorative t-shirt and fantastic finisher medal!

RACE NUMBERS: Mailed to you if registered by May 8th, free of charge!

PACKET PICKUP: Saturday, May 16th 9:30am-2:30pm at RoadRunner Sports 5553 Copley Dr, San Diego. Pickup your bib and t-shirt (and merchandise if purchased).

RACE MORNING PICKUP: At the start line area beginning at 6:30am.

FREE TRANSPORTATION BACK TO START LINE FROM FINISH: Participants can select a shuttle bus or ferry after the event, free of charge!

name: The Observatory Loop Relay
description:
On Thursday, February 26 the Leap Day/Observatory Loop Relay will return for year three. This is a 4 x Mile trail relay race, where teams of two, take on the one mile long Observatory Loop. Each team will run the loop four times, with team members alternating laps, and handing off a baton at the conclusion of each lap. (That means each individual runner will do the loop two times, with a break between each loop.) 

The race will start at 7pm. This means it will be dark during the race! Runners are required to race in headlamps. 

You can sign up with a partner or individually (and we will place you with a partner).

This event is open to runners of all ability levels. All runners take home a branded baton.

name: The Rabbit Run 5k & OC Challenge Wild Hare 5k IRVINE
description:
IRVINE JEFFREY TRAILS . Race start /finish Jeffrey Trail Middle School

SATURDAY, April 4, 2025

RACE DAY SCHEDULE: 

  • 8:00 AM : The OC CHALLENGE WILD HARE 5K : Competitive race with age division
  • 8:35 am Top 3 Overall Awards 
  • 8:40 am Awards Ceremony for the Wild Hare
  • 8:55 am  THE BUNNY DASH kid's race    (200 yards- 5& under, 400 yards- 6 to 7, 1/2 mile- 8 and above)
  • 9:00 AM  THE RABBIT RUN 5k  All finishers get medals and a special EASTER PRIZE BAG when they finish.( You may use the bag to hide the prizes anywhere in the park or school to give your kids an Easter Hunt experience afterward)
 It's an EGGcellent RUN.  DO both 5ks.  Get two bibs and two Finisher Medals.  One Shirt

Chip timed by ITZ ABOUT TIME. If doing both.  Wear only the one bib each time you run and receive a different medal each run.  

Easter-themed goodie bags and BLING! Awesome soft, fully designed custom shirts. A finisher medal that opens!  An Easter bag full of prizes at the finish! Selfie Pictures with the Easter Bunny! 

BIB PICK IS RACE DAY ONLY . There is no early packet pick up for this race . 

Participants can pick up the day of event. Registration will open at 6:30 am on race morning and continue until the 9am race start. 

COURSE: It is out and back with a twist on a picturesque, landscaped running path.  You will be sharing the route with cyclists, other runners, and dog walkers.  If pushing a stroller, stay to the right.  .  Special appearance of the Easter bunny for great selfie photos!!  Run fast, or enjoy this event with friends &  family! Make your Easter have a healthy kick to it! 

PARKING: At 155 Visions Jeffrey Trail Middle School

And , what better to Spring into SPRING, than to run a Spring race with flower names for street names!

RESTROOMS will be located inside the school buildings to the SOUTH and NORTH of the expo area.  Follow the signs.

PROCEEDS from this event to benefit the formation of Ware in the World Foundation. Proceeds will be going to Miss Pam's Ranch, a working ranch that teaches troubled youth to ride, do chores, build esteem,  and set goals. Miss Pam RUNS her ranch from a wheelchair. We are still trying to raise funds to repair the travel chair we gifted her last year.   Plus, many other projects.  We are earning money to put on a Ware in The World 5k in Tanzania, Africa to inspire a village of youth to aspire in running.

name: The Rattlesnake Ramble 5K/10K/Half Marathon (live or virtual)
description:
Resolve to RAAAAMMBBBLLLLEEE like a Rattlesnake in 2026! Our spring trail party returns with a vengeance on Sun, 3/15 to China Camp State Park! If the LIVE option doesn't work for you, VIRTUAL is an option as well.

 

Where: China Camp State Park in Santa Venetia, CA.
When: Sun, 3/15. Half Marathon-9:15AM, 10K-9:30AM, 5K-9:45AM
Course Maps: 5K Course Map, 10K Course Map, Half Marathon Course Map

 

Course Details-The 5K is trail with 'some' technical terrain and minimal ascent/descent . The 10K includes technical terrain, some single track trails, and nearly 1,000 feet of ascent/descent. includes technical terrain, some single track trails, and nearly 1,700 feet of ascent/descent.

 

*NOTE-The half marathon is a STOUT challenge. We would NOT recommend the half marathon if you've never covered this distance before and/or you are not doing any kind of trail running currently.

 

PLEASE NOTE WE CANNOT SUPPORT REFUNDS, TRANSFERS, AND/OR CREDITS.

 

In the event of race cancellation due to wildfires, hazardous air quality, hazardous weather conditions, natural disasters, COVID and/or other global pandemics, or any 'act of God' (force majeure) that is beyond our control, we cannot support refunds, transfers, and/or credits. Please note this has only happened ONCE due to COVID in 2020, but anything is possible. Please make sure you are comfortable with these potential risks before you sign up. 

In the event of race cancellation due to any of the aforementioned, we will ship all race swag/items to participants and provide direction around navigating the course(s) on your own. We'll also provide direction around submitting your result. 

We also cannot support refunds, transfers, and/or race credits if you get injured in the days/week(s) leading up to race day, if your schedule changes in the days/week(s) leading up to race day, if a work trip comes up that makes it impossible for you to attend on race day, and/or any other professional or personal matter that arises making it difficult for you to attend in person on race day.

In the event of any of the aforementioned, we will ship all race swag/items to said participants and provide direction around navigating the course(s) on your own. We'll also provide direction around submitting your result.

name: The Rebel Run – 5K, 10K, 10M, and Half Marathon
description:
Join us for an out of this world run!

Details
Start Location: Long Beach Location TBD
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course
5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route 
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details
Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

description:
We cannot promise you'll encounter any cryptic, aquatic creatures at Loch Chabot, but you might! We DO promise a gorgeous trail run on the scenic trails of Loch Chabot Regional Park, some quality nature therapy, and some incredible views!

We'll also hook you up with some awesome swag (an awesome shirt, a handcrafted race woodallion), a Rock the Loch beer sampler stein, & more), quality post run beverages/snacks, DJ Cryptid spinning your favorite tunes before/during/after the race, and more!

If you can't join us LIVE at Loch Chabot, no problem! We're supporting a VIRTUAL participation option as well.

Where: Lake Chabot in Castro Valley, CA.
When: Sun, 6/28- Early Half Start-8:15AM (for those needing 3.5-4 hours), Standard Half Start-9:15AM (for those needing 3 hours or less), 10K Start-9:30AM, 5K Start- 9:45AM.
Course Maps: 5K Course Map, 10K Course Map, Half Marathon Course Map.

Course Details:

  • The 5K is 100% paved. It's a great course for conquering your first and/or fastest 5K!
  • The 10K is 50% paved, 50% trail, and includes '1' tough climb. The 10K is a great option for those new to trails. 
  • The Half Marathon includes 3ish miles paved and the rest is trail. The Half includes nearly 1,700 feet of ascent/descent. The half is a STOUT challenge we'd recommend only for experienced trail runners. 

Aid Stations:

  • The 10K includes '1' aid station approximately 3 miles into the race. The Half Marathon includes aid stations at 4.1 miles, 7.65 miles, and 9.85 miles.
  • Aid stations include water, Skratch Labs electrolyte drink, GU Energy products, Saltstick products, chips, and pretzels. 

The Experience:

All Rock the Loch participants receive....

  • An epic, trail run at Loch Chabot (assuming you're not participating virtually)
  • An AWESOME race woodallion designed by Aravaipa Artworx
  • A sweet lifestyle tee
  • A custom Rock the Loch beer sampler stein.
  • Post race snacks/beverages including Bellwether Farms yogurt, Jambars, and more!
  • Access to the post race BREWFEST
  • DJ Cryptid spinning your favorite tunes before/during/after the race
